    using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 레벨디자인 테스트 (Docs/LevelTest_Tier1.md): 1단계 타워 4종만으로 10층까지 어디까지 버티는지 (에디터 전용).
    // 실제 게임 코드(맵 생성기·Board·MonsterManager·TowerManager·LevelRules)로 끝까지 돌린다. 에셋은 건드리지 않고 복사본만 바꾼다.
    //
    // 테스트 규칙:
    //   - 타워: 듀얼샷(basic) · 화염방사 · 나노봇(3층 해금) · EMP(5층 해금). 스탯은 끝까지 그대로 (진화·아이템 없음)
    //   - 크레딧: 시작 50, 웨이브 중 2초마다 1, 처치 1마리당 1. 휴식 중에는 없음
    //   - 몬스터 체력: 테스트 기본 체력(BaseHp) × 층당 성장률^(층−1) × 웨이브 보정(+8%/웨이브). 맵 단계 배율 표는 쓰지 않는다
    //   - 웨이브 구성·넥서스 체력(20)·몬스터 속도·넥서스 피해는 게임 규칙 그대로
    //
    // 플레이어 AI (0.5초마다, 휴식·웨이브 모두): "실제 효과 화력(EffectiveDps) × 같은 종류 감쇠 ÷ 비용"이 가장 큰 타워를 가장 좋은 자리·방향에 짓는다.
    // 더 좋은 타워(가치 1.3배 이상)가 20 크레딧 안쪽으로 모자라면 모아 두고, 더 모자라면 지금 살 수 있는 것을 산다 (타워 2개 미만이면 모으지 않음). 맵이 바뀌면 회수 타워를 새 맵에 무료로 재건축한다 (게임 규칙).
    // 넥서스가 0이 돼도 끝까지 진행해 "몇 층에서 무너졌는지"와 그 뒤 추세를 함께 본다.
    public static class LevelTestSimulator
    {
        public class TowerSpec
        {
            public string Id, Name;
            public int Cost, UnlockFloor;
            public int MaxTargets;   // 한 번에 맞히는 최대 마리 수 (단일 = 1, 범위 = 덮는 칸에 비례)
            public float SlowBonus;  // 감속으로 다른 타워가 더 오래 때리게 되는 몫을 DPS로 환산 (나노필드)
        }

        public static readonly TowerSpec[] Towers =
        {
            new TowerSpec { Id = "basic", Name = "듀얼샷", Cost = 50, UnlockFloor = 1, MaxTargets = 1 },
            new TowerSpec { Id = "flamethrower", Name = "화염방사", Cost = 70, UnlockFloor = 1, MaxTargets = 3 },
            new TowerSpec { Id = "nano", Name = "나노봇", Cost = 80, UnlockFloor = 3, MaxTargets = 1, SlowBonus = 1.2f },
            new TowerSpec { Id = "emp", Name = "EMP", Cost = 100, UnlockFloor = 5, MaxTargets = 6 },
        };

        public const int StartCredit = 50;
        public const float IncomeEverySec = 2f;
        public const int KillReward = 1;
        public const float HpPerWave = 0.08f;

        [System.Serializable]
        public class WaveRow
        {
            public int Floor, Wave, Monsters, Kills, Leaks, Income, KillIncome, CreditEnd, NexusHp;
            public int Basic, Flame, Nano, Emp;
            public float NormalHp, TankHp, FastHp, Seconds, TeamDps;
        }

        public class RunResult
        {
            public float Growth;
            public int Seed;
            public int FailFloor; // 넥서스가 처음 0 이하가 된 층 (끝까지 버티면 0)
            public List<WaveRow> Rows = new List<WaveRow>();
        }

        const float Dt = 0.05f;
        const float ShopEvery = 0.5f;

        // 몬스터 기본 체력 (테스트용, 1층 1웨이브 값). 넥서스 피해는 게임 값 그대로 (일반 1 · 해머헤드 1 · 바스티온 2)
        public static readonly Dictionary<string, float> BaseHp = new Dictionary<string, float> { { "normal", 2f }, { "fast", 1f }, { "tank", 6f } };

        public static RunResult Run(float growth, int seed)
        {
            var srcConfig = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            var config = Object.Instantiate(srcConfig);
            config.startCash = StartCredit;
            var r = config.rules;
            r.hpMapScale = new[] { 1f };
            r.hpComplexityScale = new[] { 1f };
            r.hpSecondFloorScale = 1f;
            r.hpPerWave = HpPerWave;
            var mapRules = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset");

            string[] monsterIds = { "normal", "fast", "tank" };
            var monsterDefs = new MonsterDef[monsterIds.Length];
            var baseHp = new float[monsterIds.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < monsterIds.Length; i++)
            {
                monsterDefs[i] = Object.Instantiate(AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/" + monsterIds[i] + ".asset"));
                monsterDefs[i].reward = KillReward;
                monsterDefs[i].viewPrefab = null;
                baseHp[i] = BaseHp[monsterIds[i]];
            }

            var towerDefs = new TowerDef[Towers.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < Towers.Length; i++)
            {
                var d = Object.Instantiate(AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/" + Towers[i].Id + ".asset"));
                d.name = Towers[i].Id;
                d.buildCost = Towers[i].Cost;
                d.viewPrefab = null;
                d.projectilePrefab = null;
                d.muzzleFxPrefab = null;
                d.chargeFxPrefab = null;
                d.hitFxPrefab = null;
                d.fieldFxPrefab = null;
                towerDefs[i] = d;
            }

            var data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, mapRules, monsterDefs, towerDefs);
            var board = new Board();
            var monsters = new MonsterManager();
            var towers = new TowerManager();
            var player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);

            int kills = 0, leaks = 0, nexusLost = 0;
            monsters.Killed += e => { kills++; player.HandleKilled(e); };
            monsters.ReachedExit += e => { leaks++; nexusLost += e.Damage; };

            var result = new RunResult { Growth = growth, Seed = seed };
            var buffer = new WaveSpawn[8];
            int g = 0, lastTier = 0;

            for (int floor = 1; floor <= config.finalFloor; floor++)
            {
                var plan = LevelRules.GetFloorPlan(config, floor);
                float floorMul = Mathf.Pow(growth, floor - 1);
                for (int i = 0; i < monsterDefs.Length; i++)
                    monsterDefs[i].hp = baseHp[i] * floorMul;
                if (plan.Tier != lastTier)
                {
                    if (lastTier != 0)
                        towers.MoveAllTowersToRecovery(floor);
                    board.Load(new LayoutMapGenerator().Generate(new MapSpec(plan.N, plan.Complexity, seed * 100 + floor, mapRules)));
                    var recovered = new List<TowerDef>(run.RecoveryList);
                    recovered.Sort((a, b) => b.buildCost.CompareTo(a.buildCost));
                    foreach (var def in recovered)
                        if (BestSite(board, towers, def, out var cell, out _))
                            towers.RequestRebuild(def, cell);
                    run.RecoveryList.Clear();
                    lastTier = plan.Tier;
                }

                for (int w = 1; w <= plan.Waves; w++)
                {
                    g++;
                    run.Floor = floor;
                    run.Wave = w;
                    int k0 = kills, l0 = leaks;

                    Shop(floor, board, towers, player, towerDefs); // 휴식: 짓기 (휴식 중 크레딧 지급은 없음)

                    monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, floor, w));
                    int lines = LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, floor, w, g, buffer);
                    monsters.BeginWave(buffer, lines);
                    int count = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < lines; i++) count += buffer[i].Count;

                    float shopTimer = 0f, incomeTimer = 0f, time = 0f;
                    int income = 0, guard = 0;
                    while ((!monsters.SpawnFinished || monsters.AliveCount > 0) && guard++ < 400000)
                    {
                        monsters.TickSpawn(Dt);
                        monsters.TickMove(Dt);
                        towers.TickCombat(Dt);
                        monsters.Cleanup();
                        time += Dt;
                        incomeTimer += Dt;
                        if (incomeTimer >= IncomeEverySec)
                        {
                            incomeTimer -= IncomeEverySec;
                            player.Earn(1, CashReason.Kill); // 웨이브 중 시간 지급 (시뮬레이션 전용, 사유 구분 없음)
                            income++;
                        }
                        shopTimer += Dt;
                        if (shopTimer >= ShopEvery)
                        {
                            shopTimer = 0f;
                            Shop(floor, board, towers, player, towerDefs);
                        }
                    }
                    monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Break, floor, w));
                    towers.ClearCombat();

                    float scale = monsters.HpScale;
                    var row = new WaveRow
                    {
                        Floor = floor, Wave = w, Monsters = count, Kills = kills - k0, Leaks = leaks - l0,
                        Income = income, KillIncome = (kills - k0) * KillReward, CreditEnd = player.Cash,
                        NexusHp = config.nexusHp - nexusLost, Seconds = time,
                        NormalHp = LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, monsterDefs[0].hp, scale),
                        FastHp = LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, monsterDefs[1].hp, scale),
                        TankHp = LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, monsterDefs[2].hp, scale),
                    };
                    foreach (var t in run.Towers)
                    {
                        row.TeamDps += Dps(t.Def);
                        switch (t.Def.name)
                        {
                            case "basic": row.Basic++; break;
                            case "flamethrower": row.Flame++; break;
                            case "nano": row.Nano++; break;
                            case "emp": row.Emp++; break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (result.FailFloor == 0 && row.NexusHp <= 0)
                        result.FailFloor = floor;
                    result.Rows.Add(row);
                }
            }

            foreach (var d in towerDefs) Object.DestroyImmediate(d);
            foreach (var m in monsterDefs) Object.DestroyImmediate(m);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(config);
            return result;
        }

        // ---------- 플레이어 AI ----------

        // 혼합 배치 시나리오: 해금된 나노봇·EMP를 각각 이만큼은 먼저 갖춘다 (0 = AI 가치 계산대로).
        // AI 가치 계산으로는 둘 다 한 번도 사지 않아서, 섞어 지었을 때 차이를 따로 본다.
        public static int ForceMixCount;

        static void Shop(int floor, Board board, TowerManager towers, PlayerState player, TowerDef[] defs)
        {
            for (int guard = 0; guard < 30; guard++)
            {
                if (ForceMixCount > 0)
                {
                    bool waiting = false;
                    for (int i = 2; i < defs.Length; i++) // 나노봇, EMP
                    {
                        if (floor < Towers[i].UnlockFloor || CountOf(towers, defs[i]) >= ForceMixCount)
                            continue;
                        if (!BestSite(board, towers, defs[i], out var site, out _))
                            continue;
                        if (player.Cash >= defs[i].buildCost)
                        {
                            towers.Build(site, defs[i]);
                            waiting = true; // 지었으면 처음부터 다시 본다
                            break;
                        }
                        if (towers.Towers.Count >= 2)
                            return; // 모은다
                    }
                    if (waiting)
                        continue;
                }
                float bestValue = 0f, bestAffordable = 0f;
                int bestCost = 0;
                TowerDef buyDef = null;
                Vector2Int buyCell = default;
                for (int i = 0; i < defs.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (floor < Towers[i].UnlockFloor)
                        continue;
                    var def = defs[i];
                    if (!BestSite(board, towers, def, out var cell, out int cover))
                        continue;
                    float value = EffectiveDps(i, def, cover) * Mathf.Pow(VarietyDecay, CountOf(towers, def)) / def.buildCost;
                    if (value > bestValue) { bestValue = value; bestCost = def.buildCost; }
                    if (def.buildCost <= player.Cash && value > bestAffordable)
                    {
                        bestAffordable = value;
                        buyDef = def;
                        buyCell = cell;
                    }
                }
                // 살 게 없거나, 더 좋은 타워가 조금만(SaveGap 이하) 모으면 되면 모은다. 한참 모아야 하면 지금 살 수 있는 걸 산다
                // 타워가 2개 미만이면 모으지 않는다 (막을 수단부터)
                if (buyDef == null || (towers.Towers.Count >= 2 && bestValue > bestAffordable * 1.3f && bestCost - player.Cash <= SaveGap))
                    return;
                towers.Build(buyCell, buyDef); // 방향 = 경로를 가장 많이 덮는 쪽 (BestFacing)
            }
        }

        // 실제 효과 화력: 대상 1마리 DPS × 동시에 맞히는 마리 수(덮는 칸의 70%, 최대 MaxTargets) × 가동률 + 감속 보정.
        // 몬스터는 1초 간격·1칸/초로 와서 경로 칸마다 약 1마리. 덮는 칸이 3칸 미만이면 대상이 없는 시간이 생긴다.
        static float EffectiveDps(int spec, TowerDef def, int cover)
        {
            var s = Towers[spec];
            float uptime = Mathf.Min(1f, cover / 3f);
            float targets = Mathf.Clamp(cover * 0.7f, 1f, s.MaxTargets);
            return (Dps(def) * targets + s.SlowBonus) * uptime;
        }

        // 같은 종류를 많이 지을수록 가치를 조금씩 낮춰 섞어 짓게 한다 (한 종류만 쌓으면 그 종류의 약점이 그대로 드러남).
        const float VarietyDecay = 0.92f;

        static int CountOf(TowerManager towers, TowerDef def)
        {
            int n = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < towers.Towers.Count; i++)
                if (towers.Towers[i].Def == def) n++;
            return n;
        }

        const int SaveGap = 20;

        // 1회 공격 피해 ÷ 주기 (차지 포함, 대상 1마리 기준)
        static float Dps(TowerDef d) => d.damage * Mathf.Max(1, d.burstCount) / (d.interval + d.chargeTime);

        static bool BestSite(Board board, TowerManager towers, TowerDef def, out Vector2Int best, out int bestCover)
        {
            best = default;
            bestCover = 0;
            int n = board.N;
            for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                {
                    var c = new Vector2Int(x, y);
                    if (!board.IsBuildable(c))
                        continue;
                    int facing = towers.BestFacing(def, c);
                    int cover = 0;
                    for (int px = 0; px < n; px++)
                        for (int py = 0; py < n; py++)
                            if (board.IsPathCell(new Vector2Int(px, py)) && TowerFacing.InArea(def, facing, px - x, py - y))
                                cover++;
                    if (cover > bestCover)
                    {
                        bestCover = cover;
                        best = c;
                    }
                }
            return bestCover > 0;
        }

        // ---------- 출력 ----------

        public static string ToJson(List<RunResult> results)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("[");
            for (int i = 0; i < results.Count; i++)
            {
                var res = results[i];
                if (i > 0) sb.Append(',');
                sb.Append("{\"growth\":").Append(res.Growth.ToString("0.###", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                    .Append(",\"seed\":").Append(res.Seed).Append(",\"failFloor\":").Append(res.FailFloor).Append(",\"rows\":[");
                for (int j = 0; j < res.Rows.Count; j++)
                {
                    if (j > 0) sb.Append(',');
                    sb.Append(JsonUtility.ToJson(res.Rows[j]));
                }
                sb.Append("]}");
            }
            return sb.Append(']').ToString();
        }

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Balance/Level Test Tier1 (10F)")]
        public static void RunMenu()
        {
            var results = new List<RunResult>();
            foreach (float growth in new[] { 1.15f, 1.25f, 1.35f, 1.45f })
                foreach (int seed in new[] { 1, 2, 3 })
                    results.Add(Run(growth, seed));
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText("Temp/LevelTest_Tier1.json", ToJson(results));
            Debug.Log("[LevelTest] Temp/LevelTest_Tier1.json");
        }
    }
}

    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 맵 생성 테스트 씬 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Setup/Map Gen Test Scene): SampleScene을 복사해
    // GameLoop를 맵 생성 테스트 모드로 바꾼다 (F키 = 랜덤 맵, 게임 진행 없음). SampleScene은 그대로 둔다.
    // 여러 번 눌러도 된다: 매번 SampleScene에서 새로 복사한다.
    public static class MapGenTestSceneBuilder
    {
        const string SampleScenePath = "Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity";
        public const string ScenePath = "Assets/Scenes/Test_MapGen.unity";

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Setup/Map Gen Test Scene")]
        public static void Build()
        {
            if (!EditorSceneManager.SaveCurrentModifiedScenesIfUserWantsTo())
                return;
            var previous = EditorSceneManager.GetActiveScene().path;
            if (AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<SceneAsset>(ScenePath) != null)
                AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(ScenePath);
            AssetDatabase.CopyAsset(SampleScenePath, ScenePath);
            var scene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(ScenePath);

            // 게임 진행 대신 맵 생성 테스트 모드 (GameLoop가 맵 표시·카메라만 돌린다. Update는 GameLoop 하나)
            var loop = Object.FindFirstObjectByType<GameLoop>();
            var so = new SerializedObject(loop);
            so.FindProperty("mapGenTestMode").boolValue = true;
            so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();

            EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene);
            Debug.Log("[MapGenTestSceneBuilder] " + ScenePath + " 생성 (F키 = 랜덤 맵)");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(previous) && previous != ScenePath)
                EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(previous);
        }
    }
}

    using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 몬스터 모델(FBX) → 게임용 프리팹 + Animator Controller (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Monster Prefabs).
    // Controller에는 Idle / Walk / Die 상태만 두고 전환(Transition)은 만들지 않는다.
    // 어떤 상태를 재생할지는 코드의 유한상태머신(MonsterView)이 정한다.
    public static class MonsterPrefabBuilder
    {
        const string ModelFolder = "Assets/Models/Monsters";
        const string ControllerFolder = "Assets/Art/Monsters";
        const string PrefabFolder = "Assets/Prefabs/Monsters";

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Monster Prefabs")]
        public static void BuildAll()
        {
            foreach (var guid in AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:Model", new[] { ModelFolder }))
                Build(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        }

        // 모델 이름 = 프리팹·컨트롤러 이름. 클립 이름은 "…Idle", "…Walk", "…Die"로 끝나야 한다.
        public static GameObject Build(string modelPath)
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ControllerFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(modelPath);
            ConfigureImporter(modelPath);

            AnimationClip idle = null, walk = null, die = null;
            foreach (var asset in AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(modelPath))
            {
                if (!(asset is AnimationClip clip) || clip.name.StartsWith("__preview"))
                    continue;
                if (clip.name.EndsWith("Idle")) idle = clip;
                else if (clip.name.EndsWith("Walk")) walk = clip;
                else if (clip.name.EndsWith("Die")) die = clip;
            }
            if (idle == null || walk == null || die == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"[MonsterPrefabBuilder] {modelPath}: Idle/Walk/Die 클립을 모두 찾지 못했습니다.");
                return null;
            }

            var controller = BuildController($"{ControllerFolder}/{name}.controller", idle, walk, die);

            var model = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(modelPath);
            var root = (GameObject)PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab(model);
            try
            {
                var animator = root.GetComponent<Animator>();
                if (animator == null)
                    animator = root.AddComponent<Animator>();
                animator.runtimeAnimatorController = controller;
                animator.applyRootMotion = false;
                animator.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.CullUpdateTransforms; // 화면 밖이면 뼈 계산 생략
                foreach (var smr in root.GetComponentsInChildren<SkinnedMeshRenderer>())
                    smr.updateWhenOffscreen = false;
                var prefab = PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, $"{PrefabFolder}/{name}.prefab");
                Debug.Log($"[MonsterPrefabBuilder] {name}: 프리팹·컨트롤러 생성 (Idle {idle.length:F2}s, Walk {walk.length:F2}s, Die {die.length:F2}s)");
                return prefab;
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            }
        }

        // Idle·Walk는 반복, Die는 한 번. Generic 리그는 이 모델로 Avatar를 만든다.
        static void ConfigureImporter(string modelPath)
        {
            var importer = (ModelImporter)AssetImporter.GetAtPath(modelPath);
            importer.animationType = ModelImporterAnimationType.Generic;
            importer.avatarSetup = ModelImporterAvatarSetup.CreateFromThisModel;
            var clips = importer.clipAnimations;
            if (clips == null || clips.Length == 0)
                clips = importer.defaultClipAnimations;
            for (int i = 0; i < clips.Length; i++)
            {
                bool loop = clips[i].name.EndsWith("Idle") || clips[i].name.EndsWith("Walk");
                clips[i].loopTime = loop;
                clips[i].loopPose = loop;
            }
            importer.clipAnimations = clips;
            importer.SaveAndReimport();
        }

        static AnimatorController BuildController(string path, AnimationClip idle, AnimationClip walk, AnimationClip die)
        {
            if (AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<AnimatorController>(path) != null)
                AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path);
            var controller = AnimatorController.CreateAnimatorControllerAtPath(path);
            var sm = controller.layers[0].stateMachine;
            var idleState = sm.AddState("Idle");
            idleState.motion = idle;
            var walkState = sm.AddState("Walk");
            walkState.motion = walk;
            var dieState = sm.AddState("Die");
            dieState.motion = die;
            sm.defaultState = idleState;
            return controller;
        }

        static void EnsureFolder(string path)
        {
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(path))
                return;
            var parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(path).Replace('\\', '/');
            AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(parent, Path.GetFileName(path));
        }
    }
}

    using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // EMP 타워 이펙트 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build EMP FX).
    //   FX_EMPWave : 타워 발밑에서 원형으로 퍼지는 전자파. 바닥에 누운 빛 고리 + 고리를 따라 달리는 지지직 전기 줄기 + 불티 고리
    //   FX_EMPHit  : 파면에 닿은 몬스터에서 튀는 작은 전기
    // 파면 속도·반지름은 게임 판정(TowerDef.pulseSpeed·pulseRadius)과 같은 값(EmpWaveSpeed·EmpWaveRadius)으로 만든다.
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string EmpWavePath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_EMPWave.prefab";
        public const string EmpHitPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_EMPHit.prefab";
        public const float EmpWaveRadius = 2f;  // 칸 (= 월드 단위)
        public const float EmpWaveSpeed = 6f;   // 칸/초
        const string RingTexturePath = ArtFolder + "/FX_Ring.png";
        const string RingMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_RingAdditive.mat";
        const string RingBandTexturePath = ArtFolder + "/FX_RingBand.png";
        const string RingBandMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_RingBand.mat";

        static readonly Color EmpCore = new Color(0.86f, 0.92f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color EmpGlow = new Color(0.5f, 0.64f, 1f, 1f);   // SF_EMP_Glow 쪽
        static readonly Color EmpDeep = new Color(0.45f, 0.38f, 1f, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build EMP FX")]
        public static void BuildEmp()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var dot = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
            if (dot == null)
                dot = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var mat = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, dot, true);
            var ringMat = BuildMaterial(RingMatPath, BuildRingTexture(RingTexturePath, 0.07f), true);
            // 밝은 땅(잔디·흙) 위에서도 보이게: 더하기가 아닌 반투명으로 덮는 짙은 파란 띠 (밝은 고리 밑에 깔린다)
            var bandMat = BuildMaterial(RingBandMatPath, BuildRingTexture(RingBandTexturePath, 0.14f), false);

            Save("FX_EMPWave", EmpWavePath, root => BuildEmpWave(root, mat, ringMat, bandMat));
            Save("FX_EMPHit", EmpHitPath, root => BuildEmpHit(root, mat));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] EMP 이펙트 2종 생성");
        }

        // --- 전자파 (원점 = 타워 발밑 조금 위, 바닥 평면으로 퍼짐) ---
        static void BuildEmpWave(GameObject root, Material mat, Material ringMat, Material bandMat)
        {
            float travel = EmpWaveRadius / EmpWaveSpeed; // 파면이 끝까지 가는 시간

            // 1) 바닥에 누운 빛 고리: 0 → 반지름까지 커지며 지지직 깜빡이다 사라진다
            var ring = AddSystem(root, ringMat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = ring.main;
            main.duration = travel + 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = travel + 0.08f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = (EmpWaveRadius + 0.25f) * 2f;
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(ring, 1, 1);
            NoShape(ring);
            var size = ring.sizeOverLifetime;
            size.enabled = true;
            var grow = AnimationCurve.Linear(0f, 0.04f, travel / (travel + 0.08f), 1f); // 파면과 같은 속도로 일정하게
            grow.AddKey(new Keyframe(1f, 1.03f));
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, grow);
            var color = ring.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(EmpCore, 0f), new GradientColorKey(EmpGlow, 0.5f), new GradientColorKey(EmpDeep, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.45f, 0.12f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0.24f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.5f, 0.38f),
                        new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0.52f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.4f, 0.68f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.85f, 0.82f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            color.color = g; // 깜빡임 = 지지직
            ring.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().sortingOrder = 2; // 짙은 띠 위
            AddElectricLight(root, ring, 6f);

            // 1-1) 짙은 파란 띠 (반투명): 밝은 바닥에서 고리의 윤곽을 잡아 준다
            var band = AddSystem(Child(root, "Band"), bandMat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = band.main;
            main.duration = travel + 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = travel + 0.1f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = (EmpWaveRadius + 0.25f) * 2f;
            main.startColor = new Color(0.16f, 0.24f, 0.95f, 0.8f);
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(band, 1, 1);
            NoShape(band);
            var bandSize = band.sizeOverLifetime;
            bandSize.enabled = true;
            bandSize.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, grow);
            var bandColor = band.colorOverLifetime;
            bandColor.enabled = true;
            var bg = new Gradient();
            bg.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(Color.white, 0f), new GradientColorKey(Color.white, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.9f, 0.7f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            bandColor.color = bg;
            band.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().sortingOrder = 1;

            // 1-2) 메아리 고리: 조금 늦게 한 번 더 퍼져 "웅-웅" 두 겹 파동
            var echo = AddSystem(Child(root, "Echo"), ringMat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = echo.main;
            main.duration = travel + 0.2f;
            main.startDelay = 0.08f;
            main.startLifetime = travel + 0.08f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = (EmpWaveRadius + 0.25f) * 2f;
            main.startColor = new Color(EmpGlow.r, EmpGlow.g, EmpGlow.b, 0.7f);
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(echo, 1, 1);
            NoShape(echo);
            var echoSize = echo.sizeOverLifetime;
            echoSize.enabled = true;
            echoSize.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, grow);
            Fade(echo, EmpGlow, EmpDeep);
            echo.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().sortingOrder = 2;

            // 1-3) 전자파 벽: 파면에서 위로 솟는 빛줄기 → 나무·타워 사이로도 보이는 높이
            var wall = AddSystem(Child(root, "Wall"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var wallRenderer = wall.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            wallRenderer.velocityScale = 0.06f;
            wallRenderer.lengthScale = 2f;
            wallRenderer.sortingOrder = 3;
            main = wall.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = travel;
            main.startSpeed = EmpWaveSpeed;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.08f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 90;
            Burst(wall, 64, 72);
            FlatCircle(wall, 0.15f);
            var lift = wall.velocityOverLifetime;
            lift.enabled = true;
            lift.space = ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World;
            lift.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, 0f);
            lift.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(2.5f, 4.5f);
            lift.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, 0f);
            Fade(wall, EmpCore, EmpGlow);

            // 2) 지지직 전기 줄기: 고리와 같은 속도로 바깥으로 달리며 노이즈로 꺾인 선을 남긴다
            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Crackle"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = travel;
            main.startSpeed = EmpWaveSpeed;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.02f, 0.035f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 90;
            Burst(arcs, 60, 70);
            FlatCircle(arcs, 0.15f);
            ElectricTrail(arcs, mat, 0.065f, 1f);
            arcs.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().sortingOrder = 3;
            var trails = arcs.trails;
            trails.lifetime = 0.35f; // 짧은 꼬리 → 고리 근처에서만 지지직
            Noise(arcs, 2.4f, 10f);

            // 3) 불티 고리: 파면을 따라 점점이 빛나는 입자
            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.025f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = travel;
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(EmpWaveSpeed * 0.92f, EmpWaveSpeed);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.03f, 0.05f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 120;
            Burst(sparks, 90, 110);
            FlatCircle(sparks, 0.15f);
            Fade(sparks, EmpCore, EmpGlow);

            // 4) 방출 순간 타워 발밑 섬광
            var flash = AddSystem(Child(root, "Flash"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.12f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, 1.3f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(flash, 1, 1);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, EmpCore, EmpGlow);
            Shrink(flash, 1f, 0.4f);
        }

        // --- 맞은 몬스터의 지지직 ---
        static void BuildEmpHit(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.5f, 0.65f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(flash, 1, 1);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, EmpCore, EmpGlow);

            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.16f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.2f, 2.2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.01f, 0.02f);
            main.startColor = EmpCore;
            main.maxParticles = 12;
            Burst(arcs, 7, 9);
            Sphere(arcs, 0.08f);
            ElectricTrail(arcs, mat, 0.032f, 1f);
            Noise(arcs, 3f, 10f);
        }

        // 바닥에 눕힌 원 (가장자리에서 바깥으로 퍼짐)
        static void FlatCircle(ParticleSystem ps, float radius)
        {
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Circle;
            shape.radius = radius;
            shape.radiusThickness = 0f; // 가장자리에서
            shape.arc = 360f;
            shape.rotation = new Vector3(90f, 0f, 0f);
        }

        // 가운데가 비고 테두리가 밝은 고리 텍스처 (전자파 고리)
        static Texture2D BuildRingTexture(string path, float width)
        {
            const int size = 256;
            var tex = new Texture2D(size, size, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
            for (int y = 0; y < size; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < size; x++)
                {
                    float dx = (x + 0.5f) / size * 2f - 1f;
                    float dy = (y + 0.5f) / size * 2f - 1f;
                    float d = Mathf.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    float edge = Mathf.Exp(-Mathf.Pow((d - 0.88f) / width, 2f));          // 밝은 테두리
                    float inner = Mathf.Clamp01((d - 0.35f) / 0.55f) * 0.18f * (d < 0.95f ? 1f : 0f); // 안쪽 옅은 빛
                    tex.SetPixel(x, y, new Color(1f, 1f, 1f, Mathf.Clamp01(edge + inner)));
                }
            File.WriteAllBytes(path, tex.EncodeToPNG());
            Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(path);
            var importer = (TextureImporter)AssetImporter.GetAtPath(path);
            importer.textureType = TextureImporterType.Default;
            importer.alphaIsTransparency = true;
            importer.mipmapEnabled = true;
            importer.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
            importer.SaveAndReimport();
            return AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(path);
        }
    }
}

    11.7 MuzzleFxBuilder.Flame2.cs

    Assets/Editor/MuzzleFxBuilder.Flame2.cs · 323줄 · 함수 15개

    화염 계열 2단계 타워 이펙트 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Flame Tier2 FX). 모두 파티클이라 스크립트 Update가 없다. 블렌더에서 만든 불꽃 조각 모델(Assets/Models/FX/FX_PlasmaBeam · FX_Phosphorus · FX_Dust)을 메시 파티클로 뿜는다. 층 구성·색·속도·퍼짐 각도는 모델과 함께 온 TowerFlameFX.cs 설계값 그대로이고, 길이만 각 타워 사거리에 맞춰 줄인다 (설계 사거리 → 게임 사거리 비율 k로 속도·크기·중력을 같이 줄여 모양을 유지). 화염방사 타워처럼 한 번 발사(0.2초) 동안 이어서 뿜어 연달아 쏘면 끊기지 않는 불길이 된다. 프리팹 원점 = 노즐, +Z = 뿜는 방향. 불길 길이 = 각 타워의 coneLength → coneFxReach도 같은 값 (크기 1배). 플라즈마: 흰-하늘 줄기 + 파란 플라즈마 덩어리 + 끝에서 주황으로 식는 끝 덩어리, 가운데 떨리는 빔 혼합백린: 주황 화염 + 하얗게 타며 처지는 백린 덩어리 + 짙은 흰 연기 혼합분진: 짧고 넓은 화염 + 흙빛 분진 알갱이 + 튀는 스파크

    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 화염 계열 2단계 타워 이펙트 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Flame Tier2 FX). 모두 파티클이라 스크립트 Update가 없다.
    // 블렌더에서 만든 불꽃 조각 모델(Assets/Models/FX/FX_PlasmaBeam · FX_Phosphorus · FX_Dust)을 메시 파티클로 뿜는다.
    // 층 구성·색·속도·퍼짐 각도는 모델과 함께 온 TowerFlameFX.cs 설계값 그대로이고, 길이만 각 타워 사거리에 맞춰 줄인다
    // (설계 사거리 → 게임 사거리 비율 k로 속도·크기·중력을 같이 줄여 모양을 유지).
    // 화염방사 타워처럼 한 번 발사(0.2초) 동안 이어서 뿜어 연달아 쏘면 끊기지 않는 불길이 된다.
    // 프리팹 원점 = 노즐, +Z = 뿜는 방향. 불길 길이 = 각 타워의 coneLength → coneFxReach도 같은 값 (크기 1배).
    //   플라즈마: 흰-하늘 줄기 + 파란 플라즈마 덩어리 + 끝에서 주황으로 식는 끝 덩어리, 가운데 떨리는 빔
    //   혼합백린: 주황 화염 + 하얗게 타며 처지는 백린 덩어리 + 짙은 흰 연기
    //   혼합분진: 짧고 넓은 화염 + 흙빛 분진 알갱이 + 튀는 스파크
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string DustSprayPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_DustSpray.prefab";
        public const string PhosphorusSprayPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_PhosphorusSpray.prefab";
        public const string PlasmaJetPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_PlasmaJet.prefab";

        const string PlasmaModelPath = "Assets/Models/FX/FX_PlasmaBeam.fbx";
        const string PhosphorusModelPath = "Assets/Models/FX/FX_Phosphorus.fbx";
        const string DustModelPath = "Assets/Models/FX/FX_Dust.fbx";
        const string ChunkMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_ChunkUnlit.mat";      // 정점색(파티클 색)을 곱하는 불투명 Unlit
        const string GlowMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_AdditiveSolid.mat";    // 텍스처 없는 가산 (빔)
        const string StreakMeshPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_StreakMesh.asset";
        const string SparkMeshPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_SparkMesh.asset";
        const string BeamMeshPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_BeamTubeMesh.asset";

        // 히트박스(TowerDef.coneAngle / coneLength) = 이펙트가 실제로 퍼지는 폭과 길이
        public const float DustArc = 60f, DustReach = 1.6f;
        public const float PhosphorusArc = 40f, PhosphorusReach = 1.8f;
        public const float PlasmaArc = 0f, PlasmaReach = 3f; // 플라즈마는 일직선 (AttackType.Line, 3칸)
        // 모델 설계 사거리 (TowerFlameFX.Range)
        const float PlasmaDesignRange = 6f, PhosphorusDesignRange = 3.6f, DustDesignRange = 2.4f;
        // 플라즈마 굵기 (길이는 그대로 3칸): 빔 바깥 지름 = 타일 1칸의 1/3, 플라즈마 덩어리·줄기 크기·퍼지는 폭은 설계값 ×4
        const float PlasmaThickness = 4f;
        const float PlasmaBeamDiameter = 1f / 3f, PlasmaCoreDiameter = 1f / 6f;

        // 한 층: mesh = 모델 안 메시 이름 또는 "#streak"/"#spark"/"#beam" (여기서 만든 메시)
        struct ChunkLayer
        {
            public string Mesh;
            public float Rate, LifeMin, LifeMax, SpeedMin, SpeedMax, SizeMin, SizeMax, Angle, Radius, Gravity, Drag;
            public Color C0, C1, C2;     // 수명에 따른 색 (시작 / 중간 / 끝)
            public bool Grow;            // 커지며 사라짐(연기) / 줄어들며 사라짐(불꽃)
            public bool AlignLocal, AlignVelocity, Local;
        }

        static Color Rgb(float r, float g, float b) => new Color(r, g, b, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Flame Tier2 FX")]
        public static void BuildFlameTier2()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var chunk = BuildMaterial(ChunkMatPath, null, false);
            chunk.SetFloat("_Surface", 0f); // 불투명: 조각은 단단한 저폴리 덩어리
            chunk.DisableKeyword("_SURFACE_TYPE_TRANSPARENT");
            chunk.SetOverrideTag("RenderType", "Opaque");
            chunk.SetFloat("_ZWrite", 1f);
            chunk.SetFloat("_DstBlend", (float)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.Zero);
            chunk.SetFloat("_DstBlendAlpha", (float)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.Zero);
            chunk.SetFloat("_SrcBlend", (float)UnityEngine.Rendering.BlendMode.One);
            chunk.renderQueue = (int)UnityEngine.Rendering.RenderQueue.Geometry;
            var glow = BuildMaterial(GlowMatPath, null, true);
            var streak = SaveMesh(StreakMeshPath, StreakMesh());
            var spark = SaveMesh(SparkMeshPath, BoxMesh(0.022f, 0.022f, 0.16f));
            var beam = SaveMesh(BeamMeshPath, TubeMesh(0.5f, 0.42f, 10));

            Save("FX_PlasmaJet", PlasmaJetPath, r => BuildChunkFx(r, PlasmaModelPath, PlasmaLayers(), PlasmaReach / PlasmaDesignRange, chunk, streak, spark, PlasmaThickness));
            Save("FX_PhosphorusSpray", PhosphorusSprayPath, r => BuildChunkFx(r, PhosphorusModelPath, PhosphorusLayers(), PhosphorusReach / PhosphorusDesignRange, chunk, streak, spark));
            Save("FX_DustSpray", DustSprayPath, r => BuildChunkFx(r, DustModelPath, DustLayers(), DustReach / DustDesignRange, chunk, streak, spark));
            var plasma = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(PlasmaJetPath);
            try
            {
                AddPlasmaBeam(plasma, beam, glow, PlasmaReach);
                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(plasma, PlasmaJetPath);
            }
            finally
            {
                PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(plasma);
            }
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 화염 계열 2단계 이펙트 3종 생성 (블렌더 조각 모델)");
        }

        // ---------- 층 설계 (TowerFlameFX.cs 값, 설계 사거리 R 기준) ----------

        static ChunkLayer[] PlasmaLayers()
        {
            const float R = PlasmaDesignRange;
            return new[]
            {
                // 토치처럼: 흰-하늘 코어 → 파란 몸통 → 끝에서 주황
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "#streak", Rate = 260, LifeMin = 0.22f, LifeMax = 0.3f, SpeedMin = R / 0.3f, SpeedMax = R / 0.26f, SizeMin = 0.7f, SizeMax = 1f, Angle = 1.2f, Radius = 0.03f,
                    C0 = Rgb(0.95f, 0.98f, 1f), C1 = Rgb(0.55f, 0.8f, 1f), C2 = Rgb(0.2f, 0.45f, 1f), AlignLocal = true, Local = true },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_Plasma_Chunk", Rate = 170, LifeMin = 0.28f, LifeMax = 0.4f, SpeedMin = R / 0.42f, SpeedMax = R / 0.36f, SizeMin = 0.45f, SizeMax = 0.8f, Angle = 2.5f, Radius = 0.05f, Drag = 0.3f,
                    C0 = Rgb(0.45f, 0.7f, 1f), C1 = Rgb(0.15f, 0.4f, 1f), C2 = Rgb(0.45f, 0.25f, 0.95f) },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_Plasma_Tip", Rate = 70, LifeMin = 0.35f, LifeMax = 0.45f, SpeedMin = R / 0.46f, SpeedMax = R / 0.4f, SizeMin = 0.5f, SizeMax = 0.9f, Angle = 3.5f, Radius = 0.06f, Drag = 0.6f, Gravity = -0.05f,
                    C0 = Rgb(0.2f, 0.45f, 1f), C1 = Rgb(0.35f, 0.45f, 1f), C2 = Rgb(1f, 0.55f, 0.25f) },
            };
        }

        static ChunkLayer[] PhosphorusLayers()
        {
            return new[]
            {
                // 주황 화염 + 곳곳에 하얗게 타는 백린 덩어리 + 짙은 흰 연기
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_WP_Flame", Rate = 200, LifeMin = 0.35f, LifeMax = 0.55f, SpeedMin = 6.5f, SpeedMax = 8f, SizeMin = 0.5f, SizeMax = 1.1f, Angle = 13f, Radius = 0.08f, Drag = 0.6f, Gravity = -0.05f,
                    C0 = Rgb(1f, 0.85f, 0.4f), C1 = Rgb(1f, 0.5f, 0.1f), C2 = Rgb(0.55f, 0.12f, 0.04f) },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_WP_Phosphor", Rate = 70, LifeMin = 0.5f, LifeMax = 0.9f, SpeedMin = 5f, SpeedMax = 7.5f, SizeMin = 0.6f, SizeMax = 1.1f, Angle = 16f, Radius = 0.06f, Drag = 0.4f, Gravity = 0.6f,
                    C0 = Rgb(1f, 1f, 0.95f), C1 = Rgb(1f, 1f, 0.85f), C2 = Rgb(1f, 0.8f, 0.45f) },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_WP_Smoke", Rate = 45, LifeMin = 0.9f, LifeMax = 1.4f, SpeedMin = 2f, SpeedMax = 3.2f, SizeMin = 0.7f, SizeMax = 1.3f, Angle = 20f, Radius = 0.12f, Drag = 0.8f, Gravity = -0.12f,
                    C0 = Rgb(0.95f, 0.95f, 0.95f), C1 = Rgb(0.85f, 0.86f, 0.87f), C2 = Rgb(0.7f, 0.71f, 0.72f), Grow = true },
            };
        }

        static ChunkLayer[] DustLayers()
        {
            return new[]
            {
                // 짧고 넓은 화염 + 곳곳에 섞인 분진 알갱이 + 튀는 스파크
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_Dust_Flame", Rate = 230, LifeMin = 0.25f, LifeMax = 0.4f, SpeedMin = 6f, SpeedMax = 7.5f, SizeMin = 0.6f, SizeMax = 1.2f, Angle = 22f, Radius = 0.1f, Drag = 0.9f, Gravity = -0.05f,
                    C0 = Rgb(1f, 0.75f, 0.3f), C1 = Rgb(1f, 0.38f, 0.08f), C2 = Rgb(0.45f, 0.1f, 0.05f) },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "FX_Dust_Mote", Rate = 170, LifeMin = 0.3f, LifeMax = 0.5f, SpeedMin = 5f, SpeedMax = 7f, SizeMin = 0.7f, SizeMax = 1.4f, Angle = 26f, Radius = 0.1f, Drag = 0.7f, Gravity = 0.25f,
                    C0 = Rgb(0.42f, 0.36f, 0.28f), C1 = Rgb(0.33f, 0.28f, 0.22f), C2 = Rgb(0.25f, 0.21f, 0.17f) },
                new ChunkLayer { Mesh = "#spark", Rate = 70, LifeMin = 0.15f, LifeMax = 0.3f, SpeedMin = 8f, SpeedMax = 11f, SizeMin = 0.7f, SizeMax = 1.1f, Angle = 26f, Radius = 0.08f, Drag = 0.4f, Gravity = 0.3f,
                    C0 = Rgb(1f, 0.95f, 0.6f), C1 = Rgb(1f, 0.8f, 0.3f), C2 = Rgb(1f, 0.5f, 0.15f), AlignVelocity = true },
            };
        }

        // ---------- 구성 ----------

        // 첫 층이 루트 시스템 (자식까지 함께 재생). k = 게임 사거리 ÷ 설계 사거리
        // thickness = 크기·퍼지는 폭만 키우는 배율 (속도·길이는 k 그대로)
        static void BuildChunkFx(GameObject root, string modelPath, ChunkLayer[] layers, float k, Material mat, Mesh streak, Mesh spark, float thickness = 1f)
        {
            var model = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(modelPath);
            if (model == null)
                Debug.LogError("[MuzzleFxBuilder] " + modelPath + " 없음");
            for (int i = 0; i < layers.Length; i++)
            {
                var go = i == 0 ? root : Child(root, layers[i].Mesh.TrimStart('#'));
                var mesh = layers[i].Mesh == "#streak" ? streak : layers[i].Mesh == "#spark" ? spark : FindMesh(model, layers[i].Mesh);
                AddChunkLayer(go, layers[i], k, mat, mesh, thickness);
            }
        }

        static void AddChunkLayer(GameObject go, ChunkLayer l, float k, Material mat, Mesh mesh, float thickness)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(go, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Mesh, l.Local ? ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local : ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f; // 발사 1번 = 0.2초 동안 뿜기
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(l.LifeMin, l.LifeMax);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(l.SpeedMin * k, l.SpeedMax * k);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(l.SizeMin * k * thickness, l.SizeMax * k * thickness);
            main.gravityModifier = l.Gravity * k;
            main.maxParticles = Mathf.CeilToInt(l.Rate * 0.2f * 1.3f) + 2;
            if (!l.AlignLocal && !l.AlignVelocity)
            {
                main.startRotation3D = true;
                main.startRotationX = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
                main.startRotationY = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
                main.startRotationZ = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
                var rot = ps.rotationOverLifetime;
                rot.enabled = true;
                rot.separateAxes = true;
                rot.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-4f, 4f);
                rot.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-4f, 4f);
                rot.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-4f, 4f);
            }
            Stream(ps, l.Rate);
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Cone;
            shape.angle = l.Angle;
            shape.radius = l.Radius * k * thickness;
            shape.radiusThickness = 1f;
            if (l.Drag > 0f)
            {
                var limit = ps.limitVelocityOverLifetime;
                limit.enabled = true;
                limit.limit = 100f;
                limit.drag = l.Drag;
            }

            var color = ps.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(l.C0, 0f), new GradientColorKey(l.C1, 0.45f), new GradientColorKey(l.C2, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 1f) });
            color.color = g;
            var size = ps.sizeOverLifetime;
            size.enabled = true;
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, l.Grow
                ? new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0.5f), new Keyframe(0.6f, 1.1f), new Keyframe(1f, 0f))
                : new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0.7f), new Keyframe(0.25f, 1f), new Keyframe(1f, 0f)));

            var renderer = go.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            renderer.mesh = mesh;
            renderer.alignment = l.AlignVelocity ? ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Velocity : l.AlignLocal ? ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Local : ParticleSystemRenderSpace.World;
        }

        // 플라즈마 빔: 노즐에서 사거리 끝까지 뻗는 가는 관 2겹(흰 심 + 파란 빛). 발사 1번에 1개, 굵기가 떨린다.
        static void AddPlasmaBeam(GameObject root, Mesh tube, Material mat, float reach)
        {
            AddBeamPart(Child(root, "BeamCore"), tube, mat, Rgb(0.9f, 0.96f, 1f), PlasmaCoreDiameter, reach);
            AddBeamPart(Child(root, "BeamGlow"), tube, mat, Rgb(0.2f, 0.45f, 1f), PlasmaBeamDiameter, reach * 0.97f);
        }

        static void AddBeamPart(GameObject go, Mesh tube, Material mat, Color color, float width, float length)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(go, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Mesh, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startLifetime = 0.22f; // 다음 발사와 살짝 겹쳐 끊기지 않게
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize3D = true;
            main.startSizeX = width;
            main.startSizeY = width;
            main.startSizeZ = length;
            main.startColor = color;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(ps, 1, 1);
            NoShape(ps);
            var size = ps.sizeOverLifetime; // 떨림: 굵기만 출렁인다
            size.enabled = true;
            size.separateAxes = true;
            var wobble = new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 1f), new Keyframe(0.17f, 1.25f), new Keyframe(0.33f, 0.85f),
                new Keyframe(0.5f, 1.2f), new Keyframe(0.67f, 0.9f), new Keyframe(0.83f, 1.15f), new Keyframe(1f, 0.6f));
            size.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, wobble);
            size.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, wobble);
            size.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, AnimationCurve.Constant(0f, 1f, 1f));
            go.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().mesh = tube;
            go.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().alignment = ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Local;
        }

        static Mesh FindMesh(GameObject model, string name)
        {
            if (model != null)
                foreach (var mf in model.GetComponentsInChildren<MeshFilter>(true))
                    if (mf.name == name)
                        return mf.sharedMesh;
            Debug.LogWarning("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 조각 메시 없음: " + name);
            return null;
        }

        static Mesh SaveMesh(string path, Mesh mesh)
        {
            var existing = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Mesh>(path);
            if (existing == null)
            {
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(mesh, path);
                return mesh;
            }
            existing.Clear();
            existing.SetVertices(mesh.vertices);
            existing.SetTriangles(mesh.triangles, 0);
            existing.SetColors(mesh.colors);
            existing.SetNormals(mesh.normals);
            existing.RecalculateBounds();
            Object.DestroyImmediate(mesh);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(existing);
            return existing;
        }

        // +Z 방향으로 길쭉한 마름모 (플라즈마 줄기)
        static Mesh StreakMesh()
        {
            const float L = 0.5f, w = 0.06f;
            var v = new[] { new Vector3(0, 0, L / 2), new Vector3(0, 0, -L / 2), new Vector3(w, 0, 0), new Vector3(-w, 0, 0), new Vector3(0, w, 0), new Vector3(0, -w, 0) };
            var t = new[] { 0, 2, 4, 0, 4, 3, 0, 3, 5, 0, 5, 2, 1, 4, 2, 1, 3, 4, 1, 5, 3, 1, 2, 5 };
            var m = new Mesh { name = "FX_Streak", vertices = v, triangles = t, colors = White(v.Length) };
            m.RecalculateNormals();
            m.RecalculateBounds();
            return m;
        }

        // 가는 막대 (튀는 스파크)
        static Mesh BoxMesh(float x, float y, float z)
        {
            var v = new Vector3[8];
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                v[i] = new Vector3((i & 1) == 0 ? -x / 2 : x / 2, (i & 2) == 0 ? -y / 2 : y / 2, (i & 4) == 0 ? -z / 2 : z / 2);
            var t = new[] { 0, 2, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 6, 0, 1, 4, 1, 5, 4, 2, 6, 3, 3, 6, 7, 0, 4, 2, 2, 4, 6, 1, 3, 5, 3, 7, 5 };
            var m = new Mesh { name = "FX_Spark", vertices = v, triangles = t, colors = White(v.Length) };
            m.RecalculateNormals();
            m.RecalculateBounds();
            return m;
        }

        // 원점(노즐)에서 +Z로 길이 1 뻗는 관 (지름 1 → 끝 0.84). 파티클 크기 X·Y = 지름, Z = 사거리
        static Mesh TubeMesh(float r0, float r1, int n)
        {
            var v = new Vector3[n * 2];
            var t = new int[n * 6];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                float a = Mathf.PI * 2f * i / n;
                v[i * 2] = new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a) * r0, Mathf.Sin(a) * r0, 0f);
                v[i * 2 + 1] = new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(a) * r1, Mathf.Sin(a) * r1, 1f);
                int p = i * 2, q = (i + 1) % n * 2;
                t[i * 6] = p; t[i * 6 + 1] = q; t[i * 6 + 2] = p + 1;
                t[i * 6 + 3] = q; t[i * 6 + 4] = q + 1; t[i * 6 + 5] = p + 1;
            }
            var m = new Mesh { name = "FX_Beam", vertices = v, triangles = t, colors = White(v.Length) };
            m.RecalculateNormals();
            m.RecalculateBounds();
            return m;
        }

        static Color[] White(int count)
        {
            var c = new Color[count];
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                c[i] = Color.white;
            return c;
        }
    }
}

    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 번개 타워 이펙트 3종 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Lightning FX).
    //   FX_LightningCharge : 차지 동안(약 1초) 구슬 둘레에서 전기 줄기가 안쪽으로 모이고 빛이 커진다
    //   FX_LightningBolt   : 날아가는 번개 (투사체 표시). 밝은 머리 + 지그재그로 떨리는 꼬리 + 곁가지 전기
    //   FX_LightningBurst  : 발사 순간 구슬, 명중 순간 몬스터에서 터지는 섬광과 전기 불티
    // 전기 줄기 = 노이즈를 강하게 건 파티클의 트레일 (꺾인 선처럼 보인다). 모두 파티클 시스템이라 스크립트 Update가 없다.
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string LightningChargePath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_LightningCharge.prefab";
        public const string LightningBoltPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_LightningBolt.prefab";
        public const string LightningBurstPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_LightningBurst.prefab";

        static readonly Color ElectricCore = new Color(0.92f, 0.98f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color Electric = new Color(0.45f, 0.8f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color ElectricDeep = new Color(0.35f, 0.45f, 1f, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Lightning FX")]
        public static void BuildLightning() => BuildLightning(0.96f);

        // chargeDuration = 차지 클립 길이 (Tower_Lightning@Charge)
        public static void BuildLightning(float chargeDuration)
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var texture = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
            if (texture == null)
                texture = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var mat = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, texture, true);

            Save("FX_LightningCharge", LightningChargePath, root => BuildCharge(root, mat, chargeDuration));
            Save("FX_LightningBolt", LightningBoltPath, root => BuildBolt(root, mat));
            Save("FX_LightningBurst", LightningBurstPath, root => BuildBurst(root, mat));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 번개 이펙트 3종 생성");
        }

        static void Save(string name, string path, System.Action<GameObject> build)
        {
            var root = new GameObject(name);
            try
            {
                build(root);
                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, path);
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            }
        }

        // --- 차지: 구슬 둘레 전기가 모이며 빛이 커진다 (루트 = 빛 덩어리) ---
        static void BuildCharge(GameObject root, Material mat, float duration)
        {
            var glow = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = glow.main;
            main.duration = duration;
            main.startLifetime = duration;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = 0.32f;
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(glow, 1, 1);
            NoShape(glow);
            var size = glow.sizeOverLifetime;
            size.enabled = true;
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0.5f), new Keyframe(0.85f, 2.2f), new Keyframe(1f, 2.7f)));
            var color = glow.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(Electric, 0f), new GradientColorKey(ElectricCore, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(0.55f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0.7f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 1f) });
            color.color = g;
            AddElectricLight(root, glow, 3.5f);

            // 구슬 중심에서 깜빡이는 하얀 심
            var core = AddSystem(Child(root, "Core"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = core.main;
            main.duration = duration;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.04f, 0.07f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.12f, 0.2f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 6;
            Stream(core, 40f);
            NoShape(core);

            // 전기 줄기: 둘레 구면에서 안쪽(구슬)으로, 노이즈로 꺾인 트레일. 차지가 끝날수록 많아진다
            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.duration = duration;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.18f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-2.2f, -1.4f); // 안쪽으로
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.03f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 90;
            var emission = arcs.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 30f), new Keyframe(1f, 110f)));
            Sphere(arcs, 0.3f);
            ElectricTrail(arcs, mat, 0.035f, 1f);
            Noise(arcs, 0.9f, 8f);

            // 튀는 불티
            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.03f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = duration;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.14f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.6f, 1.6f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.03f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 40;
            Stream(sparks, 40f);
            Sphere(sparks, 0.12f);
            Fade(sparks, ElectricCore, Electric);
        }

        // --- 날아가는 번개 (투사체 표시, 계속 재생). 원점 = 번개 머리 ---
        static void BuildBolt(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var head = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = head.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.08f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.32f, 0.42f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 10;
            Stream(head, 60f);
            NoShape(head);
            Fade(head, ElectricCore, Electric);
            AddElectricLight(root, head, 3f);

            // 지나간 자리: 지그재그로 떨리는 꼬리 (월드 공간, 이동 거리마다)
            var streak = AddSystem(Child(root, "Streak"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = streak.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.14f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.09f, 0.13f);
            main.startColor = Electric;
            main.maxParticles = 120;
            var emission = streak.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 90f;
            NoShape(streak);
            Fade(streak, ElectricCore, ElectricDeep);
            Shrink(streak, 1f, 0.2f);
            Noise(streak, 0.6f, 12f);

            // 곁가지 전기: 짧게 튀어 나가는 꺾인 줄기
            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.12f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, 2.4f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.01f, 0.02f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 60;
            Stream(arcs, 45f);
            Sphere(arcs, 0.03f);
            ElectricTrail(arcs, mat, 0.028f, 1f);
            Noise(arcs, 3f, 9f);
        }

        // --- 섬광 + 전기 불티 (발사·명중) ---
        static void BuildBurst(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.07f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.7f, 0.9f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 3;
            Burst(flash, 1, 2);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, ElectricCore, Electric);
            Shrink(flash, 1f, 0.3f);
            AddElectricLight(root, flash, 4f);

            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.04f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.25f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.5f, 3.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.02f, 0.035f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 24;
            Burst(sparks, 12, 18);
            Sphere(sparks, 0.05f);
            Fade(sparks, ElectricCore, Electric);

            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.14f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(2f, 3.2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.012f, 0.02f);
            main.startColor = ElectricCore;
            main.maxParticles = 10;
            Burst(arcs, 5, 7);
            Sphere(arcs, 0.04f);
            ElectricTrail(arcs, mat, 0.02f, 1f);
            Noise(arcs, 3f, 9f);
        }

        // --- 도우미 ---

        static void NoShape(ParticleSystem ps)
        {
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = false;
        }

        static void Sphere(ParticleSystem ps, float radius)
        {
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Sphere;
            shape.radius = radius;
            shape.radiusThickness = 1f;
        }

        static void Noise(ParticleSystem ps, float strength, float frequency)
        {
            var noise = ps.noise;
            noise.enabled = true;
            noise.strength = strength;
            noise.frequency = frequency;
            noise.scrollSpeed = 3f;
            noise.damping = true;
            noise.quality = ParticleSystemNoiseQuality.Medium;
        }

        // 꺾인 전기 줄기: 파티클이 지나간 길을 가는 선으로 남긴다 (끝으로 갈수록 가늘게)
        static void ElectricTrail(ParticleSystem ps, Material mat, float width, float ratio)
        {
            var trails = ps.trails;
            trails.enabled = true;
            trails.mode = ParticleSystemTrailMode.PerParticle;
            trails.ratio = ratio;
            trails.lifetime = 0.6f;
            trails.minVertexDistance = 0.008f;
            trails.dieWithParticles = true;
            trails.sizeAffectsWidth = false;
            trails.widthOverTrail = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(width, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 1f), new Keyframe(1f, 0f)));
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(ElectricCore, 0f), new GradientColorKey(Electric, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            trails.colorOverTrail = g;
            var renderer = ps.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            renderer.trailMaterial = mat;
        }

        // 파란 순간 조명 (Lights 모듈). URP 조명 데이터를 미리 붙여 웨이브 중 AddComponent(GC)를 막는다.
        static void AddElectricLight(GameObject root, ParticleSystem ps, float intensity)
        {
            var lightGo = Child(root, "LightTemplate");
            var light = lightGo.AddComponent<Light>();
            light.type = LightType.Point;
            light.color = new Color(0.5f, 0.75f, 1f);
            light.range = 1.6f;
            light.intensity = intensity;
            light.shadows = LightShadows.None;
            lightGo.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal.UniversalAdditionalLightData>();
            lightGo.SetActive(false);
            var lights = ps.lights;
            lights.enabled = true;
            lights.light = light;
            lights.ratio = 1f;
            lights.maxLights = 1;
            lights.useParticleColor = false;
            lights.sizeAffectsRange = false;
            lights.alphaAffectsIntensity = true;
        }
    }
}

    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 나노봇 타워 이펙트 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Nano FX).
    //   FX_NanoMuzzle   : 발사구마다 터지는 작은 청록 섬광과 나노 입자
    //   Projectile_Nano : 날아가는 나노 탄 (모델 Projectile_Nano_Shot + 청록 꼬리 파티클, 루트 = 꼬리 파티클)
    //   FX_NanoField    : 명중 자리에 깔리는 나노 무리 (모델 FX_NanoSwarm_Field의 2초 물결 애니메이션 반복 + 떠오르는 입자)
    // 필드 모델은 루트 위치·회전도 키로 갖고 있어서, 배치용 빈 루트 아래 자식으로 둔다 (게임이 루트를 옮기고 크기를 바꾼다).
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string NanoMuzzlePath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_NanoMuzzle.prefab";
        public const string NanoProjectilePath = PrefabFolder + "/Projectile_Nano.prefab";
        public const string NanoFieldPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_NanoField.prefab";
        const string NanoShotModelPath = "Assets/Models/Towers/Projectile_Nano_Shot.fbx";
        const string NanoFieldModelPath = "Assets/Models/FX/FX_NanoSwarm_Field.fbx";
        const string NanoFieldControllerPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_NanoField.controller";
        public const float NanoFieldModelRadius = 1.6f; // 필드 모델 반지름 (나노 무리 3.2 × 3.4 모델 단위)

        static readonly Color NanoGlow = new Color(0.22f, 0.98f, 0.77f, 1f);  // SF_Nano_Glow
        static readonly Color NanoPale = new Color(0.75f, 1f, 0.92f, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Nano FX")]
        public static void BuildNano()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var texture = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
            if (texture == null)
                texture = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var mat = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, texture, true);

            Save("FX_NanoMuzzle", NanoMuzzlePath, root => BuildNanoMuzzle(root, mat));
            Save("Projectile_Nano", NanoProjectilePath, root => BuildNanoProjectile(root, mat));
            var controller = BuildNanoFieldController();
            Save("FX_NanoField", NanoFieldPath, root => BuildNanoField(root, mat, controller));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 나노 이펙트 3종 생성");
        }

        // 발사구 섬광: 짧은 청록 빛 + 앞으로 튀는 나노 입자 (원점 = 발사구, +Z = 발사 방향)
        static void BuildNanoMuzzle(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.07f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.16f, 0.22f);
            main.startColor = NanoPale;
            main.maxParticles = 3;
            Burst(flash, 1, 2);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, NanoPale, NanoGlow);
            Shrink(flash, 1f, 0.4f);

            var bits = AddSystem(Child(root, "Bits"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            bits.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.03f;
            main = bits.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.22f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.2f, 2.6f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.028f);
            main.startColor = NanoGlow;
            main.maxParticles = 14;
            Burst(bits, 5, 9);
            Cone(bits, 25f, 0.01f);
            Fade(bits, NanoPale, NanoGlow);
        }

        // 나노 탄: 루트 = 지나간 자리에 남는 청록 꼬리, 자식 = 탄 모델
        static void BuildNanoProjectile(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var trail = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var main = trail.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.12f, 0.22f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.035f, 0.06f);
            main.startColor = NanoGlow;
            main.maxParticles = 80;
            var emission = trail.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 60f;
            NoShape(trail);
            Fade(trail, NanoPale, NanoGlow);
            Shrink(trail, 1f, 0.1f);

            var model = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(NanoShotModelPath);
            if (model != null)
            {
                var m = (GameObject)PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab(model);
                m.name = "Model";
                m.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
                foreach (var r in m.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>())
                    r.shadowCastingMode = UnityEngine.Rendering.ShadowCastingMode.Off;
            }
        }

        // 필드 애니메이션 (Scene 클립 2초) 반복 재생용 컨트롤러. 모델의 클립을 반복으로 다시 가져온다.
        static AnimatorController BuildNanoFieldController()
        {
            var importer = (ModelImporter)AssetImporter.GetAtPath(NanoFieldModelPath);
            if (importer == null)
                return null;
            var clips = importer.clipAnimations;
            if (clips == null || clips.Length == 0)
                clips = importer.defaultClipAnimations;
            bool changed = false;
            foreach (var c in clips)
                if (!c.loopTime) { c.loopTime = true; changed = true; }
            if (changed || importer.clipAnimations.Length == 0)
            {
                importer.clipAnimations = clips;
                importer.SaveAndReimport();
            }
            AnimationClip clip = null;
            foreach (var o in AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(NanoFieldModelPath))
                if (o is AnimationClip ac && !ac.name.StartsWith("__preview"))
                    clip = ac;
            if (clip == null)
                return null;
            AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(NanoFieldControllerPath);
            return AnimatorController.CreateAnimatorControllerAtPathWithClip(NanoFieldControllerPath, clip);
        }

        // 필드: 배치용 빈 루트(바닥 중앙) + 나노 무리 모델(반복 애니메이션) + 원 안에서 떠오르는 청록 입자
        static void BuildNanoField(GameObject root, Material mat, AnimatorController controller)
        {
            var model = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(NanoFieldModelPath);
            if (model != null)
            {
                var m = (GameObject)PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab(model);
                m.name = "Swarm";
                m.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
                var animator = m.GetComponent<Animator>();
                if (animator == null)
                    animator = m.AddComponent<Animator>();
                animator.runtimeAnimatorController = controller;
                animator.applyRootMotion = false;
                animator.cullingMode = AnimatorCullingMode.CullUpdateTransforms;
                foreach (var r in m.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>())
                {
                    r.shadowCastingMode = UnityEngine.Rendering.ShadowCastingMode.Off;
                    r.receiveShadows = false;
                }
            }

            var motes = AddSystem(Child(root, "Motes"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = motes.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 2f;
            main.prewarm = true;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.6f, 1.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.11f);
            var rise = motes.velocityOverLifetime;
            rise.enabled = true;
            rise.space = ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local;
            rise.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, 0f);
            rise.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.25f, 0.55f);
            rise.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, 0f);
            main.startColor = NanoGlow;
            main.maxParticles = 80;
            Stream(motes, 40f);
            var shape = motes.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Circle;
            shape.radius = NanoFieldModelRadius;
            shape.radiusThickness = 1f;
            shape.rotation = new Vector3(90f, 0f, 0f); // 바닥에 눕힌 원 (속도는 위로)
            Fade(motes, NanoPale, NanoGlow);
            Shrink(motes, 1f, 0.3f);
        }
    }
}
