    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 이상효과 표시 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Status FX). 몬스터 몸통 가운데에서 1초 동안 재생하도록 만들고,
    // 정지 시간이 길면(생물 얼음·기계 감전 2초) TowerManager가 재생 속도를 늦춘다. 모두 파티클이라 스크립트 Update가 없다.
    //   얼음: 하얗게 번쩍인 뒤 얼음 껍질이 몸을 감싸고, 얼음 가시가 돋고, 발밑에 서리, 반짝임 → 끝에 얼음 조각이 튄다
    //   감전: 몸 둘레로 노랑·하늘색 전기 줄기가 지지직 튀고, 몸이 번쩍번쩍, 불꽃이 튄다
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string FrozenFxPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_StatusFrozen.prefab";
        public const string ShockedFxPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_StatusShocked.prefab";

        static readonly Color Ice = new Color(0.72f, 0.92f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color IceDeep = new Color(0.42f, 0.72f, 1f, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Status FX")]
        public static void BuildStatusFx()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var dot = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
            if (dot == null)
                dot = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var add = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, dot, true);
            var smoke = BuildMaterial(SmokeMatPath, dot, false);
            var chunk = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>(ChunkMatPath);       // 불투명 정점색 Unlit (화염 2단계 이펙트와 같은 재질)
            var shard = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Mesh>(StreakMeshPath);         // 길쭉한 마름모 = 얼음 결정
            if (chunk == null || shard == null)
            {
                BuildFlameTier2();
                chunk = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>(ChunkMatPath);
                shard = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Mesh>(StreakMeshPath);
            }
            Save("FX_StatusFrozen", FrozenFxPath, r => BuildFrozen(r, add, smoke, chunk, shard));
            var spark = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Mesh>(SparkMeshPath);           // 가는 막대 = 전기 조각
            Save("FX_StatusShocked", ShockedFxPath, r => BuildShocked(r, add, chunk, spark));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 이상효과 이펙트 2종 생성 (얼음·감전)");
        }

        // ---------- 얼음 ----------

        static void BuildFrozen(GameObject root, Material add, Material smoke, Material chunk, Mesh shard)
        {
            // 얼음 껍질: 몸을 감싸는 반투명 하늘색 덩어리, 1초 내내 유지 (루트)
            var shell = AddSystem(root, smoke, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = shell.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 1f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 0.95f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = new Color(0.62f, 0.86f, 1f, 0.85f);
            main.maxParticles = 4;
            Burst(shell, 3, 3);
            Sphere(shell, 0.08f);
            HoldFade(shell, new Color(0.85f, 0.97f, 1f), Ice);

            // 얼음 결정: 몸을 둘러싼 저폴리 얼음 덩어리 (불투명, 하늘색~흰색). 돋아난 뒤 그대로 있다가 끝에 줄어든다
            var crystals = AddSystem(Child(root, "Crystals"), chunk, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Mesh, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            crystals.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().mesh = shard;
            crystals.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().alignment = ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Local;
            main = crystals.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 1f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.45f, 0.75f);
            main.startRotation3D = true;
            main.startRotationX = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-0.6f, 0.6f);
            main.startRotationY = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startRotationZ = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-0.6f, 0.6f);
            main.startColor = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(new Color(0.75f, 0.93f, 1f), new Color(0.5f, 0.8f, 1f));
            main.maxParticles = 12;
            Burst(crystals, 9, 11);
            Sphere(crystals, 0.2f);
            var cgrow = crystals.sizeOverLifetime;
            cgrow.enabled = true;
            cgrow.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0f), new Keyframe(0.1f, 1.1f), new Keyframe(0.16f, 1f), new Keyframe(0.88f, 1f), new Keyframe(1f, 0f)));

            // 얼음 가시: 몸에서 바깥으로 뾰족하게 돋아 그대로 멈춘다
            var spikes = AddSystem(Child(root, "Spikes"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var sr = spikes.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            sr.velocityScale = 0f;
            sr.lengthScale = 4f;
            main = spikes.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 1f;
            main.startSpeed = 0.02f; // 방향만 (늘어나는 쪽)
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.12f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 16;
            Burst(spikes, 12, 14);
            Sphere(spikes, 0.2f);
            HoldFade(spikes, FrostCore, Ice);
            var grow = spikes.sizeOverLifetime;
            grow.enabled = true;
            grow.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0.2f), new Keyframe(0.12f, 1.1f), new Keyframe(0.2f, 1f), new Keyframe(1f, 1f)));

            // 발밑 서리: 바닥에 눕힌 하얀 원 (몸통 가운데 기준 아래)
            var floor = AddSystem(Child(root, "FloorFrost"), smoke, ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            floor.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, -0.22f, 0f);
            main = floor.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 1f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = 1.1f;
            main.startColor = new Color(0.85f, 0.95f, 1f, 0.85f);
            main.maxParticles = 1;
            Burst(floor, 1, 1);
            NoShape(floor);
            HoldFade(floor, new Color(0.92f, 0.98f, 1f), Ice);

            // 처음: 하얀 번쩍임
            var flash = AddSystem(Child(root, "Flash"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 0.15f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = 0.8f;
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 1;
            Burst(flash, 1, 1);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, FrostCore, Frost);

            // 반짝임
            var glints = AddSystem(Child(root, "Glints"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = glints.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.15f, 0.3f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.03f, 0.06f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 12;
            Stream(glints, 18f);
            Sphere(glints, 0.25f);
            Fade(glints, FrostCore, Ice);

            // 끝: 얼음이 깨지며 조각이 튄다
            var chips = AddSystem(Child(root, "Shatter"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var cr = chips.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            cr.velocityScale = 0.04f;
            cr.lengthScale = 1.2f;
            main = chips.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startDelay = 0.9f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.25f, 0.4f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, 2.2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.03f, 0.06f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.gravityModifier = 1.2f;
            main.maxParticles = 16;
            Burst(chips, 10, 14);
            Sphere(chips, 0.2f);
            Fade(chips, FrostCore, IceDeep);
        }

        // 1초 동안 거의 그대로 보이다가 끝에서 사라짐 (얼음은 정지 시간 내내 보여야 한다)
        static void HoldFade(ParticleSystem ps, Color start, Color end)
        {
            var color = ps.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(start, 0f), new GradientColorKey(end, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0.06f), new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0.85f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            color.color = g;
        }

        // ---------- 감전 ----------

        static void BuildShocked(GameObject root, Material add, Material chunk, Mesh spark)
        {
            // 몸이 번쩍번쩍 (루트)
            var glow = AddSystem(root, add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = glow.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.09f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.7f, 1f);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.maxParticles = 4;
            Stream(glow, 18f);
            NoShape(glow);
            Fade(glow, VoltCore, Volt);

            // 전기 조각: 불투명한 노랑·하늘색 막대가 몸 둘레에서 지그재그로 튄다 (밝은 바닥에서도 보이게)
            var bolts = AddSystem(Child(root, "Bolts"), chunk, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Mesh, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var br = bolts.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            br.mesh = spark;
            br.alignment = ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Velocity;
            main = bolts.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.11f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.6f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.3f);
            main.startColor = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(new Color(1f, 0.95f, 0.35f), new Color(0.55f, 0.9f, 1f));
            main.maxParticles = 12;
            Stream(bolts, 60f);
            Sphere(bolts, 0.22f);
            Noise(bolts, 2f, 8f);

            // 전기 줄기: 몸 둘레에서 짧게 꺾이며 튄다 (노랑, 가끔 하늘색)
            var arcs = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = arcs.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.14f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.6f);
            main.startSize = 0.03f;
            main.startColor = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(Volt, VoltBlue);
            main.maxParticles = 24;
            Stream(arcs, 60f);
            Sphere(arcs, 0.22f);
            Noise(arcs, 2.5f, 6f);
            VoltTrail(arcs, add, 0.05f);

            // 불꽃: 몸에서 튀어 떨어진다
            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var sr = sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            sr.velocityScale = 0.04f;
            sr.lengthScale = 1f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.15f, 0.3f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, 2.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.02f, 0.035f);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.gravityModifier = 0.8f;
            main.maxParticles = 16;
            Stream(sparks, 20f);
            Sphere(sparks, 0.2f);
            Fade(sparks, VoltCore, Volt);

            // 발밑에 지지직 원
            var ring = AddSystem(Child(root, "FloorGlow"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            ring.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, -0.22f, 0f);
            main = ring.main;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.15f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.6f, 0.8f);
            main.startColor = new Color(1f, 0.9f, 0.4f, 0.6f);
            main.maxParticles = 3;
            Stream(ring, 10f);
            NoShape(ring);
            Fade(ring, Volt, VoltBlue);
        }
    }
}

    using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 2단계 타워 이펙트 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Tier2 FX). 모두 파티클이라 스크립트 Update가 없다.
    //   미니건 : 가벼운 총구 섬광(연기 없음, 초당 5발이라) / 노란 예광탄 / 작은 불티
    //   전기   : 노랑·하늘색 전기 섬광 / 지지직 플라즈마 구슬 / 맞은 자리 전기 폭발
    //   냉기   : 서리 안개가 뿜어지는 총구 / 얼음 조각 탄 + 눈가루 꼬리 / 맞은 자리 얼음 파편과 냉기 고리
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        public const string MinigunFlashPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_MinigunFlash.prefab";
        public const string MinigunTracerPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_MinigunTracer.prefab";
        public const string MinigunHitPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_MinigunHit.prefab";
        public const string ElectroMuzzlePath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_ElectroMuzzle.prefab";
        public const string ElectroBoltPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_ElectroBolt.prefab";
        public const string ElectroHitPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_ElectroHit.prefab";
        public const string CryoMuzzlePath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_CryoMuzzle.prefab";
        public const string CryoShardPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_CryoShard.prefab";
        public const string CryoHitPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_CryoHit.prefab";

        static readonly Color TracerCore = new Color(1f, 0.95f, 0.7f, 1f);
        static readonly Color TracerHot = new Color(1f, 0.7f, 0.25f, 1f);
        static readonly Color VoltCore = new Color(1f, 0.98f, 0.8f, 1f);
        static readonly Color Volt = new Color(1f, 0.88f, 0.3f, 1f);   // 노란 전기
        static readonly Color VoltBlue = new Color(0.45f, 0.85f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color FrostCore = new Color(0.92f, 0.98f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color Frost = new Color(0.55f, 0.88f, 1f, 1f);
        static readonly Color FrostDeep = new Color(0.35f, 0.6f, 1f, 1f);

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Tier2 FX")]
        public static void BuildTier2()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var dot = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
            if (dot == null)
                dot = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var add = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, dot, true);
            var smoke = BuildMaterial(SmokeMatPath, dot, false);

            Save("FX_MinigunFlash", MinigunFlashPath, r => BuildMinigunFlash(r, add));
            Save("FX_MinigunTracer", MinigunTracerPath, r => BuildTracer(r, add));
            Save("FX_MinigunHit", MinigunHitPath, r => BuildBulletHit(r, add));
            Save("FX_ElectroMuzzle", ElectroMuzzlePath, r => BuildVoltBurst(r, add, 0.5f, 6));
            Save("FX_ElectroBolt", ElectroBoltPath, r => BuildVoltBolt(r, add));
            Save("FX_ElectroHit", ElectroHitPath, r => BuildVoltBurst(r, add, 0.75f, 10));
            Save("FX_CryoMuzzle", CryoMuzzlePath, r => BuildCryoMuzzle(r, add, smoke));
            Save("FX_CryoShard", CryoShardPath, r => BuildCryoShard(r, add, smoke));
            Save("FX_CryoHit", CryoHitPath, r => BuildCryoHit(r, add, smoke));
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] 2단계 타워 이펙트 9종 생성");
        }

        // ---------- 미니건 ----------

        static void BuildMinigunFlash(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.05f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.03f, 0.05f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.22f, 0.3f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = TracerCore;
            main.maxParticles = 3;
            Burst(flash, 1, 2);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, TracerCore, TracerHot);

            var tongue = AddSystem(Child(root, "Tongue"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var tr = tongue.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            tr.velocityScale = 0.05f;
            tr.lengthScale = 2f;
            main = tongue.main;
            main.duration = 0.05f;
            main.startLifetime = 0.04f;
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(3f, 4.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.14f);
            main.startColor = TracerHot;
            main.maxParticles = 4;
            Burst(tongue, 2, 3);
            Cone(tongue, 6f, 0.01f);
            Fade(tongue, TracerCore, TracerHot);

            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.03f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 0.05f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.16f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(2f, 4f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.025f);
            main.startColor = TracerHot;
            main.gravityModifier = 0.5f;
            main.maxParticles = 8;
            Burst(sparks, 2, 4);
            Cone(sparks, 25f, 0.01f);
        }

        // 예광탄: 노랗게 빛나는 짧은 줄 (투사체 표시, 계속 재생)
        static void BuildTracer(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var head = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = head.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = 0.04f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.09f, 0.12f);
            main.startColor = TracerCore;
            main.maxParticles = 6;
            Stream(head, 80f);
            NoShape(head);

            var trail = AddSystem(Child(root, "Trail"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = trail.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.08f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.04f, 0.06f);
            main.startColor = TracerHot;
            main.maxParticles = 60;
            var emission = trail.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 80f;
            NoShape(trail);
            Fade(trail, TracerCore, TracerHot);
            Shrink(trail, 1f, 0.2f);
        }

        static void BuildBulletHit(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var sparks = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.03f;
            var main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.16f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.5f, 3f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.03f);
            main.startColor = TracerHot;
            main.gravityModifier = 0.6f;
            main.maxParticles = 10;
            Burst(sparks, 4, 7);
            Sphere(sparks, 0.03f);
            Fade(sparks, TracerCore, TracerHot);

            var puff = AddSystem(Child(root, "Puff"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = puff.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = 0.06f;
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.14f, 0.2f);
            main.startColor = TracerCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(puff, 1, 1);
            NoShape(puff);
            Fade(puff, TracerCore, TracerHot);
        }

        // ---------- 전기 ----------

        // 노랑·하늘 전기 섬광 + 꺾인 전기 줄기 (총구 섬광과 명중 폭발 공용, size·arcs로 크기 조절)
        static void BuildVoltBurst(GameObject root, Material mat, float size, int arcs)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(size * 0.85f, size);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.maxParticles = 3;
            Burst(flash, 1, 2);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, VoltCore, Volt);
            Shrink(flash, 1f, 0.3f);
            AddElectricLight(root, flash, 3.5f);

            var a = AddSystem(Child(root, "Arcs"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = a.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.15f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.8f, 3.2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.012f, 0.02f);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.maxParticles = arcs + 4;
            Burst(a, (short)arcs, (short)(arcs + 2));
            Sphere(a, 0.05f);
            VoltTrail(a, mat, 0.03f);
            Noise(a, 3f, 10f);

            var sparks = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            sparks.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.03f;
            main = sparks.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.22f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.5f, 3.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.015f, 0.03f);
            main.startColor = VoltBlue;
            main.maxParticles = 20;
            Burst(sparks, 8, 14);
            Sphere(sparks, 0.04f);
            Fade(sparks, VoltCore, VoltBlue);
        }

        // 플라즈마 구슬: 노란 심 + 둘레 지지직 + 지나간 자리 꼬리 (투사체 표시)
        static void BuildVoltBolt(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var core = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = core.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.08f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.26f, 0.34f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.maxParticles = 10;
            Stream(core, 60f);
            NoShape(core);
            Fade(core, VoltCore, Volt);
            AddElectricLight(root, core, 2.5f);

            var crackle = AddSystem(Child(root, "Crackle"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            main = crackle.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.2f, 2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.01f, 0.018f);
            main.startColor = VoltCore;
            main.maxParticles = 30;
            Stream(crackle, 70f);
            Sphere(crackle, 0.06f);
            VoltTrail(crackle, mat, 0.022f);
            Noise(crackle, 2.5f, 12f);

            var tail = AddSystem(Child(root, "Tail"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = tail.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.18f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.07f, 0.11f);
            main.startColor = Volt;
            main.maxParticles = 100;
            var emission = tail.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 70f;
            NoShape(tail);
            Fade(tail, VoltCore, Volt); // 노랑끼리 (노랑+파랑은 섞여 탁한 초록이 된다)
            Shrink(tail, 1f, 0.15f);
            Noise(tail, 0.5f, 12f);
        }

        // 노랑 → 하늘 전기 줄기 트레일
        static void VoltTrail(ParticleSystem ps, Material mat, float width)
        {
            ElectricTrail(ps, mat, width, 1f);
            var trails = ps.trails;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(VoltCore, 0f), new GradientColorKey(Volt, 0.5f), new GradientColorKey(VoltBlue, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            trails.colorOverTrail = g;
        }

        // ---------- 냉기 ----------

        // 총구: 하얀 서리 안개가 앞으로 뿜어지고 얼음 가루가 반짝인다 (원점 = 총구, +Z = 발사 방향)
        static void BuildCryoMuzzle(GameObject root, Material add, Material smoke)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.12f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.07f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.35f, 0.45f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(flash, 1, 1);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, FrostCore, Frost);
            Shrink(flash, 1f, 0.4f);

            var mist = AddSystem(Child(root, "Mist"), smoke, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = mist.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.35f, 0.6f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.6f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.15f, 0.25f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = new Color(0.88f, 0.96f, 1f, 0.75f);
            main.maxParticles = 14;
            Burst(mist, 6, 9);
            Cone(mist, 18f, 0.02f);
            var limit = mist.limitVelocityOverLifetime;
            limit.enabled = true;
            limit.limit = 0.2f;
            limit.dampen = 0.3f;
            var grow = mist.sizeOverLifetime;
            grow.enabled = true;
            grow.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 0.6f), new Keyframe(1f, 2.4f)));
            FadeSoft(mist, new Color(0.9f, 0.97f, 1f), new Color(0.75f, 0.88f, 1f));

            var glints = AddSystem(Child(root, "Glints"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = glints.main;
            main.duration = 0.12f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.2f, 0.4f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 2.2f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.02f, 0.04f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 16;
            Burst(glints, 8, 12);
            Cone(glints, 25f, 0.02f);
            Fade(glints, FrostCore, Frost);
        }

        // 얼음 탄: 하얀 심 + 둘레 서리빛 + 눈가루 꼬리 (투사체 표시)
        static void BuildCryoShard(GameObject root, Material add, Material smoke)
        {
            var core = AddSystem(root, add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = core.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.1f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.2f, 0.26f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 10;
            Stream(core, 50f);
            NoShape(core);
            Fade(core, FrostCore, Frost);

            var snow = AddSystem(Child(root, "Snow"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = snow.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.25f, 0.45f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, 0.25f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.02f, 0.04f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.gravityModifier = 0.15f;
            main.maxParticles = 80;
            var emission = snow.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 45f;
            Sphere(snow, 0.05f);
            Fade(snow, FrostCore, Frost);

            var vapor = AddSystem(Child(root, "Vapor"), smoke, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = vapor.main;
            main.loop = true;
            main.playOnAwake = true;
            main.duration = 1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.18f, 0.3f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.1f, 0.16f);
            main.startColor = new Color(0.85f, 0.95f, 1f, 0.55f);
            main.maxParticles = 60;
            emission = vapor.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            emission.rateOverDistance = 25f;
            NoShape(vapor);
            FadeSoft(vapor, new Color(0.9f, 0.97f, 1f), new Color(0.7f, 0.85f, 1f));
        }

        // 명중: 얼음 파편이 튀고 바닥에 냉기 고리가 퍼진다
        static void BuildCryoHit(GameObject root, Material add, Material smoke)
        {
            var flash = AddSystem(root, add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = flash.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.08f, 0.12f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.5f, 0.65f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.maxParticles = 2;
            Burst(flash, 1, 1);
            NoShape(flash);
            Fade(flash, FrostCore, Frost);

            var shards = AddSystem(Child(root, "Shards"), add, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            shards.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>().velocityScale = 0.04f;
            main = shards.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.2f, 0.4f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1.5f, 3f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.03f, 0.05f);
            main.startColor = FrostCore;
            main.gravityModifier = 0.8f;
            main.maxParticles = 20;
            Burst(shards, 10, 14);
            Sphere(shards, 0.05f);
            Fade(shards, FrostCore, FrostDeep);

            var ring = AddSystem(Child(root, "ColdRing"), smoke, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            main = ring.main;
            main.duration = 0.15f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.35f, 0.55f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.3f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.12f, 0.2f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = new Color(0.88f, 0.96f, 1f, 0.7f);
            main.maxParticles = 20;
            Burst(ring, 12, 16);
            FlatCircle(ring, 0.05f);
            var limit = ring.limitVelocityOverLifetime;
            limit.enabled = true;
            limit.limit = 0.2f;
            limit.dampen = 0.25f;
            FadeSoft(ring, new Color(0.9f, 0.97f, 1f), new Color(0.7f, 0.85f, 1f));
        }

        // 안개용: 서서히 나타났다 사라지는 반투명
        static void FadeSoft(ParticleSystem ps, Color start, Color end)
        {
            var color = ps.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var g = new Gradient();
            g.SetKeys(new[] { new GradientColorKey(start, 0f), new GradientColorKey(end, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.8f, 0.15f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.4f, 0.6f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            color.color = g;
        }
    }
}

    using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

namespace TowerDefence.EditorTools
{
    // 총구 발사 이펙트 프리팹을 만든다 (메뉴: TowerDefence/Build Muzzle FX).
    // 실제 총 발사 때 보이는 현상만: 총구 섬광(+ 순간 조명), 앞으로 뿜는 화염, 불티, 화약 연기.
    // 프리팹 원점 = 총구 끝, +Z = 포신 방향. 파티클 시스템은 엔진이 돌리므로 스크립트 Update가 없다.
    public static partial class MuzzleFxBuilder
    {
        const string ArtFolder = "Assets/Art/FX";
        const string PrefabFolder = "Assets/Prefabs/FX";
        const string TexturePath = ArtFolder + "/FX_SoftDot.png";
        const string AdditiveMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_Additive.mat";
        const string SmokeMatPath = ArtFolder + "/FX_Smoke.mat";
        public const string PrefabPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_MuzzleFlash.prefab";

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Muzzle FX")]
        public static void Build()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Art");
            EnsureFolder(ArtFolder);
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);

            var texture = BuildSoftDotTexture();
            var additive = BuildMaterial(AdditiveMatPath, texture, true);
            var smoke = BuildMaterial(SmokeMatPath, texture, false);

            var root = new GameObject("FX_MuzzleFlash");
            try
            {
                var flash = AddFlash(root, additive);
                AddFlame(root, additive);
                AddSparks(root, additive);
                AddSmoke(root, smoke);
                AddFlashLight(root, flash);
                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, PrefabPath);
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            }
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] " + PrefabPath + " 생성");
        }

        // --- 화염방사 타워: FX_FlameSpray90 모델 (90° 부채꼴 불길) ---
        // 모델 구성: 불꽃 조각 3종(Chunk_Core 노랑 / Mid 주황 / Outer 빨강, 각자 재질) + 범위 안내 호(Shape_Core/Mid/Outer).
        // 안내 호의 반지름(약 0.1 / 1.0 / 2.28)과 90° 폭대로, 노즐에서 조각을 뿜어 안쪽은 노랑·가운데는 주황·끝은 빨강이 되게 한다.
        // 프리팹 원점 = 노즐, +Z = 뿜는 방향. 길이는 모델 단위 2.28 (TowerDef.coneFxReach) → 게임에서 coneLength에 맞춰 크기를 정한다.
        // 한 번 발사(0.2초 간격) 동안 이어서 뿜으므로 연달아 쏘면 끊기지 않는 불길이 된다.

        const string FlameSprayModelPath = "Assets/Models/FX/FX_FlameSpray90.fbx";
        public const string FlamePrefabPath = PrefabFolder + "/FX_FlameSpray90.prefab";
        const float FlameArc = 90f;         // 부채꼴 각도 (히트박스 coneAngle과 같게)
        const float FlameGravity = 0.6f;    // 날아가며 바닥 쪽으로 처져 끝이 바닥 히트박스에 닿게

        [MenuItem("TowerDefence/Build Flame Spray FX")]
        public static void BuildFlameSpray()
        {
            EnsureFolder("Assets/Prefabs");
            EnsureFolder(PrefabFolder);
            var model = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(FlameSprayModelPath);
            if (model == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("[MuzzleFxBuilder] " + FlameSprayModelPath + " 없음");
                return;
            }

            var root = new GameObject("FX_FlameSpray90");
            try
            {
                // 노즐 가까이: 노랑 (안쪽 호까지 ~1.0)
                var core = AddChunkStream(root, model, "Chunk_Core", 0.16f, 0.22f, 4.5f, 5.5f, 0.7f, 1.0f, 70f);
                SizeCurve(core, 0.6f, 1.3f, 1.1f);
                // 가운데: 주황 (~1.75)
                var mid = AddChunkStream(Child(root, "Mid"), model, "Chunk_Mid", 0.24f, 0.3f, 5.5f, 6.5f, 1.0f, 1.4f, 55f);
                SizeCurve(mid, 0.7f, 1.5f, 1.0f);
                // 끝: 빨강, 바깥 호(~2.28)에서 사그라짐
                var outer = AddChunkStream(Child(root, "Outer"), model, "Chunk_Outer", 0.32f, 0.38f, 6.0f, 6.6f, 1.3f, 1.8f, 45f);
                SizeCurve(outer, 0.6f, 1.4f, 0.15f);
                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, FlamePrefabPath);
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            }
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Debug.Log("[MuzzleFxBuilder] " + FlamePrefabPath + " 생성");
        }

        // 모델의 불꽃 조각 메시를 그 재질 그대로 파티클로 뿜는다 (90° 부채꼴, 위아래 얇게, 이리저리 굴러가며).
        static ParticleSystem AddChunkStream(GameObject go, GameObject model, string chunk, float lifeMin, float lifeMax,
            float speedMin, float speedMax, float sizeMin, float sizeMax, float perSecond)
        {
            Renderer source = null;
            foreach (var r in model.GetComponentsInChildren<MeshRenderer>(true))
                if (r.name.EndsWith(chunk))
                    source = r;
            var ps = AddSystem(go, source != null ? source.sharedMaterial : null, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Mesh, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var renderer = go.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            if (source != null)
                renderer.mesh = source.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().sharedMesh;
            renderer.alignment = ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Local;

            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(lifeMin, lifeMax);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(speedMin, speedMax);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(sizeMin, sizeMax);
            main.startRotation3D = true;
            main.startRotationX = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startRotationY = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startRotationZ = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.maxParticles = 30;
            Stream(ps, perSecond);

            // 평평한 90° 호에서 바깥으로: 각도마다 고르게 퍼진다 (원뿔은 가운데로 몰림).
            // 원(XY 평면, +X에서 시작하는 호)을 눕히고(X 90°) 호 가운데가 +Z(뿜는 방향)에 오게 돌린다(Y −45°).
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Circle;
            shape.arc = FlameArc;
            shape.arcMode = ParticleSystemShapeMultiModeValue.Random;
            shape.radius = 0.03f;
            shape.rotation = new Vector3(90f, -FlameArc * 0.5f, 0f);
            shape.randomDirectionAmount = 0.08f;
            main.gravityModifier = FlameGravity;

            var spin = ps.rotationOverLifetime;
            spin.enabled = true;
            spin.separateAxes = true;
            spin.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-6f, 6f);
            spin.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-6f, 6f);
            spin.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-6f, 6f);
            return ps;
        }

        // 크기 변화: 시작 → 중간 → 끝
        static void SizeCurve(ParticleSystem ps, float start, float middle, float end)
        {
            var size = ps.sizeOverLifetime;
            size.enabled = true;
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(
                new Keyframe(0f, start), new Keyframe(0.55f, middle), new Keyframe(1f, end)));
        }

        // 1) 총구 섬광: 아주 짧고 밝은 빛 덩어리 (루트 시스템, 자식까지 함께 재생)
        static ParticleSystem AddFlash(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(root, mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.06f, 0.08f);
            main.startSpeed = 0f;
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.45f, 0.6f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = new Color(1f, 0.92f, 0.65f, 1f);
            main.maxParticles = 4;
            Burst(ps, 2, 3);
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = false;
            Fade(ps, new Color(1f, 0.95f, 0.75f), new Color(1f, 0.55f, 0.15f));
            Shrink(ps, 1f, 0.3f);
            return ps;
        }

        // 2) 화염: 포신 방향으로 길게 뿜어지는 불꽃
        static void AddFlame(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(Child(root, "Flame"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.Local);
            var renderer = ps.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            renderer.velocityScale = 0.05f;
            renderer.lengthScale = 2.5f;
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.1f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.08f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(3f, 5.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.16f, 0.24f);
            main.startColor = new Color(1f, 0.75f, 0.3f, 1f);
            main.maxParticles = 8;
            Burst(ps, 4, 6);
            Cone(ps, 7f, 0.01f);
            Fade(ps, new Color(1f, 0.85f, 0.45f), new Color(1f, 0.35f, 0.05f));
            Shrink(ps, 1f, 0.2f);
        }

        // 3) 불티: 앞으로 튀어 나가 떨어지는 작은 불꽃 입자
        static void AddSparks(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(Child(root, "Sparks"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var renderer = ps.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            renderer.velocityScale = 0.04f;
            renderer.lengthScale = 1f;
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.3f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.15f, 0.35f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(2.5f, 6f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.025f, 0.045f);
            main.startColor = new Color(1f, 0.7f, 0.25f, 1f);
            main.gravityModifier = 0.6f;
            main.maxParticles = 20;
            Burst(ps, 8, 14);
            Cone(ps, 22f, 0.01f);
            Fade(ps, new Color(1f, 0.85f, 0.4f), new Color(1f, 0.3f, 0.05f));
        }

        // 4) 화약 연기: 회색 연기가 천천히 퍼지며 위로 흩어진다
        static void AddSmoke(GameObject root, Material mat)
        {
            var ps = AddSystem(Child(root, "Smoke"), mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World);
            var main = ps.main;
            main.duration = 0.2f;
            main.startDelay = 0.02f;
            main.startLifetime = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.8f, 1.3f);
            main.startSpeed = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.15f, 0.5f);
            main.startSize = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.22f, 0.32f);
            main.startRotation = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            main.startColor = new Color(0.82f, 0.82f, 0.8f, 0.85f);
            main.gravityModifier = -0.04f; // 천천히 떠오름
            main.maxParticles = 12;
            Burst(ps, 4, 6);
            Cone(ps, 18f, 0.02f);

            var velocity = ps.velocityOverLifetime;
            velocity.enabled = true;
            velocity.space = ParticleSystemSimulationSpace.World;
            velocity.x = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-0.05f, 0.05f);
            velocity.y = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(0.05f, 0.15f);
            velocity.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-0.05f, 0.05f);

            var limit = ps.limitVelocityOverLifetime; // 처음엔 빠르게 밀려나다 금방 느려진다
            limit.enabled = true;
            limit.limit = 0.25f;
            limit.dampen = 0.35f;

            var rotation = ps.rotationOverLifetime;
            rotation.enabled = true;
            rotation.z = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(-0.8f, 0.8f);

            var color = ps.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var gradient = new Gradient();
            gradient.SetKeys(
                new[] { new GradientColorKey(new Color(0.95f, 0.93f, 0.9f), 0f), new GradientColorKey(new Color(0.72f, 0.72f, 0.72f), 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.85f, 0.08f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.45f, 0.55f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            color.color = gradient;

            var size = ps.sizeOverLifetime; // 퍼지면서 커진다
            size.enabled = true;
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, 1f), new Keyframe(1f, 4.5f)));
        }

        // 섬광 순간 조명: 섬광 입자에 붙어 주변을 짧게 밝힌다 (Lights 모듈)
        static void AddFlashLight(GameObject root, ParticleSystem flash)
        {
            var lightGo = Child(root, "FlashLightTemplate");
            var light = lightGo.AddComponent<Light>();
            light.type = LightType.Point;
            light.color = new Color(1f, 0.75f, 0.4f);
            light.range = 2f;
            light.intensity = 4f;
            light.shadows = LightShadows.None;
            // URP 조명 데이터를 미리 붙인다. 없으면 파티클이 만든 조명이 처음 그려질 때마다 URP가 AddComponent를 해서
            // 웨이브 중 GC 할당이 생긴다 (작업 10 프로파일 측정: 이펙트 인스턴스마다 1번씩).
            lightGo.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal.UniversalAdditionalLightData>();
            lightGo.SetActive(false); // 템플릿: 실제 조명은 파티클이 살아 있는 동안만 생긴다

            var lights = flash.lights;
            lights.enabled = true;
            lights.light = light;
            lights.ratio = 1f;
            lights.maxLights = 1;
            lights.useParticleColor = false;
            lights.sizeAffectsRange = false;
            lights.alphaAffectsIntensity = true;
            lights.intensityMultiplier = 1f;
            lights.rangeMultiplier = 1f;
        }

        // --- 도우미 ---

        static ParticleSystem AddSystem(GameObject go, Material mat, ParticleSystemRenderMode mode, ParticleSystemSimulationSpace space)
        {
            var ps = go.AddComponent<ParticleSystem>();
            ps.Stop(true, ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingAndClear);
            var main = ps.main;
            main.playOnAwake = false;
            main.loop = false;
            main.simulationSpace = space;
            main.scalingMode = ParticleSystemScalingMode.Hierarchy;
            var emission = ps.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = 0f;
            var renderer = go.GetComponent<ParticleSystemRenderer>();
            renderer.renderMode = mode;
            renderer.sharedMaterial = mat;
            renderer.shadowCastingMode = ShadowCastingMode.Off;
            renderer.receiveShadows = false;
            return ps;
        }

        static GameObject Child(GameObject root, string name)
        {
            var go = new GameObject(name);
            go.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
            return go;
        }

        static void Burst(ParticleSystem ps, int min, int max)
        {
            var emission = ps.emission;
            emission.SetBursts(new[] { new ParticleSystem.Burst(0f, (short)min, (short)max) });
        }

        static void Stream(ParticleSystem ps, float perSecond)
        {
            var emission = ps.emission;
            emission.rateOverTime = perSecond;
        }

        static void Cone(ParticleSystem ps, float angle, float radius)
        {
            var shape = ps.shape;
            shape.enabled = true;
            shape.shapeType = ParticleSystemShapeType.Cone;
            shape.angle = angle;
            shape.radius = radius;
        }

        static void Fade(ParticleSystem ps, Color start, Color end)
        {
            var color = ps.colorOverLifetime;
            color.enabled = true;
            var gradient = new Gradient();
            gradient.SetKeys(
                new[] { new GradientColorKey(start, 0f), new GradientColorKey(end, 1f) },
                new[] { new GradientAlphaKey(1f, 0f), new GradientAlphaKey(0.8f, 0.4f), new GradientAlphaKey(0f, 1f) });
            color.color = gradient;
        }

        static void Shrink(ParticleSystem ps, float from, float to)
        {
            var size = ps.sizeOverLifetime;
            size.enabled = true;
            size.size = new ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve(1f, new AnimationCurve(new Keyframe(0f, from), new Keyframe(1f, to)));
        }

        // 가운데가 밝고 가장자리로 부드럽게 사라지는 원형 텍스처 (섬광·불티·연기 공용)
        static Texture2D BuildSoftDotTexture()
        {
            const int size = 64;
            var tex = new Texture2D(size, size, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
            for (int y = 0; y < size; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < size; x++)
                {
                    float dx = (x + 0.5f) / size * 2f - 1f;
                    float dy = (y + 0.5f) / size * 2f - 1f;
                    float d = Mathf.Clamp01(Mathf.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy));
                    float a = Mathf.Pow(1f - d, 2.2f);
                    tex.SetPixel(x, y, new Color(1f, 1f, 1f, a));
                }
            }
            File.WriteAllBytes(TexturePath, tex.EncodeToPNG());
            Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(TexturePath);

            var importer = (TextureImporter)AssetImporter.GetAtPath(TexturePath);
            importer.textureType = TextureImporterType.Default;
            importer.alphaIsTransparency = true;
            importer.mipmapEnabled = true;
            importer.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
            importer.SaveAndReimport();
            return AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(TexturePath);
        }

        // URP 파티클 Unlit, 투명. additive = 빛(섬광·불꽃), 아니면 알파 블렌드(연기).
        static Material BuildMaterial(string path, Texture2D texture, bool additive)
        {
            var mat = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>(path);
            if (mat == null)
            {
                mat = new Material(Shader.Find("Universal Render Pipeline/Particles/Unlit"));
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(mat, path);
            }
            mat.SetTexture("_BaseMap", texture);
            mat.SetColor("_BaseColor", Color.white);
            mat.SetFloat("_Surface", 1f);                 // Transparent
            mat.SetFloat("_Blend", additive ? 2f : 0f);    // 2 = Additive, 0 = Alpha
            mat.SetFloat("_SrcBlend", (float)BlendMode.SrcAlpha);
            mat.SetFloat("_DstBlend", additive ? (float)BlendMode.One : (float)BlendMode.OneMinusSrcAlpha);
            mat.SetFloat("_SrcBlendAlpha", (float)BlendMode.One);
            mat.SetFloat("_DstBlendAlpha", additive ? (float)BlendMode.One : (float)BlendMode.OneMinusSrcAlpha);
            mat.SetFloat("_ZWrite", 0f);
            mat.EnableKeyword("_SURFACE_TYPE_TRANSPARENT");
            mat.SetOverrideTag("RenderType", "Transparent");
            mat.renderQueue = (int)RenderQueue.Transparent;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(mat);
            return mat;
        }

        static void EnsureFolder(string path)
        {
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(path))
                return;
            var parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(path).Replace('\\', '/');
            AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(parent, Path.GetFileName(path));
        }
    }
}
