    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 7: BuildController + MapView 오버레이 + 확인 팝업 (마우스 대신 PointAt/Click을 직접 호출).
    // 고정 7×7 맵: 부지 (2,0) (2,2) (6,4) …, 경로 (3,1), 부지 아님 (0,6)
    public class BuildControllerTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        MapProvider maps;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        GameFlow flow;
        BuildController build;
        GameUI ui;
        GameObject canvasGo;
        TowerDef basic;
        int modeEvents;

        static readonly Vector2Int SiteA = new Vector2Int(2, 0);
        static readonly Vector2Int SiteB = new Vector2Int(2, 2);
        static readonly Vector2Int PathCell = new Vector2Int(3, 1);
        static readonly Vector2Int EmptyCell = new Vector2Int(0, 6);

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            basic = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") },
                new[] { basic });

            maps = new MapProvider();
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            flow = new GameFlow { LogStates = false };
            build = new BuildController();
            ui = new GameUI();

            canvasGo = new GameObject("TestCanvas", typeof(Canvas), typeof(CanvasScaler));
            maps.Init(data, null, null);
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            flow.Init(data, maps, board, monsters, towers);
            build.Init(data, flow, board, towers, player, null);
            ui.Init(data, canvasGo.GetComponent<Canvas>(), board, build, flow, null, null, null);

            modeEvents = 0;
            flow.StateChanged += ui.HandleStateChanged;
            flow.StateChanged += build.HandleStateChanged;
            player.CashChanged += ui.HandleCashChanged;
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            towers.TowerChanged += ui.HandleTowerChanged;
            build.ModeChanged += ui.HandleModeChanged;
            build.ModeChanged += e => modeEvents++;
            build.HoverChanged += ui.HandleHoverChanged;
            build.SelectionChanged += ui.HandleSelectionChanged;
            build.PopupRequested += ui.HandlePopupRequested;

            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            maps.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            build.ResetForNewRun(run);
            ui.ResetForNewRun(run);
            flow.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            flow.RequestStartGame(); // Break: 건축 가능
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            Object.DestroyImmediate(canvasGo);
            var overlay = GameObject.Find("BuildOverlay");
            while (overlay != null)
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(overlay);
                overlay = GameObject.Find("BuildOverlay");
            }
        }

        GameObject PopupRoot => canvasGo.transform.Find("ConfirmPopup").gameObject;
        Button PopupLeft => canvasGo.transform.Find("ConfirmPopup/Left").GetComponent<Button>();
        string PopupMessage => canvasGo.transform.Find("ConfirmPopup/Message/Label").GetComponent<Text>().text;
        string PopupWarning => canvasGo.transform.Find("ConfirmPopup/Warning/Label").GetComponent<Text>().text;

        [Test]
        public void Gdd54_BuildProcedure_StaysInModeAfterBuild()
        {
            // 1. [타워 건축] → BuildMode
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Build, build.Mode);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, modeEvents);
            Assert.IsTrue(ui.Map.OverlayVisible, "2. 오버레이 표시");

            // 3. 설치 가능 칸 Hover, 4. 클릭 → 파랑 + 팝업
            build.PointAt(true, SiteA);
            build.Click(SiteA);
            Assert.IsTrue(build.HasSelection);
            Assert.AreEqual(SiteA, build.SelectedCell);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Build, build.Popup);
            Assert.IsTrue(PopupRoot.activeSelf);
            Assert.AreEqual("설치하시겠습니까?", PopupMessage);
            Assert.IsTrue(PopupLeft.interactable);

            // 4-1. [설치] → 캐시 차감, 타워, 파랑 제거, 모드 유지
            build.ConfirmPopup();
            Assert.IsNotNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
            Assert.AreEqual(50, player.Cash);
            Assert.IsFalse(build.HasSelection);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup);
            Assert.IsFalse(PopupRoot.activeSelf);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Build, build.Mode, "설치 후에도 BuildMode 유지");

            // 4-2. 다른 칸 클릭 → [취소] → 파랑 제거, 계속 선택
            build.Click(SiteB);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Build, build.Popup);
            build.CancelPopup();
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteB));
            Assert.IsFalse(build.HasSelection);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Build, build.Mode);
            Assert.AreEqual(50, player.Cash, "취소는 캐시 그대로");

            // 5. ESC(ExitMode) → 종료, 오버레이 제거
            build.ExitMode();
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.None, build.Mode);
            Assert.IsFalse(ui.Map.OverlayVisible);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, modeEvents);
        }

        [Test]
        public void BlockedCells_DoNotReact()
        {
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            build.Click(PathCell);
            build.Click(EmptyCell);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup, "경로·부지 아닌 칸은 반응 없음");
            Assert.IsFalse(build.HasSelection);

            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            build.Click(SiteA);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup, "타워가 있는 칸은 반응 없음");
        }

        [Test]
        public void NotEnoughCash_InstallDisabled_WithMessage()
        {
            player.Spend(70, CashReason.Build); // 30 남음 < 50
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            build.Click(SiteA);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Build, build.Popup);
            Assert.IsFalse(PopupLeft.interactable, "[설치] 비활성");
            Assert.AreEqual("캐시가 부족합니다", PopupWarning);

            // 실시간: 팝업이 열린 채 캐시가 늘면 다시 활성
            player.Earn(25, CashReason.Kill);
            Assert.IsTrue(PopupLeft.interactable);
            Assert.AreEqual("", PopupWarning);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Hover_RepaintsAtMostTwoCells()
        {
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            int afterEnter = ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites;
            Assert.AreEqual(49, afterEnter, "진입 때 1번 전체(7×7)");

            var path = new[]
            {
                new Vector2Int(0, 0), new Vector2Int(1, 0), new Vector2Int(2, 0), new Vector2Int(2, 1), new Vector2Int(3, 1),
                new Vector2Int(4, 1), new Vector2Int(4, 2), new Vector2Int(6, 6), new Vector2Int(0, 6),
            };
            int last = ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites;
            foreach (var cell in path)
            {
                build.PointAt(true, cell);
                int delta = ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites - last;
                Assert.LessOrEqual(delta, 2, $"{cell}로 이동 시 {delta}칸 갱신");
                last = ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites;

                build.PointAt(true, cell); // 같은 칸이면 갱신 없음
                Assert.AreEqual(last, ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites, "칸이 안 바뀌면 Hover 처리 없음");
            }

            build.PointAt(false, default); // 맵 밖·UI 위로
            Assert.LessOrEqual(ui.Map.OverlayCellWrites - last, 1);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Sell_PopupShowsRefund_ConfirmReturns35()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(SiteA, basic));
            Assert.AreEqual(50, player.Cash);

            build.Click(SiteA); // 일반 상태에서 타워 클릭
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Sell, build.Popup);
            Assert.AreEqual("판매하시겠습니까? (+35 캐시)", PopupMessage);

            build.ConfirmPopup();
            Assert.AreEqual(85, player.Cash, "+35");
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
            Assert.IsTrue(board.IsBuildable(SiteA));
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Sell_Cancel_KeepsTower()
        {
            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            build.Click(SiteA);
            build.CancelPopup();
            Assert.IsNotNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
            Assert.AreEqual(50, player.Cash);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClickOnEmptyCell_InNoneMode_DoesNothing()
        {
            build.Click(SiteA);
            build.Click(PathCell);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup);
        }

        [Test]
        public void GameOver_ClosesModeAndPopup()
        {
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            build.Click(SiteA);
            flow.StartNow();
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Build, build.Mode, "웨이브가 시작돼도 모드 유지 (실시간)");
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Build, build.Popup);

            player.TakeNexusDamage(100);
            flow.HandleDefeated();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.None, build.Mode);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup);
        }

        // ---------- 타워 목록 · 드래그 설치 · 이동 ----------

        [Test]
        public void DragNewTower_DropOnSite_BuildsWithoutPopup()
        {
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            int drags = 0;
            build.DragChanged += e => drags++;

            build.BeginNewTowerDrag(basic);
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.NewTower, build.Drag);
            build.PointAt(true, SiteA);
            build.Drop();

            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.None, build.Drag);
            Assert.IsNotNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA), "놓은 칸에 설치");
            Assert.AreEqual(config.startCash - basic.buildCost, player.Cash);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup, "드래그 설치는 확인 팝업 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Build, build.Mode, "연속 건축 가능");
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(drags, 3, "시작·칸 변경·끝");
        }

        [Test]
        public void DragNewTower_DropOnPathOrOffMap_Cancels()
        {
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            build.BeginNewTowerDrag(basic);
            build.PointAt(true, PathCell);
            build.Drop();
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(PathCell));

            build.BeginNewTowerDrag(basic);
            build.PointAt(false, default); // UI 위·맵 밖에서 놓음
            build.Drop();

            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.Towers.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(config.startCash, player.Cash, "캐시 그대로");
        }

        [Test]
        public void DragNewTower_NotEnoughCash_ShowsInvalid()
        {
            player.Spend(player.Cash - (basic.buildCost - 1), CashReason.Build);
            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            TowerDrag last = default;
            build.DragChanged += e => last = e;

            build.BeginNewTowerDrag(basic);
            build.PointAt(true, SiteA);
            Assert.IsFalse(last.Valid, "캐시 부족 → 빨강");
            build.Drop();
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DragNewTower_OnlyInBuildMode()
        {
            build.BeginNewTowerDrag(basic); // 일반 상태 (타워 목록이 없음)
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.None, build.Drag);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecoveryDrag_IconSlot_DropRebuildsForFree()
        {
            towers.RecoveryChanged += ui.HandleRecoveryChanged;
            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            towers.MoveAllTowersToRecovery(2); // 맵 교체처럼 회수 목록으로
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.GetRecoveryCount(basic));
            var slot = canvasGo.transform.Find("RecoveryPanel/Recovery_basic");
            Assert.IsNotNull(slot, "회수 목록 아이콘 칸");
            Assert.IsNotNull(slot.GetComponent<TowerSlot>(), "건축 목록처럼 끌 수 있다");
            int cash = player.Cash;

            build.BeginRecoveryDrag(basic);
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.Recovery, build.Drag);
            build.PointAt(true, PathCell);
            Assert.IsFalse(build.HasPreview, "경로 칸에는 못 놓는다");
            build.PointAt(true, SiteB);
            build.Drop();

            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.None, build.Drag);
            Assert.AreEqual(basic, towers.GetTowerAt(SiteB).Def, "놓은 칸에 재건축");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.GetRecoveryCount(basic), "목록에서 1개 차감");
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash, "재건축은 무료");
            Assert.IsFalse(slot.gameObject.activeSelf, "다 쓰면 칸이 숨는다");

            build.BeginRecoveryDrag(basic);
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.None, build.Drag, "남은 게 없으면 끌 수 없다");
        }

        [Test]
        public void MoveDrag_ToEmptySite_MovesTowerForFree()
        {
            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            var tower = towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA);
            int cash = player.Cash;

            build.BeginMoveDrag(tower);
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.MoveTower, build.Drag);
            build.PointAt(true, SiteB);
            build.Drop();

            Assert.AreEqual(SiteB, tower.Cell);
            Assert.AreSame(tower, towers.GetTowerAt(SiteB));
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
            Assert.IsTrue(board.IsOccupied(SiteB));
            Assert.IsFalse(board.IsOccupied(SiteA), "옛 칸 비움");
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash, "이동은 무료");

            // 사거리 칸을 새 위치 기준으로 다시 계산
            for (int i = 0; i < board.GetPathLength(0); i++)
            {
                var c = board.GetPathCell(0, i);
                bool inRange = Mathf.Max(Mathf.Abs(c.x - SiteB.x), Mathf.Abs(c.y - SiteB.y)) <= basic.range;
                Assert.AreEqual(inRange, tower.CoversCell[board.CellId(c)], $"경로 칸 {i}");
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void MoveDrag_ToBlockedCellOrSameCell_KeepsPosition()
        {
            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            towers.Build(SiteB, basic);
            var tower = towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA);
            TowerDrag last = default;
            build.DragChanged += e => last = e;

            build.BeginMoveDrag(tower);
            build.PointAt(true, SiteB);  // 다른 타워가 있는 칸
            Assert.IsFalse(last.Valid);
            build.PointAt(true, PathCell);
            Assert.IsFalse(last.Valid);
            build.PointAt(true, SiteA);  // 제자리
            Assert.IsTrue(last.Valid, "제자리는 그대로 두기");
            build.PointAt(true, PathCell);
            build.Drop();

            Assert.AreEqual(SiteA, tower.Cell);
            Assert.IsTrue(board.IsOccupied(SiteA));
        }

        [Test]
        public void MoveDrag_CancelledWhenLeavingBreakOrWave()
        {
            towers.Build(SiteA, basic);
            build.BeginMoveDrag(towers.GetTowerAt(SiteA));
            build.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(DragKind.None, build.Drag);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Palette_SlidesInOnlyInBuildMode_InfoShowsDef()
        {
            var palette = ui.Palette.Root;
            var hidden = palette.anchoredPosition;
            Assert.AreEqual(1, ui.Palette.SlotCount);
            Assert.IsNotNull(palette.Find("Slot_basic/Name"), "아이콘 아래 이름");
            Assert.AreEqual($"{basic.buildCost} 캐시", palette.Find("Slot_basic/Cost").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);

            build.EnterBuildMode(basic);
            ui.Tick(1f);
            Assert.Greater(palette.anchoredPosition.y, hidden.y, "건축 모드: 타워 목록이 올라옴");

            palette.Find("Slot_basic").GetComponent<TowerSlot>().Clicked(basic);
            Assert.IsTrue(ui.Info.Visible);
            Assert.AreSame(basic, ui.Info.Shown);
            string title = canvasGo.transform.Find("TowerInfo/Title").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text;
            Assert.AreEqual(basic.displayName, title);

            build.ExitMode();
            ui.Tick(1f);
            Assert.AreEqual(hidden, palette.anchoredPosition, "나가면 다시 숨음");
            Assert.IsFalse(ui.Info.Visible, "정보 패널도 닫힘");
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 화염방사 범위 공격: 조준 방향 90° 부채꼴(길이 coneLength) 히트박스 안의 몬스터 모두에게 피해.
    public class ConeAttackTests
    {
        // ---------- 히트박스 판정 ----------

        static bool In(float angleDeg, float dist) =>
            TowerManager.InCone(Quaternion.Euler(0f, angleDeg, 0f) * Vector3.forward * dist, Vector3.forward, 1.6f, 45f, 0.25f);

        [Test]
        public void InCone_FanShape()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(In(0f, 1f), "정면");
            Assert.IsTrue(In(40f, 1.5f), "부채꼴 안 (반각 45°)");
            Assert.IsTrue(In(-40f, 1.5f), "반대쪽도");
            Assert.IsTrue(In(0f, 1.8f), "끝에 몸통이 걸침 (1.6 + 0.25)");
            Assert.IsFalse(In(0f, 1.9f), "불길 끝 너머");
            Assert.IsFalse(In(70f, 1.5f), "부채꼴 밖 (옆)");
            Assert.IsFalse(In(180f, 0.8f), "뒤");
            Assert.IsTrue(In(120f, 0.2f), "타워에 겹쳐 있으면 맞음");
        }

        [Test]
        public void InCone_IgnoresHeight()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(TowerManager.InCone(new Vector3(0f, 5f, 1f), Vector3.forward, 1.6f, 45f, 0.25f), "바닥 평면으로만 판정");
        }

        // ---------- 실제 발사 ----------

        GameConfig config;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef flame;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            flame = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/flamethrower.asset");
            if (flame == null || flame.attackType != AttackType.Cone)
                Assert.Ignore("flamethrower 에셋이 없거나 범위 공격이 아님");
            var data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { flame });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player); // 표시 없음: 판정만
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            run.Cash = 10000;
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Fire_DamagesEveryMonsterInsideFan_Only()
        {
            // 몬스터를 경로를 따라 0.25초 간격으로 늘어놓는다
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 12, 0.25f, 0f) }, 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.25f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.25f);
            }

            // 몬스터가 가장 많이 몰린 경로 근처 부지에 화염방사 타워
            var site = BestSite();
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, flame));
            var tower = towers.GetTowerAt(site);

            var before = new Dictionary<MonsterInstance, float>();
            foreach (var m in AliveMonsters())
                before[m] = m.Hp;
            Assert.Greater(before.Count, 2);

            towers.TickCombat(0.01f); // 즉시 1발
            Assert.IsFalse(tower.Locked.IsNone, "대상을 잡고 발사");

            var center = board.CellToWorld(site);
            var forward = monsters.GetGroundPoint(monsters.Get(tower.Locked)) - center;
            forward.y = 0f;
            forward.Normalize();
            int hit = 0, missed = 0;
            foreach (var pair in before)
            {
                var m = pair.Key;
                bool inside = TowerManager.InCone(monsters.GetGroundPoint(m) - center, forward, flame.coneLength, flame.coneAngle * 0.5f, TowerManager.ConeHitRadius);
                if (inside)
                {
                    Assert.AreEqual(pair.Value - flame.damage, m.Hp, "부채꼴 안: 피해");
                    hit++;
                }
                else
                {
                    Assert.AreEqual(pair.Value, m.Hp, "부채꼴 밖: 피해 없음");
                    missed++;
                }
            }
            Assert.Greater(hit, 1, "범위 공격: 2마리 이상 맞음");
            TestContext.WriteLine($"맞음 {hit}, 안 맞음 {missed}");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Fire_KillsSeveralAtOnce_WithoutSkippingOthers()
        {
            monsters.DebugHpOverride = 1; // 한 번에 여러 마리가 죽어도 칸 목록을 끝까지 돈다
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 12, 0.25f, 0f) }, 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.25f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.25f);
            }
            var site = BestSite();
            towers.Build(site, flame);
            var tower = towers.GetTowerAt(site);

            // 대상 = 사거리 칸 안에서 경로를 가장 많이 간 몬스터 (TargetRule.First) → 발사 전에 부채꼴을 미리 계산
            MonsterInstance target = null;
            foreach (var m in AliveMonsters())
                if (tower.CoversCell[m.CellId] && (target == null || m.Remaining < target.Remaining))
                    target = m;
            Assert.IsNotNull(target);
            var center = board.CellToWorld(site);
            var forward = monsters.GetGroundPoint(target) - center;
            forward.y = 0f;
            forward.Normalize();
            var inside = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            var outside = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            foreach (var m in AliveMonsters())
                (TowerManager.InCone(monsters.GetGroundPoint(m) - center, forward, flame.coneLength, flame.coneAngle * 0.5f, TowerManager.ConeHitRadius) ? inside : outside).Add(m);
            Assert.Greater(inside.Count, 1, "부채꼴 안에 2마리 이상");

            towers.TickCombat(0.01f);                  // 1틱 0.5
            towers.TickCombat(flame.interval + 0.001f); // 2틱 0.5 → 체력 1 처치
            foreach (var m in inside)
                Assert.AreNotEqual(MonsterState.Alive, m.State, "부채꼴 안은 한 번에 모두 처치 (칸 목록을 건너뛰지 않음)");
            foreach (var m in outside)
                Assert.AreEqual(MonsterState.Alive, m.State, "부채꼴 밖은 그대로");
        }

        List<MonsterInstance> AliveMonsters()
        {
            var list = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            for (int i = 0; i < board.GetPathLength(0); i++)
                foreach (var h in board.MonstersAtPath(i))
                {
                    var m = monsters.Get(h);
                    if (m != null && m.State == MonsterState.Alive)
                        list.Add(m);
                }
            return list;
        }

        // 1.6칸 안에 살아 있는 몬스터가 가장 많은 부지
        Vector2Int BestSite()
        {
            var best = default(Vector2Int);
            int bestCount = -1;
            var alive = AliveMonsters();
            for (int x = 0; x < board.N; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < board.N; y++)
                {
                    var cell = new Vector2Int(x, y);
                    if (!board.IsBuildable(cell))
                        continue;
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var m in alive)
                        if ((monsters.GetGroundPoint(m) - board.CellToWorld(cell)).magnitude <= flame.coneLength)
                            count++;
                    if (count > bestCount)
                    {
                        bestCount = count;
                        best = cell;
                    }
                }
            return best;
        }
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // EMP 타워: 차지 뒤 원형 전자파. 파면이 지나가는 몬스터마다 1번씩 피해, 반지름 밖은 피해 없음.
    // 고정 7×7 맵 경로: 0(3,0) 1(3,1) 2(3,2) 3(4,2) 4(5,2) 5(5,3) 6(5,4) 7(5,5) 8(5,6)
    public class EmpPulseTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef emp;
        MonsterDef mech; // 기계 속성 몬스터 (일반 몬스터 복사본 + "mechanical")

        static readonly Vector2Int Site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            emp = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            emp.id = "empTest";
            emp.buildCost = 50;
            emp.damage = 1.5f;
            emp.interval = 1.6f;
            emp.range = 2;
            emp.chargeTime = 0.42f;
            emp.attackType = AttackType.Pulse;
            emp.pulseRadius = 2f;
            emp.pulseSpeed = 6f;

            data = new GameData();
            mech = TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
            mech.id = "mech";
            mech.traits = new[] { "mechanical" };
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset"), mech }, new[] { emp });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            player.Earn(1000, CashReason.Kill);
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown() => Object.DestroyImmediate(emp);

        MonsterInstance SpawnOne(string id = "normal")
        {
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn(id, 1, 0f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var cell = board.MonstersAtPath(0);
            return monsters.Get(cell[cell.Count - 1]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pulse_AfterCharge_HitsEveryoneInRadiusOnce_NotOutside()
        {
            var far = SpawnOne();
            monsters.TickMove(4f);                 // 경로 4번 칸 (5,2): 타워 (2,0)에서 약 3.6칸 → 반지름 밖
            var near1 = SpawnOne();                // 0번 칸 (3,0): 1칸
            monsters.TickMove(1.2f);               // near1 → 1.2칸 진행 (3,1) 근처, far는 더 멀리
            var near2 = SpawnOne();                // 0번 칸
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, emp));
            var tower = towers.Towers[0];

            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Charging, tower.State, "조준 즉시 차지");
            towers.TickCombat(0.4f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.PulseCount, "차지 중에는 방출 안 함");
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, near1.Hp);

            towers.TickCombat(0.03f);              // 차지 끝 → 방출
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.PulseCount, "전자파 1개");
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++)
                towers.TickCombat(0.02f);          // 0.8초: 파동이 끝까지 퍼짐 (반지름 2 / 속도 6 ≈ 0.33초)
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.PulseCount, "다 퍼지면 사라짐");

            Assert.AreEqual(2.5f, near1.Hp, 1e-4f, "반지름 안: 1번만 1.5 피해");
            Assert.AreEqual(2.5f, near2.Hp, 1e-4f, "반지름 안: 1번만 1.5 피해");
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, far.Hp, "반지름 밖: 피해 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Reloading, tower.State);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pulse_ReachesNearBeforeFar()
        {
            var a = SpawnOne();
            monsters.TickMove(1.8f);               // a: 타워에서 조금 더 먼 곳 (3,1)~(3,2) 사이
            var b = SpawnOne();                    // b: (3,0) 바로 옆
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, emp));
            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.4f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.03f);              // 차지 0.43초 → 방출, 파면 0.18칸 (아직 아무도 안 닿음)
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, b.Hp);
            towers.TickCombat(0.1f);               // 파면 0.78칸: b(몸 가장자리 0.75칸)만 닿음
            Assert.AreEqual(2.5f, b.Hp, 1e-4f, "가까운 몬스터 먼저");
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, a.Hp, "먼 몬스터는 아직");
            towers.TickCombat(0.3f);
            Assert.AreEqual(2.5f, a.Hp, 1e-4f, "파면이 닿으면 맞음");
        }

        // 기계 속성 몬스터는 2배 (EMP: 공격력 1 → 기계 2)
        [Test]
        public void Pulse_MechanicalTakesDouble()
        {
            emp.damage = 1f;
            emp.bonusTrait = "mechanical";
            emp.bonusMultiplier = 2f;
            var normal = SpawnOne();
            monsters.TickMove(0.6f);
            var robot = SpawnOne("mech");
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, emp));
            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.43f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
                towers.TickCombat(0.02f);
            Assert.AreEqual(3f, normal.Hp, 1e-4f, "일반: 1 피해");
            Assert.AreEqual(2f, robot.Hp, 1e-4f, "기계: 2배 = 2 피해");
        }

        [Test]
        public void DamageCalculator_TraitBonus()
        {
            var plain = TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
            var info = new DamageInfo(1f, DamageType.Normal, "mechanical", 2f);
            Assert.AreEqual(2f, DamageCalculator.Compute(info, mech), "속성 일치 → 2배");
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, DamageCalculator.Compute(info, plain), "속성 없음 → 그대로");
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, DamageCalculator.Compute(new DamageInfo(1f, DamageType.Normal), mech), "상성 없는 타워 → 그대로");
            Object.DestroyImmediate(plain);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClearCombat_RemovesPulses()
        {
            SpawnOne();
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, emp));
            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.4f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.03f);              // 방출 직후 (파면 0.18칸, 아직 퍼지는 중)
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.PulseCount);
            towers.ClearCombat();
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.PulseCount);
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 9: 층 전환(같은 Tier / Tier 변경 맵 교체) + 타워 회수 목록(재건축·철거·만료).
    // 실제 맵 생성기(백그라운드)로 7×7 → 9×9 교체까지 확인한다. 표시 없이 동작.
    public class FloorTransitionTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        MapProvider maps;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        GameFlow flow;
        BuildController build;
        TowerDef basic;

        readonly List<RecoveryChange> recoveryChanges = new List<RecoveryChange>();
        readonly List<RecoveryExpire> recoveryExpires = new List<RecoveryExpire>();
        int mapWaits;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            basic = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            data = new GameData();
            var rules = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset");
            data.Init(config, rules, new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset"), TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/fast.asset"), TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/tank.asset") }, new[] { basic }); // 2층부터 돌격조, 3층부터 탱커

            maps = new MapProvider();
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            flow = new GameFlow { LogStates = false };
            build = new BuildController();

            maps.Init(data, new LayoutMapGenerator(), new LayoutMapValidator());
            maps.SeedOverride = 12345;
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            flow.Init(data, maps, board, monsters, towers);
            build.Init(data, flow, board, towers, player, null);

            // GameLoop와 같은 구독 (화면 제외)
            flow.StateChanged += monsters.HandleStateChanged;
            flow.StateChanged += towers.HandleStateChanged;
            flow.StateChanged += build.HandleStateChanged;
            flow.MapWaitChanged += w => { if (w) mapWaits++; };
            maps.TierReady += flow.HandleTierReady;
            monsters.Killed += player.HandleKilled;
            monsters.ReachedExit += player.HandleReachedExit;
            player.Defeated += flow.HandleDefeated;
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            towers.RecoveryExpired += player.HandleRecoveryExpired;
            towers.RecoveryExpired += build.HandleRecoveryExpired;
            towers.RecoveryChanged += e => recoveryChanges.Add(e);
            towers.RecoveryExpired += e => recoveryExpires.Add(e);
            recoveryChanges.Clear();
            recoveryExpires.Clear();
            mapWaits = 0;

            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            maps.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            build.ResetForNewRun(run);
            flow.ResetForNewRun(run);

            WaitUntil(() => board.Map != null, "첫 맵");
            player.Earn(10000, CashReason.Kill);
            flow.RequestStartGame();
        }

        // 백그라운드 생성 결과는 flow.Tick(→ MapProvider.Poll)에서 받는다.
        void WaitUntil(System.Func<bool> condition, string what)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 1000 && !condition(); i++)
            {
                Thread.Sleep(2);
                flow.Tick(0f);
            }
            Assert.IsTrue(condition(), what + " 대기 시간 초과");
        }

        void ClearWave()
        {
            flow.StartNow();
            monsters.DebugFinishWave();
            flow.CheckWaveClear();
        }

        // 지금 층의 웨이브를 모두 끝내고 층 전환 상태로.
        void FinishFloor()
        {
            int floor = flow.Floor;
            while (flow.State == GameState.Break && flow.Floor == floor)
                ClearWave();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.FloorTransition, flow.State);
        }

        // 층 전환 연출 시간을 흘려 다음 층 Break로.
        void FinishTransition()
        {
            flow.Tick(config.floorTransitionSec + 0.01f);
            WaitUntil(() => flow.State == GameState.Break, "층 전환 완료");
        }

        Vector2Int BuildableCell(int skip = 0)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < board.N; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < board.N; y++)
                {
                    var c = new Vector2Int(x, y);
                    if (board.IsBuildable(c) && skip-- <= 0)
                        return c;
                }
            Assert.Fail("설치 가능 칸 없음");
            return default;
        }

        // 타워를 세우고 Tier가 바뀌기 직전 층(2층)을 끝내 층 전환 상태로 (2층 → 3층 = 7×7 → 9×9).
        void GoToTierChangeWithTowers(int towerCount)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < towerCount; i++)
                Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(BuildableCell(), basic));
            for (int f = 1; f <= 2; f++)
            {
                FinishFloor();
                if (f < 2)
                    FinishTransition();
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SameTier_1to2_KeepsMapAndTowers_NoRecovery()
        {
            var map = board.Map;
            var cell = BuildableCell();
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(cell, basic));

            FinishFloor();
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.Towers.Count, "전환 중에도 타워 그대로");
            FinishTransition();

            Assert.AreEqual(2, flow.Floor);
            Assert.AreSame(map, board.Map, "같은 Tier: 맵 그대로");
            Assert.IsNotNull(towers.GetTowerAt(cell), "타워 그대로");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.RecoveryTotalCount, "회수 목록 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, recoveryChanges.Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TierChange_2to3_Swaps7x7To9x9_TowersToRecovery_NoWait()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(7, board.N);
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(3);

            // 2층 마지막 웨이브 클리어 → 연출 시작: 타워 전부 회수 목록으로
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.FloorTransition, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.Towers.Count, "맵 위 타워 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(3, towers.RecoveryTotalCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, towers.GetRecoveryCount(basic));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, recoveryChanges.Count, "종류별 1번: 기본 타워 ×3");
            Assert.AreEqual((basic, 3, 3), (recoveryChanges[0].Def, recoveryChanges[0].Count, recoveryChanges[0].TotalCount));
            Assert.IsTrue(maps.IsReady(2), "다음 Tier 맵이 이미 준비됨 (미리 생성)");

            flow.Tick(config.floorTransitionSec + 0.01f);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Break, flow.State, "생성 대기 없이 바로 Break");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, mapWaits, "로딩 대기 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(3, flow.Floor);
            Assert.AreEqual(9, board.N, "9×9 맵으로 교체");
            Assert.AreEqual(9, board.Map.N);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Rebuild_IsFree_DecrementsList_AutoExitsWhenUsedUp()
        {
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(2);
            FinishTransition();
            int cash = player.Cash;

            build.EnterRebuildMode(basic);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Rebuild, build.Mode);

            var first = BuildableCell();
            build.Click(first);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Build, build.Popup);
            build.ConfirmPopup();
            Assert.IsNotNull(towers.GetTowerAt(first));
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash, "재건축은 캐시가 들지 않음");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.RecoveryTotalCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.Rebuild, build.Mode, "남아 있으면 모드 유지");

            build.Click(BuildableCell());
            build.ConfirmPopup();
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.RecoveryTotalCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash);
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.None, build.Mode, "다 쓰면 자동 종료");
            Assert.AreEqual(2, towers.Towers.Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Rebuild_EscExitsAnytime()
        {
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(2);
            FinishTransition();
            build.EnterRebuildMode(basic);
            build.ExitMode(); // ESC
            Assert.AreEqual(BuildMode.None, build.Mode);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, towers.RecoveryTotalCount, "목록은 그대로");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Scrap_RefundsExactly70Percent()
        {
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(2);
            FinishTransition();
            int cash = player.Cash;

            build.OpenRecoveryPopup(basic); // 항목 클릭
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.Recovery, build.Popup);
            build.CancelPopup();            // 오른쪽 [철거]: 확인 없이 바로
            Assert.AreEqual(cash + 35, player.Cash, "50 × 0.7 = 35");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.RecoveryTotalCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(PopupKind.None, build.Popup);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Expire_AfterFirstWaveOfNewMap_Refunds70Percent_ListGone()
        {
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(3);
            FinishTransition();
            int cash = player.Cash;

            ClearWave(); // 3층 첫 웨이브 끝나는 순간
            Assert.AreEqual(1, recoveryExpires.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual((3, 105), (recoveryExpires[0].TowerCount, recoveryExpires[0].Refund), "3 × 35");
            Assert.AreEqual(cash + 105, player.Cash, "만료 = 정확히 70%");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.RecoveryTotalCount, "목록 제거");

            ClearWave(); // 두 번째 웨이브: 다시 만료되지 않음
            Assert.AreEqual(1, recoveryExpires.Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void GameOverDuringFirstWave_DiscardsWithoutRefund()
        {
            GoToTierChangeWithTowers(2);
            FinishTransition();
            int cash = player.Cash;

            flow.StartNow();
            player.TakeNexusDamage(1000);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.RecoveryTotalCount, "목록 소멸");
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash, "반환 없음");
        }
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using TowerDefence;

// GameData: 실제 에셋으로 id 조회와 연속 인덱스 부여를 확인한다.
public class GameDataTests
{
    static T Load<T>(string path) where T : UnityEngine.Object
    {
        var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<T>(path);
        Assert.IsNotNull(asset, path + " 에셋이 없습니다.");
        return asset;
    }

    [Test]
    public void Init_BuildsLookupAndContinuousIndexes()
    {
        var monsters = new[]
        {
            Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset"),
            Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/fast.asset"),
            Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/tank.asset"),
        };
        var towers = new[] { Load<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset") };

        var data = new GameData();
        data.Init(Load<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset"), Load<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"), monsters, towers);

        for (int i = 0; i < monsters.Length; i++)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(i, monsters[i].Index, monsters[i].id);
            Assert.AreEqual(i, data.GetMonsterIndex(monsters[i]));
            Assert.IsTrue(data.TryGetMonster(monsters[i].id, out var found));
            Assert.AreSame(monsters[i], found);
        }
        Assert.AreEqual(0, towers[0].Index);
        Assert.IsTrue(data.TryGetTower("basic", out var basic));
        Assert.AreSame(towers[0], basic);
        Assert.IsFalse(data.TryGetMonster("unknown", out _));
    }

    [Test]
    public void Assets_MatchGddTables()
    {
        var normal = Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
        var fast = Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/fast.asset");
        var tank = Load<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/tank.asset");
        Assert.AreEqual((MonsterCategory.Normal, 4f, 1f, 5, 1), (normal.category, normal.hp, normal.speed, normal.reward, normal.nexusDamage));
        Assert.AreEqual((MonsterCategory.Special, 2f, 2f, 4, 1), (fast.category, fast.hp, fast.speed, fast.reward, fast.nexusDamage));
        Assert.AreEqual((MonsterCategory.Special, 12f, 0.5f, 10, 2), (tank.category, tank.hp, tank.speed, tank.reward, tank.nexusDamage));

        var basic = Load<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
        Assert.AreEqual(50, basic.buildCost);
        Assert.AreEqual(1f, basic.damage);
        Assert.AreEqual(1f, basic.interval);
        Assert.AreEqual(2, basic.range);
        Assert.AreEqual(TargetLock.Lock, basic.lockMode);
        Assert.AreEqual(TargetRule.First, basic.targetRule);
        Assert.AreEqual(0, basic.typePriority.Length);
        Assert.AreEqual(AttackType.Projectile, basic.attackType);
        Assert.AreEqual(8f, basic.projectileSpeed);
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 4: GameFlow 상태 머신 + PlayerState. GameLoop와 같은 방식으로 매니저를 만들고 연결해 흐름을 돌린다.
    public class GameFlowTests
    {
        // GDD 2-1 상태 표에서 허용되는 전환.
        static readonly HashSet<(GameState, GameState)> Allowed = new HashSet<(GameState, GameState)>
        {
            (GameState.Ready, GameState.Break),
            (GameState.Break, GameState.Wave),
            (GameState.Wave, GameState.Break),
            (GameState.Wave, GameState.FloorTransition),
            (GameState.Wave, GameState.GameOver),
            (GameState.Wave, GameState.GameClear),
            (GameState.FloorTransition, GameState.Break),
            (GameState.GameOver, GameState.Ready),
            (GameState.GameClear, GameState.Ready),
        };

        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        MapProvider maps;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        GameFlow flow;
        RunState run;

        readonly List<StateChange> states = new List<StateChange>();
        readonly List<int> timerSeconds = new List<int>();
        int defeatedCount;
        int restartCount;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            Assert.IsNotNull(config);

            data = new GameData();
            var monsterDefs = new[]
            {
                AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset"),
                AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/fast.asset"),
                AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/tank.asset"),
            };
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"), monsterDefs, new TowerDef[0]);
            maps = new MapProvider();
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            flow = new GameFlow { LogStates = false };

            maps.Init(data, null, null); // 맵 생성은 이 테스트 대상이 아님
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            flow.Init(data, maps, board, monsters, towers);

            states.Clear();
            timerSeconds.Clear();
            defeatedCount = 0;
            restartCount = 0;
            flow.StateChanged += e => states.Add(e);
            flow.StateChanged += monsters.HandleStateChanged;
            flow.TimerSecondChanged += e => timerSeconds.Add(e.Seconds);
            player.Defeated += () => defeatedCount++;
            player.Defeated += flow.HandleDefeated;
            flow.RestartRequested += () => { restartCount++; StartNewRun(); };

            StartNewRun();
        }

        // GameLoop.StartNewRun과 같은 순서.
        void StartNewRun()
        {
            run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            maps.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            flow.ResetForNewRun(run);
        }

        // 디버그 키와 같은 일: 휴식은 즉시 시작, 웨이브는 클리어 처리, 층 전환은 연출 시간만큼 Tick.
        void AdvanceOneStep()
        {
            switch (flow.State)
            {
                case GameState.Break:
                    flow.StartNow();
                    break;
                case GameState.Wave:
                    monsters.DebugFinishWave();
                    flow.CheckWaveClear();
                    break;
                case GameState.FloorTransition:
                    flow.Tick(config.floorTransitionSec + 0.01f);
                    break;
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Floor1To10_ReachesGameClear_WithAllowedTransitions()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Ready, flow.State);
            flow.RequestStartGame();

            int guard = 0;
            while (flow.State != GameState.GameClear && guard++ < 10000)
            {
                if (flow.State == GameState.Wave)
                {
                    // Wave 진입 때 MonsterManager에 구성표가 넘어갔는지: 남은 스폰 = 이번 g의 몬스터 수 + 돌격조 + 탱커(층 마지막 웨이브)
                    Assert.AreEqual(LevelRules.MonsterCount(config, flow.TotalWaveIndex) + LevelRules.RunnerCount(config, flow.Floor)
                        + LevelRules.TankerCount(config, flow.Floor, flow.Wave),
                        monsters.RemainingToSpawn,
                        $"{flow.Floor}층 {flow.Wave}웨이브 구성표");
                }
                AdvanceOneStep();
            }

            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameClear, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(10, flow.Floor);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, flow.Wave);
            Assert.AreEqual(30, flow.TotalWaveIndex, "누적 웨이브 g");

            // 전환이 모두 GDD 2-1 표에 있는지
            for (int i = 1; i < states.Count; i++)
                Assert.IsTrue(Allowed.Contains((states[i - 1].State, states[i].State)),
                    $"허용되지 않은 전환 {states[i - 1].State} → {states[i].State} ({states[i].Floor}층)");

            Assert.AreEqual(1 + 30 + 9 + 30 + 1, states.Count, "Ready 1 + Break 30 + FloorTransition 9 + Wave 30 + GameClear 1");
            Assert.AreEqual(9, states.FindAll(s => s.State == GameState.FloorTransition).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(30, states.FindAll(s => s.State == GameState.Wave).Count);

            // 층 전환은 각 층의 마지막 웨이브 뒤에서만
            foreach (var s in states)
                if (s.State == GameState.FloorTransition)
                    Assert.AreEqual(LevelRules.GetWaveCount(config, s.Floor), s.Wave, $"{s.Floor}층 전환 시점");
        }

        [Test]
        public void BreakTimer_FiresOnlyWhenWholeSecondChanges_ThenStartsWave()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Break, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(new List<int> { 120 }, timerSeconds);

            int guard = 0;
            while (flow.State == GameState.Break && guard++ < 10000)
                flow.Tick(0.1f);

            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Wave, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(120, timerSeconds.Count, "120, 119, ..., 1 한 번씩");
            for (int i = 0; i < timerSeconds.Count; i++)
                Assert.AreEqual(120 - i, timerSeconds[i]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void StartNow_OnlyWorksInBreak()
        {
            flow.StartNow();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Ready, flow.State, "Ready에서는 무시");
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.StartNow();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Wave, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, flow.TotalWaveIndex);
        }

        [Test]
        public void NexusDamage_ManyTimesInOneFrame_DefeatedOnce_GameOver()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.StartNow();
            var hpEvents = new List<int>();
            player.HpChanged += e => hpEvents.Add(e.Hp);

            // 같은 프레임에 여러 마리 도착: 1씩 25번 (체력 20)
            for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++)
                player.TakeNexusDamage(1);

            Assert.AreEqual(0, player.NexusHp);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, defeatedCount, "Defeated는 1번만");
            Assert.AreEqual(20, hpEvents.Count, "0이 된 뒤의 피해는 계산하지 않음");
            Assert.IsTrue(player.IsDefeated);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, states.FindAll(s => s.State == GameState.GameOver).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.RemainingToSpawn, "게임오버 시 남은 스폰 버림");
        }

        [Test]
        public void NexusDamage_BigHitsPastZero_DefeatedOnce()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.StartNow();
            player.TakeNexusDamage(15);
            player.TakeNexusDamage(15);
            player.TakeNexusDamage(15);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, player.NexusHp, "음수가 되지 않음");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, defeatedCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Restart_AfterGameOver_ResetsRun()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
                AdvanceOneStep(); // 몇 웨이브·층 진행
            player.Spend(30, CashReason.Build);
            player.Earn(5, CashReason.Kill);
            while (flow.State != GameState.Wave)
                AdvanceOneStep();
            player.TakeNexusDamage(100);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State);
            Assert.Greater(flow.TotalWaveIndex, 0);

            flow.RequestRestart();

            Assert.AreEqual(1, restartCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Ready, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(100, player.Cash);
            Assert.AreEqual(20, player.NexusHp);
            Assert.IsFalse(player.IsDefeated);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, flow.Floor);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, flow.Wave);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, flow.TotalWaveIndex, "g = 0");

            // 새 판에서 다시 지면 Defeated가 또 1번 나온다
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.StartNow();
            player.TakeNexusDamage(100);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, defeatedCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Restart_AfterGameClear_ResetsRun()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            int guard = 0;
            while (flow.State != GameState.GameClear && guard++ < 10000)
                AdvanceOneStep();
            flow.RequestRestart();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Ready, flow.State);
            Assert.AreEqual((100, 20, 1, 0), (player.Cash, player.NexusHp, flow.Floor, flow.TotalWaveIndex));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Restart_IgnoredWhileRunning()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.RequestRestart();
            Assert.AreEqual(0, restartCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Break, flow.State);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Cash_SpendEarnAndEvents()
        {
            var changes = new List<CashChange>();
            player.CashChanged += e => changes.Add(e);

            Assert.IsTrue(player.CanAfford(100));
            Assert.IsFalse(player.CanAfford(101));
            Assert.IsTrue(player.Spend(50, CashReason.Build));
            Assert.IsFalse(player.Spend(60, CashReason.Build), "부족하면 실패");
            Assert.AreEqual(50, player.Cash, "실패한 Spend는 캐시를 바꾸지 않음");
            player.Earn(35, CashReason.Sell);
            player.Earn(0, CashReason.Kill);
            Assert.IsFalse(player.Spend(-5, CashReason.Build), "음수 사용 거부");

            Assert.AreEqual(85, player.Cash);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, changes.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual((50, -50, CashReason.Build), (changes[0].Cash, changes[0].Delta, changes[0].Reason));
            Assert.AreEqual((85, 35, CashReason.Sell), (changes[1].Cash, changes[1].Delta, changes[1].Reason));
        }
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 8: GameUI 배치(GDD 5-1), BuildMode 슬라이드(5-2), 값 변경 때만 글자 갱신(권고 6), 결과 팝업(6-4).
    public class GameUiTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        GameFlow flow;
        BuildController build;
        GameUI ui;
        GameObject canvasGo;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") },
                new[] { AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset") });

            var maps = new MapProvider();
            board = new Board();
            var monsters = new MonsterManager();
            var towers = new TowerManager();
            var player = new PlayerState();
            flow = new GameFlow { LogStates = false };
            build = new BuildController();
            ui = new GameUI();
            canvasGo = new GameObject("TestCanvas", typeof(Canvas), typeof(CanvasScaler));
            maps.Init(data, null, null);
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            flow.Init(data, maps, board, monsters, towers);
            build.Init(data, flow, board, towers, player, null);
            ui.Init(data, canvasGo.GetComponent<Canvas>(), board, build, flow, null, null, null);

            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            ui.ResetForNewRun(run);
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            Object.DestroyImmediate(canvasGo);
            var overlay = GameObject.Find("BuildOverlay");
            while (overlay != null)
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(overlay);
                overlay = GameObject.Find("BuildOverlay");
            }
        }

        Transform Find(string path) => canvasGo.transform.Find(path);
        RectTransform Rt(string path) => (RectTransform)Find(path);

        [Test]
        public void AllGdd51Areas_Exist_EachPanelOwnCanvas()
        {
            string[] areas = { "TopBar", "CashTimer", "RecoveryPanel", "CashLogPanel", "BottomBar", "StartPrompt", "BuildGuide", "ConfirmPopup", "ResultPopup", "FloorBanner" };
            foreach (var area in areas)
            {
                Assert.IsNotNull(Find(area), area + " 없음");
                Assert.IsNotNull(Find(area).GetComponent<Canvas>(), area + "는 자기 Canvas");
            }
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("TopBar/Floor"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("TopBar/Wave"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("TopBar/NexusHp"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("TopBar/StartNow"), "[즉시 시작]");
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("CashTimer/Cash"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("CashTimer/Timer"));
            Assert.IsFalse(Find("CashLogPanel").gameObject.activeSelf, "캐시 로그는 자리만 (cashLog.enabled = false)");
        }

        [Test]
        public void BottomButtons_FromListData_UpgradeOpensTechTree()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(config.ui.bottomButtons.Length, Find("BottomBar").GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(true).Length);
            foreach (var entry in config.ui.bottomButtons)
            {
                var button = Find("BottomBar/Button_" + entry.id).GetComponent<Button>();
                Assert.AreEqual(entry.label, button.GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);
            }

            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Break, 1, 0));
            Assert.IsTrue(ui.Hud.IsButtonInteractable("build"));
            Assert.AreEqual(config.upgradeEnabled, ui.Hud.IsButtonInteractable("upgrade"), "업그레이드 = 테크트리 창 (upgradeEnabled일 때 켜짐)");
        }

        [Test]
        public void BuildMode_PanelsSlideOutByDirection_CashTimerStays_ThenBack()
        {
            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Break, 1, 0));
            Vector2 top = Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition, bottom = Rt("BottomBar").anchoredPosition;
            Vector2 left = Rt("RecoveryPanel").anchoredPosition, right = Rt("CashLogPanel").anchoredPosition;
            Vector2 cash = Rt("CashTimer").anchoredPosition;

            ui.HandleModeChanged(new BuildModeChange(BuildMode.Build, null));
            ui.Tick(0.3f);
            Assert.Greater(Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition.y, top.y + 72f, "상단 → 위로 화면 밖");
            Assert.Less(Rt("BottomBar").anchoredPosition.y, bottom.y - 104f, "하단 → 아래로 화면 밖");
            Assert.Less(Rt("RecoveryPanel").anchoredPosition.x, left.x - 300f, "좌측 → 왼쪽");
            Assert.Greater(Rt("CashLogPanel").anchoredPosition.x, right.x + 300f, "우측 → 오른쪽");
            Assert.AreEqual(HudView.CashTimerBuildPosition, Rt("CashTimer").anchoredPosition, "캐시·타이머는 안내 문구 아래로 모임");
            Assert.IsTrue(Find("CashTimer").gameObject.activeSelf, "BuildMode 중에도 캐시·타이머 보임");
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, Find("BuildGuide").GetComponent<CanvasGroup>().alpha, 1e-4f, "안내 문구 페이드 인");

            ui.HandleModeChanged(new BuildModeChange(BuildMode.None, null));
            ui.Tick(0.3f);
            Assert.AreEqual(top, Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition);
            Assert.AreEqual(bottom, Rt("BottomBar").anchoredPosition);
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, Rt("CashTimer").anchoredPosition);
            Assert.IsFalse(Find("BuildGuide").gameObject.activeSelf, "안내 문구 페이드 아웃 후 숨김");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Slide_ReversedMidway_ContinuesFromCurrentPosition()
        {
            var home = Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition;
            ui.HandleModeChanged(new BuildModeChange(BuildMode.Build, null));
            ui.Tick(0.15f);
            var mid = Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition;
            Assert.Greater(mid.y, home.y, "나가는 중");

            ui.HandleModeChanged(new BuildModeChange(BuildMode.None, null)); // 도중에 취소
            ui.Tick(0.001f);
            Assert.That(Vector2.Distance(Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition, mid), Is.LessThan(1f), "현재 위치에서 이어서 (튀지 않음)");
            ui.Tick(0.3f);
            Assert.AreEqual(home, Rt("TopBar").anchoredPosition);
        }

        [Test]
        public void HudText_WrittenOnlyWhenValueChanges()
        {
            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
            int start = ui.Hud.TextWrites;

            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++)
                ui.Tick(0.016f); // 웨이브 중 프레임: 값 변경 없음
            Assert.AreEqual(start, ui.Hud.TextWrites, "매 프레임 글자 갱신 없음");

            ui.HandleCashChanged(new CashChange(105, 5, CashReason.Kill));
            ui.HandleCashChanged(new CashChange(105, 0, CashReason.Kill)); // 같은 값
            Assert.AreEqual(start + 1, ui.Hud.TextWrites);

            ui.HandleHpChanged(new HpChange(19, -1));
            Assert.AreEqual(start + 2, ui.Hud.TextWrites);
            Assert.AreEqual("캐시 105", Find("CashTimer/Cash").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);
            Assert.AreEqual("넥서스 체력 19", Find("TopBar/NexusHp").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);

            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Break, 1, 1));
            int beforeTimer = ui.Hud.TextWrites;
            ui.HandleTimerSecond(new TimerSecond(120));
            ui.HandleTimerSecond(new TimerSecond(120));
            ui.HandleTimerSecond(new TimerSecond(119));
            Assert.AreEqual(beforeTimer + 2, ui.Hud.TextWrites, "초가 바뀔 때만");
            Assert.AreEqual("휴식 119초", Find("CashTimer/Timer").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ResultPopups_GameOverAndGameClear()
        {
            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.GameOver, 7, 2));
            Assert.IsTrue(Find("ResultPopup").gameObject.activeSelf);
            Assert.AreEqual("게임 오버\n도달 층: 7층", Find("ResultPopup/Message").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);
            Assert.IsNotNull(Find("ResultPopup/Restart").GetComponent<Button>(), "[다시 시작]");

            ui.HandleHpChanged(new HpChange(13, -1));
            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.GameClear, 46, 11));
            Assert.AreEqual("게임 클리어!\n도달 층: 46층, 남은 체력: 13", Find("ResultPopup/Message").GetComponentInChildren<Text>().text);

            ui.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Ready, 1, 0));
            Assert.IsFalse(Find("ResultPopup").gameObject.activeSelf);
            Assert.IsTrue(Find("StartPrompt").gameObject.activeSelf, "Ready에서만 시작 문구");
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using TowerDefence;

// 진행 표(10층, 2층마다 복잡성·맵 단계, 웨이브 최대 5)와 LevelRules 결과를 비교한다. 실제 에셋(Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset)의 값으로 계산.
public class LevelRulesTests
{
    const string ConfigPath = "Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset";

    // 검수표 한 행. Counts가 null이면 문서가 범위만 적은 행이라 첫·마지막 웨이브만 비교한다.
    public class Row
    {
        public int Floor, Tier, N, Complexity, Waves, GFirst, GLast;
        public int[] Counts;
        public int FirstCount, LastCount;

        public override string ToString() => $"{Floor}층";
    }

    static Row R(int floor, int tier, int n, int complexity, int waves, int gFirst, int gLast, params int[] counts) =>
        new Row { Floor = floor, Tier = tier, N = n, Complexity = complexity, Waves = waves, GFirst = gFirst, GLast = gLast, Counts = counts };

    // 진행 표: 층, Tier, 맵 N, 복잡성, 웨이브 수, 누적 g 시작·끝, 웨이브별 몬스터 수
    public static IEnumerable<Row> Table()
    {
        yield return R(1, 1, 7, 1, 1, 1, 1, 10);
        yield return R(2, 1, 7, 1, 1, 2, 2, 10);
        yield return R(3, 2, 9, 2, 2, 3, 4, 12, 12);
        yield return R(4, 2, 9, 2, 2, 5, 6, 14, 14);
        yield return R(5, 3, 11, 3, 3, 7, 9, 16, 16, 18);
        yield return R(6, 3, 11, 3, 3, 10, 12, 18, 20, 20);
        yield return R(7, 4, 13, 4, 4, 13, 16, 22, 22, 24, 24);
        yield return R(8, 4, 13, 4, 4, 17, 20, 26, 26, 28, 28);
        yield return R(9, 5, 15, 5, 5, 21, 25, 30, 30, 32, 32, 34);
        yield return R(10, 5, 15, 5, 5, 26, 30, 34, 36, 36, 38, 38);
    }

    GameConfig config;

    [OneTimeSetUp]
    public void LoadConfig()
    {
        config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>(ConfigPath);
        Assert.IsNotNull(config, ConfigPath + " 에셋이 없습니다.");
    }

    // 이 층 첫 웨이브의 누적 번호 g = (이전 층 웨이브 수 합) + 1.
    int FirstG(int floor)
    {
        int g = 1;
        for (int f = 1; f < floor; f++)
            g += LevelRules.GetWaveCount(config, f);
        return g;
    }

    [TestCaseSource(nameof(Table))]
    public void FloorPlan_MatchesTable(Row row)
    {
        var plan = LevelRules.GetFloorPlan(config, row.Floor);

        Assert.AreEqual(row.Floor, plan.Floor, "floor");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.Tier, plan.Tier, "Tier");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.N, plan.N, "맵 크기 N");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.Complexity, plan.Complexity, "복잡성");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.Waves, plan.Waves, "웨이브 수");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.Floor == 10, plan.IsFinal, "마지막 층 여부");

        int gFirst = FirstG(row.Floor);
        int gLast = gFirst + plan.Waves - 1;
        Assert.AreEqual(row.GFirst, gFirst, "누적 g 시작");
        Assert.AreEqual(row.GLast, gLast, "누적 g 끝");

        if (row.Counts != null)
        {
            var actual = new int[plan.Waves];
            for (int i = 0; i < plan.Waves; i++)
                actual[i] = LevelRules.MonsterCount(config, gFirst + i);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(row.Counts, actual, "웨이브별 몬스터 수");
        }
        else
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(row.FirstCount, LevelRules.MonsterCount(config, gFirst), "첫 웨이브 몬스터 수");
            Assert.AreEqual(row.LastCount, LevelRules.MonsterCount(config, gLast), "마지막 웨이브 몬스터 수");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void TotalWaves_ThroughFinalFloor_Is30()
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(10, config.finalFloor, "진행은 10층까지");
        int total = 0;
        for (int f = 1; f <= config.finalFloor; f++)
            total += LevelRules.GetWaveCount(config, f);
        Assert.AreEqual(30, total);
    }

    [Test]
    public void OnlyFinalFloor_IsFinal()
    {
        for (int f = 1; f <= config.finalFloor; f++)
            Assert.AreEqual(f == 10, LevelRules.IsFinalFloor(config, f), $"{f}층");
    }

    [Test]
    public void Caps_MapSize15_Waves5_Complexity5()
    {
        // 표 밖 층·Tier로 가도 최대값을 넘지 않는다 (레벨디자인으로 층을 늘릴 때 대비)
        Assert.AreEqual(15, LevelRules.GetMapSize(config, 9));
        Assert.AreEqual(5, LevelRules.GetWaveCount(config, 30));
        Assert.AreEqual(5, LevelRules.GetComplexity(config, 9));
    }

    [Test]
    public void WaveComposition_IsNormalMonsters_OnePerInterval()
    {
        var buffer = new WaveSpawn[4];
        int lines = LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, 6, 3, 13, buffer);

        Assert.AreEqual(3, lines, "6층 마지막(3) 웨이브: 일반 + 돌격조 + 탱커");
        Assert.AreEqual("normal", buffer[0].MonsterId);
        Assert.AreEqual(22, buffer[0].Count);
        Assert.AreEqual(1f, buffer[0].IntervalSec);
        Assert.AreEqual(0f, buffer[0].DelaySec);
        Assert.AreEqual("fast", buffer[1].MonsterId);
        Assert.AreEqual(4, buffer[1].Count, "5·6층 (Tier 3) 돌격조 = 4마리");
        Assert.AreEqual(0.5f, buffer[1].IntervalSec);
        Assert.AreEqual(1f, buffer[1].DelaySec);
        Assert.AreEqual("tank", buffer[2].MonsterId);
        Assert.AreEqual(2, buffer[2].Count, "5·6층 (Tier 3) 탱커 = 2마리");
        Assert.AreEqual(3f, buffer[2].IntervalSec);
        Assert.AreEqual(2f, buffer[2].DelaySec);

        // 마지막 웨이브가 아니면 일반 + 돌격조
        Assert.AreEqual(2, LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, 6, 2, 12, buffer));
        // 1층은 일반 몬스터만
        Assert.AreEqual(1, LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, 1, 1, 1, buffer));
    }

    // 돌격조(해머헤드): 2층부터 모든 웨이브, 2층 2 → 9·10층 6마리
    [TestCase(1, 0)]
    [TestCase(2, 2)]
    [TestCase(3, 3)]
    [TestCase(4, 3)]
    [TestCase(5, 4)]
    [TestCase(7, 5)]
    [TestCase(9, 6)]
    [TestCase(10, 6)]
    public void RunnerCount_FromFloor2_EveryWave(int floor, int expected)
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(expected, LevelRules.RunnerCount(config, floor));
    }

    // 탱커(바스티온): 3층부터 층의 마지막 웨이브에만, 3·4층 1 → 9·10층 4마리
    [TestCase(1, 1, 0)]
    [TestCase(2, 1, 0)]
    [TestCase(3, 1, 0)]

    public void TankerCount_FromFloor3_LastWaveOnly(int floor, int wave, int expected)
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(expected, LevelRules.TankerCount(config, floor, wave));
    }

    [Test]
    public void HpScale_MatchesLevelDesignTable()
    {
        // Docs/HpLevelDesign.md 3장: 층별 웨이브마다 일반 몬스터(기본 체력 4) 체력
        float[][] expected =
        {
            new[] { 4f }, new[] { 5f }, new[] { 5.5f, 6f }, new[] { 7f, 7.5f },
            new[] { 10f, 10.5f, 11.5f }, new[] { 12f, 13f, 14f },
            new[] { 14f, 15f, 16f, 17f }, new[] { 17f, 18.5f, 20f, 21.5f },
            new[] { 22.5f, 24.5f, 26f, 28f, 30f }, new[] { 28f, 30.5f, 32.5f, 35f, 37f },
        };
        for (int floor = 1; floor <= 10; floor++)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(expected[floor - 1].Length, LevelRules.GetWaveCount(config, floor), $"{floor}층 웨이브 수");
            for (int w = 1; w <= expected[floor - 1].Length; w++)
                Assert.AreEqual(expected[floor - 1][w - 1], LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, 4f, LevelRules.GetHpScale(config, floor, w)), $"{floor}층 {w}웨이브");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void HpScale_FirstWaveIsOne_RoundsToHalf()
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(1f, LevelRules.GetHpScale(config, 1, 1), 1e-6f);
        Assert.AreEqual(2.5f, LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, 2f, 1.25f), "빠른 몬스터 2층: 2 × 1.25 = 2.5");
        Assert.AreEqual(0.5f, LevelRules.ScaleHp(config, 0.1f, 1f), "최소 0.5");
    }
}

    using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

// namespace 안에 두어 TileType이 기존 생성기의 전역 TileType이 아니라 TowerDefence.TileType을 가리키게 한다.
namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
// 맵 연결(작업 3): 생성기 어댑터, 검사기 어댑터, 고정 맵, Board.
public class MapTests
{
    MapGenRules rules;
    GameConfig config;
    readonly LayoutMapGenerator generator = new LayoutMapGenerator();
    readonly LayoutMapValidator validator = new LayoutMapValidator();

    static readonly int[] Sizes = { 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 21, 27, 37 };

    [OneTimeSetUp]
    public void Load()
    {
        rules = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset");
        config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
        Assert.IsNotNull(rules);
        Assert.IsNotNull(config);
    }

    MapData Gen(int n, int seed) => generator.Generate(new MapSpec(n, 1, seed, rules));

    [Test]
    public void SameSeed_GivesSameMap([ValueSource(nameof(Sizes))] int n)
    {
        for (int seed = 0; seed < 20; seed++)
        {
            var a = Gen(n, seed);
            var b = Gen(n, seed);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(a.Tiles, b.Tiles, $"N={n} seed={seed} Tiles");
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(a.Sites, b.Sites, $"N={n} seed={seed} Sites");
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(a.MonsterPaths[0], b.MonsterPaths[0], $"N={n} seed={seed} 경로");
            Assert.AreEqual(seed, a.Seed);
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void DifferentSeeds_GiveDifferentMaps()
    {
        int distinct = 0;
        var first = Gen(11, 1);
        for (int seed = 2; seed < 22; seed++)
            if (!SamePath(first, Gen(11, seed)))
                distinct++;
        Assert.Greater(distinct, 15, "시드가 달라도 맵이 거의 같음");
    }

    [Test]
    public void GeneratedMaps_PassValidator_AndConvertCorrectly([ValueSource(nameof(Sizes))] int n)
    {
        for (int seed = 0; seed < 50; seed++)
        {
            var map = Gen(n, seed);
            Assert.IsNotNull(map, $"N={n} seed={seed} 생성 실패");
            AssertWellFormed(map, n);
            var report = validator.Validate(map, rules);
            Assert.IsTrue(report.IsValid, $"N={n} seed={seed}: {(report.IsValid ? "" : report.Violations[0].RuleId + " " + report.Violations[0].Detail)}");
        }
    }

    [Test]
    public void FixedTestMap_Is7x7_AndPassesValidator()
    {
        var map = new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default);
        Assert.AreEqual(7, map.N);
        AssertWellFormed(map, 7);
        Assert.IsTrue(validator.Validate(map, rules).IsValid);
        Assert.AreEqual(SiteGrade.TStar, map.Sites[4, 1]);
        Assert.AreEqual(SiteGrade.TStar, map.Sites[4, 3]);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Validator_ReportsBrokenMap()
    {
        var map = Gen(9, 3);
        map.MonsterPaths[0].RemoveAt(map.MonsterPaths[0].Count / 2); // 경로를 끊는다
        Assert.IsFalse(validator.Validate(map, rules).IsValid);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Generator_RunsOnBackgroundThread()
    {
        var task = Task.Run(() => Gen(37, 12345));
        Assert.IsTrue(task.Wait(5000), "백그라운드 생성 시간 초과");
        Assert.IsNotNull(task.Result);
        Assert.IsTrue(SamePath(task.Result, Gen(37, 12345)), "스레드에서 만든 맵이 메인 스레드 결과와 다름");
    }

    [Test]
    public void Board_LoadQueriesAndOccupancy()
    {
        var data = new GameData();
        data.Init(config, rules, new MonsterDef[0], new TowerDef[0]);
        var board = new Board();
        board.Init(data);
        board.ResetForNewRun(new RunState());
        var map = new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default);
        board.Load(map);

        Assert.AreEqual(7, board.N);
        Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Spawn, board.GetTile(new Vector2Int(3, 0)));
        Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Exit, board.GetTile(new Vector2Int(5, 6)));
        Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Empty, board.GetTile(new Vector2Int(-1, 0)));
        Assert.AreEqual(9, board.GetPathLength(0));
        Assert.AreEqual(new Vector2Int(4, 2), board.GetPathCell(0, 3));
        Assert.IsTrue(board.IsPathCell(new Vector2Int(4, 2)));
        Assert.IsFalse(board.IsPathCell(new Vector2Int(0, 0)));
        Assert.AreEqual(4 * 7 + 2, board.CellId(new Vector2Int(4, 2)), "칸 번호 = x × N + y");

        var site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);
        Assert.IsTrue(board.IsBuildable(site));
        Assert.IsFalse(board.IsBuildable(new Vector2Int(3, 1)), "경로에는 설치 불가");
        Assert.IsFalse(board.IsBuildable(new Vector2Int(0, 0)), "부지가 아닌 칸은 설치 불가");
        board.Occupy(site);
        Assert.IsFalse(board.IsBuildable(site));
        board.Release(site);
        Assert.IsTrue(board.IsBuildable(site));

        // 3D 바닥 좌표: 7×7이면 칸 (x, y) 중심 = (x − 3, 0, y − 3)
        Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3(-1f, 0f, -3f), board.CellToWorld(site));
        Assert.AreEqual(Vector3.zero, board.CellToWorld(new Vector2Int(3, 3)), "맵 중앙 = 원점");
        Assert.IsTrue(board.TryWorldToCell(new Vector3(-0.6f, 0f, -2.8f), out var cell));
        Assert.AreEqual(site, cell);
        Assert.IsFalse(board.TryWorldToCell(new Vector3(3.6f, 0f, 0f), out _), "맵 밖");
    }

    [Test]
    public void Board_CellBuckets_AddRemoveWithoutAllocation()
    {
        var data = new GameData();
        data.Init(config, rules, new MonsterDef[0], new TowerDef[0]);
        var board = new Board();
        board.Init(data);
        board.ResetForNewRun(new RunState());
        board.Load(Gen(37, 7));

        // JIT·첫 호출 비용 제외용 예열
        board.AddToCell(0, new MonsterHandle(0, 0));
        board.RemoveFromCell(0, new MonsterHandle(0, 0));

        long before = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
        for (int round = 0; round < 10; round++)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 290; i++)
                board.AddToCell(board.PathCellId(i % board.GetPathLength(0)), new MonsterHandle(i, round));
            for (int i = 0; i < 290; i++)
                board.RemoveFromCell(board.PathCellId(i % board.GetPathLength(0)), new MonsterHandle(i, round));
        }
        long allocated = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - before;

        Assert.AreEqual(0, allocated, "칸별 몬스터 목록 추가·제거에서 할당 발생");
        for (int i = 0; i < board.GetPathLength(0); i++)
            Assert.AreEqual(0, board.MonstersAtPath(i).Count);
    }

    [Test]
    public void Measure_GenerationTime_37x37()
    {
        Gen(37, 0); // 예열
        const int runs = 50;
        double total = 0, max = 0;
        var sw = new Stopwatch();
        for (int seed = 1; seed <= runs; seed++)
        {
            sw.Restart();
            var map = Gen(37, seed);
            validator.Validate(map, rules);
            sw.Stop();
            double ms = sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
            total += ms;
            max = Math.Max(max, ms);
        }
        string result = $"37×37 생성+검사 {runs}회: 평균 {total / runs:F3}ms, 최대 {max:F3}ms";
        UnityEngine.Debug.Log("[MapTests] " + result);
        TestContext.WriteLine(result);
        Assert.Less(max, config.performance.mapGenFrameBudgetMs * 50, "생성이 지나치게 느림");
    }

    static bool SamePath(MapData a, MapData b)
    {
        var pa = a.MonsterPaths[0];
        var pb = b.MonsterPaths[0];
        if (pa.Count != pb.Count)
            return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < pa.Count; i++)
            if (pa[i] != pb[i])
                return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void AssertWellFormed(MapData map, int n)
    {
        Assert.AreEqual(n, map.N);
        Assert.AreEqual(1, map.Spawns.Length);
        var path = map.MonsterPaths[0];
        Assert.AreEqual(map.Spawns[0], path[0], "경로 첫 칸 = 스폰");
        Assert.AreEqual(map.Exit, path[path.Count - 1], "경로 마지막 칸 = 출구");
        Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Spawn, map.Tiles[map.Spawns[0].x, map.Spawns[0].y]);
        Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Exit, map.Tiles[map.Exit.x, map.Exit.y]);
        for (int i = 1; i < path.Count - 1; i++)
            Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Path, map.Tiles[path[i].x, path[i].y]);

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
            {
                bool site = map.Tiles[x, y] == TileType.BuildSite;
                var grade = map.Sites[x, y];
                Assert.AreEqual(site, grade != SiteGrade.None, $"({x},{y}) 부지와 등급 불일치");
                Assert.AreNotEqual(SiteGrade.T2, grade, "정본 생성기는 T2를 만들지 않음");
            }
        }
    }
}
}
