    using System;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 5: MonsterManager (표시 없이 동작, 고정 7×7 맵 = 경로 9칸).
    public class MonsterTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        MapProvider maps;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        GameFlow flow;
        RunState run;
        int killedEvents;
        int defeatedEvents;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[]
                {
                    TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset"), // 이동 시간 계산용: 스폰 대기 0
                    AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/fast.asset"),
                    AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/tank.asset"),
                },
                new TowerDef[0]);

            maps = new MapProvider();
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            flow = new GameFlow { LogStates = false };
            maps.Init(data, null, null);
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board); // 표시 없음
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            flow.Init(data, maps, board, monsters, towers);

            killedEvents = 0;
            defeatedEvents = 0;
            monsters.Killed += player.HandleKilled;
            monsters.Killed += e => killedEvents++;
            monsters.ReachedExit += player.HandleReachedExit;
            player.Defeated += flow.HandleDefeated;
            player.Defeated += () => defeatedEvents++;
            flow.StateChanged += monsters.HandleStateChanged;

            run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            maps.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            flow.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default)); // 경로 9칸, 출구 = 8번 칸
        }

        // GameLoop.Update의 2~6단계와 같은 순서.
        void Frame(float dt)
        {
            flow.Tick(dt);
            if (flow.State != GameState.Wave)
                return;
            monsters.TickSpawn(dt);
            monsters.TickMove(dt);
            bool stillWave = flow.State == GameState.Wave;
            monsters.Cleanup();
            if (stillWave)
                flow.CheckWaveClear();
        }

        void BeginWave(int count, float interval = 1f)
        {
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", count, interval, 0f) }, 1);
        }

        MonsterHandle SpawnOne()
        {
            BeginWave(1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, board.MonstersAtPath(0).Count);
            return board.MonstersAtPath(0)[0];
        }

        [Test]
        public void Spawn_TenNormals_OneSecondApart()
        {
            BeginWave(10);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, monsters.AliveCount, "첫 마리는 바로");
            monsters.TickSpawn(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, monsters.AliveCount);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, monsters.AliveCount, "1초 뒤 두 번째");
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                monsters.TickSpawn(1f);
            Assert.AreEqual(10, monsters.AliveCount);
            Assert.IsTrue(monsters.SpawnFinished);
            monsters.TickSpawn(5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(10, monsters.AliveCount, "구성표 수보다 더 나오지 않음");

            var m = monsters.Get(board.MonstersAtPath(0)[0]);
            Assert.AreEqual("normal", m.Def.id);
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, m.Hp);
            Assert.AreEqual(MonsterState.Alive, m.State);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Move_UpdatesPathIndexAndCellBuckets()
        {
            var h = SpawnOne();
            monsters.TickMove(0.5f); // speed 1칸/초
            var m = monsters.Get(h);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, m.PathIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.5f, m.PathProgress, 1e-5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, board.MonstersAtPath(0).Count, "칸이 안 바뀌면 그대로");

            monsters.TickMove(0.6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, m.PathIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, board.MonstersAtPath(0).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, board.MonstersAtPath(1).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(h, board.MonstersAtPath(1)[0]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReachExit_ExitedThenNexusDamage_NoReward_ThenCleanup()
        {
            var h = SpawnOne();
            for (int i = 0; i < 79; i++)
                monsters.TickMove(0.1f); // 7.9칸
            Assert.AreEqual(20, player.NexusHp);

            monsters.TickMove(0.2f);     // 8칸 = 출구 칸
            Assert.AreEqual(MonsterState.Exited, monsters.Get(h).State);
            Assert.AreEqual(19, player.NexusHp, "nexusDamage 1");
            Assert.AreEqual(100, player.Cash, "도착은 보상 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.AliveCount);
            for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
                Assert.AreEqual(0, board.MonstersAtPath(i).Count, "Board 목록에서 제거");

            monsters.Cleanup();
            Assert.IsFalse(monsters.IsValid(h), "정리 후 핸들 무효");
            Assert.IsNull(monsters.Get(h));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TwentyArrivals_GameOver_DefeatedOnce()
        {
            flow.RequestStartGame();
            flow.StartNow(); // 1층 1웨이브: 10마리
            Assert.AreEqual(10, monsters.RemainingToSpawn);

            int guard = 0;
            while (flow.State == GameState.Wave && guard++ < 10000)
                Frame(0.05f);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.FloorTransition, flow.State, "10마리 도착 후 웨이브 클리어 (1층은 1웨이브)");
            Assert.AreEqual(10, player.NexusHp);

            flow.Tick(config.floorTransitionSec + 0.01f); // 같은 Tier → 2층 휴식
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Break, flow.State);
            flow.StartNow(); // 2층 1웨이브: 10마리
            guard = 0;
            while (flow.State == GameState.Wave && guard++ < 10000)
                Frame(0.05f);

            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State, "20마리 도착 → GameOver");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, player.NexusHp);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, defeatedEvents);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.CreatedDuringWave, "웨이브 중 풀 생성 없음");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Spawn_UsesFloorWaveHpScale()
        {
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 10, 5));
            var h = SpawnOne();
            Assert.AreEqual(37f, monsters.Get(h).Hp, "10층 5웨이브 일반 몬스터 = 37 (HpLevelDesign)");

            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
            BeginWave(1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var fresh = board.MonstersAtPath(0)[board.MonstersAtPath(0).Count - 1];
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, monsters.Get(fresh).Hp, "1층 1웨이브 = 기본 체력 4");
        }

        [Test]
        public void ApplyDamage_DamagedThenKilled_RewardOnce()
        {
            var h = SpawnOne();
            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Damaged, monsters.ApplyDamage(h, new DamageInfo(1, DamageType.Normal)));
            Assert.AreEqual(3f, monsters.Get(h).Hp);

            // 같은 프레임에 두 번 맞아 죽음 (오버킬 포함)
            var r1 = monsters.ApplyDamage(h, new DamageInfo(80, DamageType.Normal));
            var r2 = monsters.ApplyDamage(h, new DamageInfo(80, DamageType.Normal));
            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Killed, r1);
            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Ignored, r2, "Dying은 무시");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, killedEvents, "Killed 1번");
            Assert.AreEqual(105, player.Cash, "처치 보상 5, 1번만");
            Assert.AreEqual(MonsterState.Dying, monsters.Get(h).State);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, board.MonstersAtPath(0).Count, "사망 즉시 Board 목록에서 제거");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.AliveCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ApplyDamage_TwoKillingHitsSameFrame_KilledOnce()
        {
            var h = SpawnOne();
            var r1 = monsters.ApplyDamage(h, new DamageInfo(100, DamageType.Normal));
            var r2 = monsters.ApplyDamage(h, new DamageInfo(100, DamageType.Normal));
            Assert.AreEqual((DamageResult.Killed, DamageResult.Ignored), (r1, r2));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, killedEvents);
        }

        [Test]
        public void OldHandle_OnReusedMonster_IsIgnored()
        {
            var old = SpawnOne();
            monsters.ApplyDamage(old, new DamageInfo(100, DamageType.Normal));
            monsters.Cleanup(); // 풀 반납

            var fresh = SpawnOne(); // 같은 객체가 재사용된다 (풀 스택)
            Assert.AreEqual(old.Index, fresh.Index, "같은 객체 재사용");
            Assert.AreNotEqual(old.Generation, fresh.Generation, "Generation +1");
            Assert.IsFalse(monsters.IsValid(old));
            Assert.IsTrue(monsters.IsValid(fresh));

            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Ignored, monsters.ApplyDamage(old, new DamageInfo(100, DamageType.Normal)));
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, monsters.Get(fresh).Hp, "새 몬스터는 피해 없음");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, killedEvents);
        }

        [Test]
        public void InvalidHandles_AreIgnored()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Ignored, monsters.ApplyDamage(MonsterHandle.None, new DamageInfo(10, DamageType.Normal)));
            Assert.AreEqual(DamageResult.Ignored, monsters.ApplyDamage(new MonsterHandle(99999, 1), new DamageInfo(10, DamageType.Normal)));
            Assert.IsFalse(monsters.IsValid(new MonsterHandle(0, 0)), "한 번도 안 나온 몬스터");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pool_PrewarmedAtInit_AndRefilledInBreak()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(config.performance.monsterPoolPrewarm, monsters.CreatedCount);
            monsters.Prewarm(400); // 휴식 때 부족분 채움
            Assert.AreEqual(400, monsters.CreatedCount);
            monsters.Prewarm(100);
            Assert.AreEqual(400, monsters.CreatedCount, "충분하면 더 만들지 않음");
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaveTicks_AllocateNothing()
        {
            BeginWave(290, 0.01f);
            // 예열 (JIT·첫 호출 비용 제외)
            monsters.TickSpawn(0.01f);
            monsters.TickMove(0.01f);
            monsters.Cleanup();

            long before = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread();
            for (int frame = 0; frame < 600; frame++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.02f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.02f);
                monsters.Cleanup();
            }
            long allocated = GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread() - before;

            Assert.AreEqual(0, allocated, "웨이브 중 Tick 할당");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.CreatedDuringWave);
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 복잡성 가중치 맵 생성 (꺾임 수·스타트 지점 1~3개)과 여러 경로에서의 게임 동작.
    public class MultiPathTests
    {
        static readonly int[] SizeOf = { 0, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15 }; // 복잡성 → 맵 크기 (진행 표)

        MapGenRules rules;
        GameConfig config;
        LayoutMapGenerator generator;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            rules = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset");
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            generator = new LayoutMapGenerator();
        }

        MapData Gen(int complexity, int seed) => generator.Generate(new MapSpec(SizeOf[complexity], complexity, seed, rules));

        static int Turns(List<Vector2Int> path)
        {
            int turns = 0;
            for (int i = 2; i < path.Count; i++)
                if (path[i] - path[i - 1] != path[i - 1] - path[i - 2])
                    turns++;
            return turns;
        }

        // ---------- 생성 ----------

        [Test]
        public void Generate_EveryComplexity_FollowsTable([NUnit.Framework.Range(1, 5)] int complexity)
        {
            var level = rules.GetLevel(complexity);
            var validator = new LayoutMapValidator();
            for (int seed = 1; seed <= 50; seed++)
            {
                var map = Gen(complexity, seed);
                Assert.IsNotNull(map, $"복잡성 {complexity} seed {seed} 생성 실패");
                var report = validator.Validate(map, rules);
                Assert.IsTrue(report.IsValid, $"복잡성 {complexity} seed {seed}: {(report.IsValid ? "" : report.Violations[0].Detail)}");

                Assert.AreEqual(level.spawns, map.Spawns.Length, "스타트 지점 수");
                Assert.AreEqual(level.spawns, map.MonsterPaths.Count, "스타트 지점마다 경로");
                Assert.AreEqual(level.spawns - 1, map.Junctions.Count, "지선마다 합류 지점");
                int turns = Turns(map.MonsterPaths[0]);
                Assert.That(turns, Is.InRange(level.mainTurnsMin, level.mainTurnsMax), $"본선 꺾임 seed {seed}");

                for (int k = 0; k < map.MonsterPaths.Count; k++)
                {
                    var path = map.MonsterPaths[k];
                    Assert.AreEqual(map.Spawns[k], path[0], "경로 첫 칸 = 그 스타트 지점");
                    Assert.AreEqual(map.Exit, path[path.Count - 1], "모든 경로는 같은 출구로");
                    Assert.AreEqual(TileType.Spawn, map.Tiles[path[0].x, path[0].y]);
                }
                foreach (var j in map.Junctions)
                    CollectionAssert.Contains(map.MonsterPaths[0], j, "합류 지점은 본선 위");
            }
        }

        // 넥서스는 스타트 지점이 몰린 변의 반대쪽. 상하·좌우 비율이 같으면 본선이 최대 길이(2N−3칸)로 돌아가고
        // 모든 스타트 지점이 넥서스에서 N−1칸 이상 떨어진다.
        [Test]
        public void Nexus_OppositeSpawnMajority_OrMaxDetourWhenBalanced([NUnit.Framework.Range(1, 5)] int complexity)
        {
            int n = SizeOf[complexity], balanced = 0;
            for (int seed = 0; seed < 100; seed++)
            {
                var map = Gen(complexity, 300 + seed);
                Assert.IsNotNull(map);
                int vx = 0, vy = 0;
                foreach (var sp in map.Spawns)
                {
                    if (sp.x == 0) vx++; else if (sp.x == n - 1) vx--;
                    else if (sp.y == 0) vy++; else if (sp.y == n - 1) vy--;
                }
                var exit = map.Exit;
                if (System.Math.Abs(vx) != System.Math.Abs(vy))
                {
                    bool opposite = System.Math.Abs(vx) > System.Math.Abs(vy)
                        ? (vx > 0 ? exit.x == n - 1 : exit.x == 0)
                        : (vy > 0 ? exit.y == n - 1 : exit.y == 0);
                    Assert.IsTrue(opposite, $"복잡성 {complexity} 시드 {seed}: 넥서스 {exit}가 스타트 지점 쪽 반대가 아님");
                    continue;
                }
                balanced++;
                Assert.GreaterOrEqual(map.MonsterPaths[0].Count, 2 * n - 3, $"복잡성 {complexity} 시드 {seed}: 비슷한 비율인데 최대로 돌아가지 않음");
                foreach (var sp in map.Spawns)
                    Assert.GreaterOrEqual(System.Math.Abs(sp.x - exit.x) + System.Math.Abs(sp.y - exit.y), n - 1, $"스타트 지점 {sp}가 넥서스와 가까움");
            }
            TestContext.WriteLine($"복잡성 {complexity}: 비슷한 비율(최대 우회) {balanced}/100");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Generate_SameSeed_SameMap()
        {
            for (int c = 1; c <= 5; c++)
            {
                var a = Gen(c, 77);
                var b = Gen(c, 77);
                CollectionAssert.AreEqual(a.Tiles, b.Tiles, $"복잡성 {c}");
                for (int k = 0; k < a.MonsterPaths.Count; k++)
                    CollectionAssert.AreEqual(a.MonsterPaths[k], b.MonsterPaths[k]);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Complexity_AddsSpawns_At2And4()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(new[] { 1, 2, 2, 3, 3 },
                new[] { rules.GetLevel(1).spawns, rules.GetLevel(2).spawns, rules.GetLevel(3).spawns, rules.GetLevel(4).spawns, rules.GetLevel(5).spawns });
        }

        // ---------- 게임 동작 ----------

        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef basic;

        void SetUpGame(MapData map)
        {
            basic = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            var normal = TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
            var data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, rules, new[] { normal }, new[] { basic });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            run.Cash = 100000;
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(map);
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
        }

        List<MonsterInstance> Alive()
        {
            var list = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            var seen = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int k = 0; k < board.PathCount; k++)
                for (int i = 0; i < board.GetPathLength(k); i++)
                    foreach (var h in board.MonstersAt(board.PathCellId(i, k)))
                    {
                        var m = monsters.Get(h);
                        if (m != null && m.State == MonsterState.Alive && seen.Add(m.Index))
                            list.Add(m);
                    }
            return list;
        }

        [Test]
        public void Spawns_Alternate_BetweenStartPoints()
        {
            var map = Gen(4, 3); // 스타트 지점 3개
            SetUpGame(map);
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 6, 0.1f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(10f); // 6마리 모두 스폰
            var perSpawn = new int[3];
            foreach (var m in Alive())
            {
                perSpawn[m.PathId]++;
                Assert.AreEqual(map.Spawns[m.PathId], board.GetPathCell(m.PathId, 0));
            }
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 2, 2, 2 }, perSpawn, "스타트 지점 3개에 번갈아 2마리씩");
        }

        [Test]
        public void MonstersFromDifferentPaths_ShareCellBucket_AfterJunction()
        {
            var map = Gen(2, 5);
            SetUpGame(map);
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 40, 0.25f, 0f) }, 1);
            bool shared = false;
            for (int step = 0; step < 400 && !shared; step++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.05f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.05f);
                monsters.Cleanup();
                foreach (var cell in map.MonsterPaths[0])
                {
                    var bucket = board.MonstersAt(board.CellId(cell));
                    var ids = new HashSet<int>();
                    foreach (var h in bucket)
                        ids.Add(monsters.Get(h).PathId);
                    if (ids.Count >= 2)
                        shared = true;
                }
            }
            Assert.IsTrue(shared, "합류 뒤 본선 칸에 서로 다른 스타트 지점 몬스터가 함께 담김");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Tower_CoversBranchAndMainCells_TargetsClosestToExit()
        {
            var map = Gen(2, 5);
            SetUpGame(map);
            var junction = map.Junctions[0];
            var branchCells = new HashSet<Vector2Int>(map.MonsterPaths[1]);
            branchCells.ExceptWith(map.MonsterPaths[0]);

            // 합류 지점 근처 부지 (사거리 안에 지선 칸과 본선 칸이 모두 있는 곳)
            Vector2Int site = default;
            bool found = false;
            for (int x = 0; x < map.N && !found; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < map.N && !found; y++)
                {
                    var c = new Vector2Int(x, y);
                    if (board.IsBuildable(c) && Mathf.Max(Mathf.Abs(c.x - junction.x), Mathf.Abs(c.y - junction.y)) <= 1)
                    {
                        site = c;
                        found = true;
                    }
                }
            Assert.IsTrue(found, "합류 지점 옆 부지");
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, basic));
            var tower = towers.GetTowerAt(site);

            bool coversBranch = false, coversMainAfter = false;
            foreach (int id in tower.Covered)
            {
                var cell = new Vector2Int(id / map.N, id % map.N);
                if (branchCells.Contains(cell)) coversBranch = true;
                int idx = map.MonsterPaths[0].IndexOf(cell);
                if (idx > map.MonsterPaths[0].IndexOf(junction)) coversMainAfter = true;
            }
            Assert.IsTrue(coversBranch, "지선 칸도 사거리에 포함");
            Assert.IsTrue(coversMainAfter, "합류 뒤 본선 칸도 포함");

            // 두 경로에서 몬스터를 흘려 보낸 뒤 대상 = 사거리 안에서 출구까지 가장 적게 남은 몬스터
            // (사거리는 타워가 바라보는 쪽 앞 칸만이라, 몬스터가 그 칸들에 2마리 이상 들어올 때까지 흘려 보낸다)
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 30, 0.2f, 0f) }, 1);
            var inRange = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            for (int step = 0; step < 400 && inRange.Count < 2; step++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.05f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.05f);
                inRange = Alive().FindAll(m => tower.CoversCell[m.CellId]);
            }
            Assume.That(inRange.Count, Is.GreaterThan(1), "사거리 안 몬스터 2마리 이상일 때만 의미 있음");
            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            var target = monsters.Get(tower.Locked);
            Assert.IsNotNull(target);
            foreach (var m in inRange)
                Assert.LessOrEqual(target.Remaining, m.Remaining + 1e-4f, "First = 출구에 가장 가까운 몬스터 (경로가 달라도)");
        }
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 나노봇 타워: 연발 7발, 첫 발이 맞은 자리에 감속 나노필드. 피해는 탄이 맞은 몬스터만.
    // 고정 7×7 맵 경로: 0(3,0) 1(3,1) 2(3,2) 3(4,2) 4(5,2) 5(5,3) 6(5,4) 7(5,5) 8(5,6)
    public class NanoFieldTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef nano;

        static readonly Vector2Int Site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            nano = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            nano.id = "nanoTest";
            nano.buildCost = 50;
            nano.damage = 0.3f;
            nano.interval = 2.3f;
            nano.range = 2;
            nano.burstCount = 7;
            nano.burstGap = 0.045f;
            nano.attackType = AttackType.Projectile;
            nano.projectileSpeed = 9f;
            nano.projectileTurnSpeed = 1080f;
            nano.fieldRadius = 1f;
            nano.fieldDuration = 3f;
            nano.fieldSlow = 0.6f;

            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { nano });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            player.Earn(1000, CashReason.Kill);
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown() => Object.DestroyImmediate(nano);

        MonsterInstance SpawnOne()
        {
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 1, 0f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var cell = board.MonstersAtPath(0);
            return monsters.Get(cell[cell.Count - 1]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SlowField_InsideMovesAt40Percent_ExpiresAfterDuration()
        {
            var m = SpawnOne();
            monsters.AddSlowField(monsters.GetGroundPoint(m), 1f, 0.6f, 3f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4f, monsters.GetSpeedMultiplier(m), 1e-5f, "60% 감속 → 40% 속도");
            monsters.TickMove(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.2f, m.PathProgress, 1e-4f, "속도 1 × 0.4 × 0.5초");

            // 원 밖 (반지름 1칸)으로 나가면 원래 속도
            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) monsters.TickMove(0.1f); // 누적 3.5초 → 필드 만료
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.ActiveSlowFields, "3초 뒤 사라짐");
            float before = m.PathProgress;
            monsters.TickMove(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(before + 0.5f, m.PathProgress, 1e-4f, "만료 뒤 원래 속도");
        }

        [Test]
        public void SlowFields_DoNotStack_StrongestWins()
        {
            var m = SpawnOne();
            var p = monsters.GetGroundPoint(m);
            monsters.AddSlowField(p, 1f, 0.6f, 3f);
            monsters.AddSlowField(p, 1f, 0.3f, 3f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4f, monsters.GetSpeedMultiplier(m), 1e-5f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Volley_SevenShots_OneField_DamageOnlyToHitMonster()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, nano));
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 2, 0f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var cell = board.MonstersAtPath(0);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, cell.Count);
            var a = monsters.Get(cell[0]);
            var b = monsters.Get(cell[1]);

            int guard = 0;
            towers.TickCombat(0f); // 첫 발
            while ((towers.Towers[0].BurstLeft > 0 || towers.ProjectileCount > 0) && guard++ < 500)
                towers.TickCombat(0.01f);

            Assert.AreEqual(1, monsters.ActiveSlowFields, "연발 7발이라도 필드는 첫 발 자리에 1개");
            float hpA = a.Hp, hpB = b.Hp;
            float full = 4f;
            Assert.IsTrue((Mathf.Abs(hpA - (full - 7 * 0.3f)) < 1e-3f && hpB == full) || (Mathf.Abs(hpB - (full - 7 * 0.3f)) < 1e-3f && hpA == full),
                $"피해는 고정 대상 1마리에게만 7 × 0.3 (a {hpA}, b {hpB})");
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4f, monsters.GetSpeedMultiplier(a), 1e-5f, "필드 안: 둘 다 느려짐");
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4f, monsters.GetSpeedMultiplier(b), 1e-5f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FloorTransition_ClearsFields()
        {
            var m = SpawnOne();
            monsters.AddSlowField(monsters.GetGroundPoint(m), 1f, 0.6f, 3f);
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, monsters.ActiveSlowFields);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, monsters.GetSpeedMultiplier(m));
        }
    }
}

    using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 작업 10: 최적화 규칙 검사 (GDD 8-5).
    public class OptimizationTests
    {
        // ---------- Update는 GameLoop 하나 ----------

        [Test]
        public void OnlyGameLoop_HasUpdateMethods()
        {
            var names = new[] { "Update", "LateUpdate", "FixedUpdate" };
            const BindingFlags flags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
            var offenders = new List<string>();
            foreach (var type in typeof(GameLoop).Assembly.GetTypes())
            {
                if (!typeof(MonoBehaviour).IsAssignableFrom(type))
                    continue;
                foreach (var method in type.GetMethods(flags))
                    if (names.Contains(method.Name) && method.GetParameters().Length == 0)
                        offenders.Add($"{type.FullName}.{method.Name}");
            }
            CollectionAssert.AreEquivalent(new[] { "TowerDefence.GameLoop.Update" }, offenders,
                "프로젝트에서 Update 계열 메서드를 가진 MonoBehaviour는 GameLoop 하나여야 한다");
        }

        // ---------- 특수 몬스터 혼합은 데이터만으로 ----------

        [Test]
        public void DesignedWave_MixesSpecialMonsters_FromDataOnly()
        {
            var config = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameConfig>();
            try
            {
                config.waves = new[]
                {
                    new GameConfig.DesignedWave
                    {
                        floor = 46, wave = 3,
                        lines = new[]
                        {
                            new GameConfig.SpawnLine { monsterId = "fast", count = 145, intervalSec = 0.1f },
                            new GameConfig.SpawnLine { monsterId = "tank", count = 145, intervalSec = 0.1f, delaySec = 2f },
                        },
                    },
                };
                var buffer = new WaveSpawn[8];

                int lines = LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, 46, 3, 300, buffer);
                Assert.AreEqual(2, lines);
                Assert.AreEqual("fast", buffer[0].MonsterId);
                Assert.AreEqual(145, buffer[0].Count);
                Assert.AreEqual("tank", buffer[1].MonsterId);
                Assert.AreEqual(2f, buffer[1].DelaySec);

                // 표에 없는 웨이브는 공식 규칙 그대로 (일반 몬스터 + 돌격조)
                lines = LevelRules.GetWaveComposition(config, 46, 1, 300, buffer);
                Assert.AreEqual(2, lines);
                Assert.AreEqual(config.rules.runnerMonsterId, buffer[1].MonsterId);
                Assert.AreEqual(LevelRules.RunnerCount(config, 46), buffer[1].Count);
                Assert.AreEqual(config.rules.defaultMonsterId, buffer[0].MonsterId);
                Assert.AreEqual(LevelRules.MonsterCount(config, 300), buffer[0].Count);
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(config);
            }
        }

        // ---------- 다시 시작 10번 ----------

        GameObject loopGo, canvasGo;
        GameLoop loop;

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            if (loopGo != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(loopGo);
            if (canvasGo != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(canvasGo);
            foreach (var name in new[] { "Monsters", "Towers", "BuildOverlay" })
            {
                var go = GameObject.Find(name);
                while (go != null)
                {
                    Object.DestroyImmediate(go);
                    go = GameObject.Find(name);
                }
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Restart10Times_NoDuplicateHandlers_NoGrowth()
        {
            CreateLoop();
            var flow = Field<GameFlow>("flow");
            var board = Field<Board>("board");
            var monsters = Field<MonsterManager>("monsters");
            var towers = Field<TowerManager>("towers");
            var player = Field<PlayerState>("player");
            var managers = new object[]
            {
                flow, Field<MapProvider>("maps"), board, monsters, towers, player,
                Field<BuildController>("build"), Field<GameUI>("ui"),
            };

            Snapshot first = default, second = default;
            for (int cycle = 1; cycle <= 11; cycle++)
            {
                PlayOneRun(flow, board, monsters, towers, player);
                flow.RequestRestart(); // GameOver → [다시 시작] → GameLoop.StartNewRun
                Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Ready, flow.State, $"{cycle}번째 다시 시작 후 Ready");

                var snap = TakeSnapshot(managers, monsters, towers);
                if (cycle == 1)
                {
                    first = snap; // 첫 판에서 풀이 다음 웨이브 수만큼 채워지는 것은 허용
                    continue;
                }
                if (cycle == 2)
                    second = snap;

                Assert.AreEqual(first.Handlers, snap.Handlers, $"{cycle}번째: 이벤트 핸들러 수가 늘었다 (중복 구독)");
                Assert.AreEqual(first.Monsters, snap.Monsters, $"{cycle}번째: 몬스터 데이터 풀이 늘었다");
                Assert.AreEqual(first.Views, snap.Views, $"{cycle}번째: 표시 오브젝트(몬스터·타워·투사체·이펙트)가 늘었다");
                Assert.AreEqual(first.SceneObjects, snap.SceneObjects, $"{cycle}번째: 씬 GameObject 수가 늘었다");
                if (cycle == 11)
                {
                    long growth = snap.Memory - second.Memory;
                    TestContext.WriteLine($"관리 메모리 2→11번째: {second.Memory / 1024}KB → {snap.Memory / 1024}KB ({growth / 1024}KB)");
                    Assert.Less(growth, 1024 * 1024, "다시 시작 10번 동안 관리 메모리가 1MB 넘게 늘었다");
                }
            }
        }

        struct Snapshot
        {
            public int Handlers, Monsters, Views, SceneObjects;
            public long Memory;
        }

        static Snapshot TakeSnapshot(object[] managers, MonsterManager monsters, TowerManager towers)
        {
            int handlers = 0;
            foreach (var m in managers)
                foreach (var f in m.GetType().GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public))
                    if (typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(f.FieldType) && f.GetValue(m) is Delegate d)
                        handlers += d.GetInvocationList().Length;
            return new Snapshot
            {
                Handlers = handlers,
                Monsters = monsters.CreatedCount,
                Views = monsters.ViewsCreated + towers.TowerViewsCreated + towers.ProjectileViewsCreated + towers.EffectViewsCreated,
                SceneObjects = Object.FindObjectsByType<Transform>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None).Length,
                Memory = GC.GetTotalMemory(true),
            };
        }

        // 한 판: 맵 준비 → 시작 → 타워 2개 → 웨이브(스폰·이동·전투) → 넥서스 체력 0 → GameOver.
        static void PlayOneRun(GameFlow flow, Board board, MonsterManager monsters, TowerManager towers, PlayerState player)
        {
            var until = DateTime.Now.AddSeconds(5);
            while (board.Map == null && DateTime.Now < until)
            {
                flow.Tick(0f); // MapProvider.Poll → TierReady → Board.Load
                System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(5);
            }
            Assert.IsNotNull(board.Map, "맵 준비");

            flow.RequestStartGame();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Break, flow.State);
            var basic = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            int built = 0;
            for (int x = 0; x < board.N && built < 2; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < board.N && built < 2; y++)
                    if (towers.Build(new Vector2Int(x, y), basic))
                        built++;

            flow.StartNow();
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.Wave, flow.State);
            monsters.TickSpawn(3f);
            monsters.TickMove(0.5f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.1f);
            monsters.Cleanup();
            monsters.TickViews(0.1f);
            towers.TickViews(0.1f);

            player.TakeNexusDamage(player.NexusHp);
            Assert.AreEqual(GameState.GameOver, flow.State);
        }

        void CreateLoop()
        {
            canvasGo = new GameObject("TestCanvas", typeof(Canvas), typeof(UnityEngine.UI.CanvasScaler));
            loopGo = new GameObject("TestGameLoop");
            loop = loopGo.AddComponent<GameLoop>(); // 에디터 모드라 Awake가 자동으로 불리지 않는다
            var so = new SerializedObject(loop);
            so.FindProperty("config").objectReferenceValue = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            so.FindProperty("mapGenRules").objectReferenceValue = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset");
            var mons = so.FindProperty("monsterDefs");
            mons.arraySize = 1;
            mons.GetArrayElementAtIndex(0).objectReferenceValue = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
            var tows = so.FindProperty("towerDefs");
            tows.arraySize = 1;
            tows.GetArrayElementAtIndex(0).objectReferenceValue = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            so.FindProperty("canvas").objectReferenceValue = canvasGo.GetComponent<Canvas>();
            so.FindProperty("useFixedTestMap").boolValue = true;
            so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            typeof(GameLoop).GetMethod("Awake", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).Invoke(loop, null);
            Field<GameFlow>("flow").LogStates = false;

            // 에디터 모드에서는 풀이 미리 만든 타워 표시의 Awake(TowerAim 시작 자세 저장)도 불리지 않으므로 직접 부른다.
            var aimAwake = typeof(TowerAim).GetMethod("Awake", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            foreach (var aim in Object.FindObjectsByType<TowerAim>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None))
                aimAwake.Invoke(aim, null);
        }

        T Field<T>(string name) =>
            (T)typeof(GameLoop).GetField(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(loop);
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 이상효과 (MonsterManager.ApplyDamage): 화상·분진·백린·서리(얼음)·정전기(감전). 타워 없이 피해 값만 넣어 본다.
    public class StatusEffectTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        PlayerState player;
        MonsterDef normal;
        MonsterInstance target;
        int stunnedEvents;
        float lastStun;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            normal = TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset");
            normal.traits = new string[0];
            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"), new[] { normal }, new TowerDef[0]);
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            monsters.DebugHpOverride = 100;
            monsters.Stunned += e => { stunnedEvents++; lastStun = e.Duration; };
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 1, 0f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            target = monsters.Get(board.MonstersAtPath(0)[0]);
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown() => Object.DestroyImmediate(normal);

        void Hit(float damage, StatusEffect s) => monsters.ApplyDamage(target.Handle, new DamageInfo(damage, DamageType.Normal, null, 1f, s));

        [Test]
        public void Burn_FiveHitsPerStack_ThreeStacksDeal20Percent_ThenCooldown()
        {
            var burn = new StatusEffect { kind = StatusKind.Burn, hitsPerStack = 5, procStacks = 3, procDamageRatio = 0.2f, cooldown = 1f };
            for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++)
                Hit(1f, burn);
            Assert.AreEqual(86f, target.Hp, 1e-4f, "14번: 화상 2스택 (발동 전)");
            Hit(1f, burn);
            Assert.AreEqual(100f - 15f - 0.2f, target.Hp, 1e-4f, "15번째: 3스택 → 공격력 20% 추가 피해");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, target.BurnStacks, "스택 제거");
            for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
                Hit(1f, burn);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, target.BurnStacks + target.BurnHits, "쿨타임 1초 동안은 쌓이지 않음");
            monsters.TickMove(1.01f);
            Hit(1f, burn);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, target.BurnHits, "쿨타임 뒤 다시 센다");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Dust_FiveStacksDeal50Percent_MechanicalBonus30()
        {
            var dust = new StatusEffect { kind = StatusKind.Dust, procStacks = 5, procDamageRatio = 0.5f, cooldown = 5f };
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                Hit(2f, dust);
            Assert.AreEqual(100f - 10f - 1f, target.Hp, 1e-4f, "5스택 → 공격력 50% 추가 피해");

            normal.traits = new[] { "mechanical" };
            float hp = target.Hp;
            monsters.ApplyDamage(target.Handle, new DamageInfo(2f, DamageType.Normal, "mechanical", 1.3f, dust));
            Assert.AreEqual(hp - 2.6f, target.Hp, 1e-4f, "기계 +30%");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Phosphorus_StacksBurnEverySecond_CappedAt20Percent()
        {
            var phos = new StatusEffect { kind = StatusKind.Phosphorus, dotPerStack = 0.001f, dotMax = 0.2f, dotInterval = 1f };
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
                Hit(1f, phos); // 10스택 = 초당 공격력의 1%
            float hp = target.Hp;
            monsters.TickMove(1f);
            Assert.AreEqual(hp - 0.01f, target.Hp, 1e-5f, "10스택: 1초에 공격력 × 1%");

            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++)
                Hit(0f, phos); // 공격력 0으로 스택만 (기준 공격력도 0이 되므로 아래에서 다시 1로)
            Hit(1f, phos);
            hp = target.Hp;
            monsters.TickMove(1f);
            Assert.AreEqual(hp - 0.2f, target.Hp, 1e-5f, "최대 20%");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Frost_ThreeStacksFreezeOneSecond_BiologicalTwo()
        {
            var frost = new StatusEffect { kind = StatusKind.Frost, procStacks = 3, stunSec = 1f, stunBonusTrait = "biological", stunBonusSec = 1f };
            Hit(1f, frost);
            Hit(1f, frost);
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, target.StunTime);
            Hit(1f, frost);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, target.StunTime, 1e-4f, "3스택 → 얼음 1초");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, stunnedEvents, "이펙트 이벤트");

            float progress = target.PathProgress;
            monsters.TickMove(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(progress, target.PathProgress, 1e-5f, "얼어 있는 동안 안 움직인다");
            Hit(1f, frost);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, target.FrostStacks, "얼어 있는 동안은 서리가 안 쌓인다");
            monsters.TickMove(0.6f);
            Assert.Greater(target.PathProgress, progress, "풀리면 다시 걷는다 (남은 0.1초만큼)");

            normal.traits = new[] { "biological" };
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                Hit(1f, frost);
            Assert.AreEqual(2f, lastStun, 1e-4f, "생물 +1초");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Static_ThreeStacksShock_MechanicalTwoSeconds()
        {
            var shock = new StatusEffect { kind = StatusKind.Static, procStacks = 3, stunSec = 1f, stunBonusTrait = "mechanical", stunBonusSec = 1f };
            normal.traits = new[] { "mechanical" };
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                Hit(1f, shock);
            Assert.AreEqual(2f, target.StunTime, 1e-4f, "기계 감전 2초");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, target.StaticStacks);
        }
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 테크트리(진화)와 층 클리어 아이템. 기본 GameConfig 복사본에서 두 기능을 켜고 표시 없이 판정만 본다.
    // 고정 7×7 맵 경로: 0(3,0) 1(3,1) 2(3,2) 3(4,2) 4(5,2) 5(5,3) 6(5,4) 7(5,5) 8(5,6)
    public class TechTreeItemTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        RunState run;
        TowerDef t1, t2, t3;

        static readonly Vector2Int Site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);

        static TowerDef MakeDef(string id, int tier, int totalCost, float damage, string next, int unlockFloor)
        {
            var d = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            d.id = id;
            d.tier = tier;
            d.buildCost = totalCost;
            d.damage = damage;
            d.interval = 1f;
            d.range = 2;
            d.attackType = AttackType.Hitscan;
            d.upgradeTo = next != null ? new[] { next } : new string[0];
            d.unlockFloor = unlockFloor;
            return d;
        }

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = Object.Instantiate(AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset"));
            config.upgradeEnabled = true;
            config.upgradeFree = false; // 차액 계산을 본다 (기본 설정은 임시로 무료)
            config.floorItems.enabled = true;
            config.floorItems.damagePerItem = 0.10f;
            config.floorItems.speedPerItem = 0.08f;
            t1 = MakeDef("t1", 1, 50, 1f, "t2", 1);
            t2 = MakeDef("t2", 2, 120, 2f, "t3", 3);
            t3 = MakeDef("t3", 3, 270, 4f, null, 7);

            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { t1, t2, t3 });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            player.Earn(1000, CashReason.Kill);
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            Object.DestroyImmediate(t1);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(t2);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(t3);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(config);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_PaysDifference_ReplacesTowerInPlace()
        {
            run.Floor = 3;
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            int cash = player.Cash;
            Assert.AreEqual(t2, towers.GetUpgrade(t1));
            Assert.AreEqual(70, towers.GetUpgradeCost(t1, t2));

            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site)));
            Assert.AreEqual(cash - 70, player.Cash, "차액 70만 낸다");
            Assert.AreEqual(t2, towers.GetTowerAt(Site).Def, "같은 칸에 2단계");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.Towers.Count);
            Assert.IsFalse(board.IsBuildable(Site), "칸 점유 유지");
            Assert.AreEqual(Mathf.RoundToInt(120 * config.sellRefundRate), towers.GetSellRefund(towers.GetTowerAt(Site).Def), "판매는 누적 비용 기준");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_BeforeUnlockFloor_Refused()
        {
            run.Floor = 2;
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            int cash = player.Cash;
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.IsUpgradeUnlocked(t2));
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site)));
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash);
            Assert.AreEqual(t1, towers.GetTowerAt(Site).Def);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_Branches_PickAnyOption_PaysDifference()
        {
            t1.upgradeTo = new[] { "t2", "t3", "missing" }; // 게임에 없는 id는 건너뛴다
            run.Floor = 7;
            var options = new System.Collections.Generic.List<TowerDef>();
            towers.GetUpgrades(t1, options);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { t2, t3 }, options);
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.IsUpgradeOption(t1, t3));
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.IsUpgradeOption(t2, t1), "거꾸로는 안 된다");

            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            int cash = player.Cash;
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site), t3), "두 번째 갈래로 진화");
            Assert.AreEqual(t3, towers.GetTowerAt(Site).Def);
            Assert.AreEqual(cash - (270 - 50), player.Cash, "차액만");
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site), t2), "t3에서 t2는 갈래가 아님");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_FreeFlag_CostsNothing()
        {
            config.upgradeFree = true;
            run.Floor = 3; // t2 해금 층
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            int cash = player.Cash;
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.GetUpgradeCost(t1, t2));
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site)));
            Assert.AreEqual(cash, player.Cash, "임시 무료 진화");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_LastTier_OrDisabled_HasNoNext()
        {
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetUpgrade(t3), "마지막 단계");
            config.upgradeEnabled = false;
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetUpgrade(t1), "테크트리 꺼짐 (SampleScene)");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Upgrade_NotEnoughCash_Refused()
        {
            run.Floor = 3;
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            player.Spend(player.Cash - 69, CashReason.Build);
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.Upgrade(towers.GetTowerAt(Site)));
            Assert.AreEqual(69, player.Cash);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FloorClear_GrantsAlternatingItems_NotOnGameClear()
        {
            int granted = 0;
            towers.ItemGranted += e => granted++;
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(1.10f, run.ItemDamageMul, 1e-5f, "1층 클리어 = 화력 +10%");
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 2, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(1.08f, run.ItemSpeedMul, 1e-5f, "2층 클리어 = 연사 +8%");
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.GameClear, 10, 5));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, granted);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, run.ItemCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f / 1.08f, towers.GetInterval(t1), 1e-5f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FloorItems_Disabled_NoChange()
        {
            config.floorItems.enabled = false;
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, run.ItemDamageMul);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, run.ItemCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DamageItem_AppliesToShots()
        {
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1)); // 화력 ×1.1
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, t1));
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 1, 1f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var h = board.MonstersAtPath(0)[0];
            float hp = monsters.Get(h).Hp;
            towers.TickCombat(0f);
            Assert.AreEqual(hp - 1.1f, monsters.Get(h).Hp, 1e-4f, "피해 1 × 1.1");
        }

        [Test]
        public void NewRun_ResetsItems()
        {
            towers.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.FloorTransition, 1, 1));
            var fresh = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, fresh.ItemDamageMul);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, fresh.ItemSpeedMul);
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 테스트용 에셋 도우미. 에셋 파일은 바꾸지 않고 메모리 사본만 고친다.
    static class TestAssets
    {
        // 스폰 직후 대기(Idle) 없이 바로 걷는 사본 — 이동 시간 계산이 대기 시간에 흔들리지 않게.
        public static MonsterDef NoIdleCopy(string path)
        {
            var source = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>(path);
            var copy = Object.Instantiate(source);
            copy.name = source.name;
            copy.spawnIdleSec = 0f;
            return copy;
        }
    }

    // 경로 칸 번호(본선 = 스타트 지점 0의 경로) → 칸 번호 도우미. Board 몬스터 목록·타워 사거리는 칸 번호 기준.
    static class TestBoard
    {
        public static int PathCellId(this Board board, int pathIndex, int pathId = 0) =>
            board.CellId(board.GetPathCell(pathId, pathIndex));

        public static List<MonsterHandle> MonstersAtPath(this Board board, int pathIndex, int pathId = 0) =>
            board.MonstersAt(board.PathCellId(pathIndex, pathId));

        public static bool CoversPathIndex(this TowerInstance tower, Board board, int pathIndex) =>
            tower.CoversCell[board.PathCellId(pathIndex)];
    }
}

    using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 2단계 타워: 미니건 예열(쏠수록 빨라져 초당 5발), 단발 타워(전기·냉기)는 기존 투사체 규칙 그대로.
    // 고정 7×7 맵 경로: 0(3,0) 1(3,1) 2(3,2) 3(4,2) 4(5,2) 5(5,3) 6(5,4) 7(5,5) 8(5,6)
    public class Tier2TowerTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef minigun;

        static readonly Vector2Int Site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            minigun = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            minigun.id = "minigunTest";
            minigun.tier = 2;
            minigun.buildCost = 50;
            minigun.damage = 1f;
            minigun.interval = 0.2f;
            minigun.spinUpTime = 1.5f;
            minigun.spinUpStartInterval = 0.6f;
            minigun.range = 2;
            minigun.attackType = AttackType.Hitscan; // 비행 시간 없이 발수만 센다

            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { minigun });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            player.Earn(1000, CashReason.Kill);
            monsters.DebugHpOverride = 1000; // 죽지 않고 계속 맞는 과녁
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown() => Object.DestroyImmediate(minigun);

        [Test]
        public void Minigun_SpinsUpTo5ShotsPerSecond_CoolsDownWhenIdle()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, minigun));
            var tower = towers.Towers[0];
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 1, 0f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            var target = monsters.Get(board.MonstersAtPath(0)[0]);

            const float dt = 0.01f;
            float hp0 = target.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) towers.TickCombat(dt); // 0~1초: 예열 중
            float firstSecond = hp0 - target.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) towers.TickCombat(dt); // 1~2초: 예열 끝 (1.5초)
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, tower.SpinUp, 1e-4f, "1.5초 쏘면 예열 완료");
            float hp2 = target.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) towers.TickCombat(dt); // 2~3초: 최고 연사
            float thirdSecond = hp2 - target.Hp;

            Assert.Less(firstSecond, thirdSecond, "쏠수록 빨라진다");
            Assert.That(thirdSecond, Is.InRange(4.5f, 5.5f), "최고 연사 초당 5발 × 1 피해");
            Assert.AreEqual(0.2f, towers.GetInterval(tower), 1e-4f);

            // 대상이 없으면 식는다 (예열 시간의 절반에 걸쳐)
            monsters.ApplyDamage(tower.Locked, new DamageInfo(100000, DamageType.Normal));
            monsters.Cleanup();
            for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) towers.TickCombat(dt);
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, tower.SpinUp, 1e-4f, "0.75초 쉬면 완전히 식음");
            Assert.AreEqual(0.6f, towers.GetInterval(tower), 1e-4f, "다시 느린 간격부터");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Tier2_UpgradeOnly_LinkedFromDualShotTechTree()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(2, minigun.tier);
            Assert.IsFalse(minigun.showInPalette, "기본은 진화 전용 (건축 목록에 안 나옴)");
            var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/minigun.asset");
            if (asset != null)
            {
                Assert.AreEqual(2, asset.tier);
                Assert.IsFalse(asset.showInPalette, "진화 전용: 건축 목록에 없음");
                var basicAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
                CollectionAssert.IsSubsetOf(new[] { "cryo", "electro", "minigun" }, basicAsset.upgradeTo, "듀얼샷 테크트리");
                var flameAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/flamethrower.asset");
                CollectionAssert.IsSubsetOf(new[] { "plasma", "dust", "phosphorus" }, flameAsset.upgradeTo, "화염방사 테크트리");
            }
        }
    }
}

    using System.Reflection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 타워 건축 연출 (모델@Build 클립): 조립이 끝나야 공격, 판매하면 거꾸로 분해된 뒤 풀로.
    // 실제 basic 에셋(트윈캐논 모델 + Build 클립 1.92초)과 고정 7×7 맵을 쓴다.
    public class TowerBuildAnimTests
    {
        static readonly Vector2Int Site = new Vector2Int(2, 2); // 경로 칸과 맞닿은 부지

        GameConfig config;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef basic;
        GameObject towerRoot;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            basic = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TowerDef>("Assets/Data/Towers/basic.asset");
            if (basic.buildClip == null || basic.viewPrefab == null)
                Assert.Ignore("basic 타워에 모델·Build 클립이 연결되지 않음");

            var data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonsterDef>("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { basic });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            towerRoot = new GameObject("TestTowerViews");
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player, towerRoot.transform); // 표시 있음
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;

            // 에디터 모드에서는 풀이 만든 표시의 Awake(TowerAim 시작 자세)가 불리지 않으므로 직접 부른다
            var awake = typeof(TowerAim).GetMethod("Awake", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            foreach (var aim in towerRoot.GetComponentsInChildren<TowerAim>(true))
                awake.Invoke(aim, null);

            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            run.Cash = 10000;
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            monsters.HandleStateChanged(new StateChange(GameState.Wave, 1, 1));
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            if (towerRoot != null)
                Object.DestroyImmediate(towerRoot);
        }

        static Transform Part(TowerInstance t, string name)
        {
            foreach (var child in t.View.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true))
                if (child.name == name)
                    return child;
            return null;
        }

        [Test]
        public void Build_PlaysAssembly_ThenAttacks()
        {
            float length = basic.buildClip.length;
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(Site, basic));
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(Site);
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Building, t.State, "설치 직후 조립 연출");
            Assert.IsFalse(t.Parts.IsMerged, "조립 중에는 부품을 따로 그린다");

            // 사거리 안에 몬스터가 있어도 조립 중에는 쏘지 않는다
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 1, 1f, 0f) }, 1);
            monsters.TickSpawn(0f);
            monsters.TickMove(1f);
            towers.TickCombat(0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.ProjectileCount);
            Assert.IsTrue(t.Locked.IsNone, "대상도 잡지 않음");

            towers.TickViews(length * 0.5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Building, t.State, "연출 도중");
            towers.TickViews(length * 0.6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Idle, t.State, "연출이 끝나면 공격 대기");
            Assert.IsTrue(t.Parts.IsMerged, "끝나면 합친 메시로");

            towers.TickCombat(0.1f);
            Assert.IsFalse(t.Locked.IsNone, "이제 대상을 잡는다");
        }

        [Test]
        public void Build_EndsInExactRestPose()
        {
            var prefabBase = basic.viewPrefab.transform.Find("TT_Base");
            towers.Build(Site, basic);
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(Site);
            towers.TickViews(basic.buildClip.length * 0.3f);
            var basePart = Part(t, "TT_Base");
            towers.TickViews(basic.buildClip.length);
            Assert.AreEqual(prefabBase.localPosition, basePart.localPosition, "완성 자세 = 모델 기본 자세 (합친 메시와 어긋나지 않음)");
            Assert.AreEqual(prefabBase.localScale, basePart.localScale);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Sell_PlaysReverse_ThenReturnsToPool()
        {
            float length = basic.buildClip.length;
            towers.Build(Site, basic);
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(Site);
            towers.TickViews(length + 0.1f);
            Assert.AreEqual(TowerState.Idle, t.State);

            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Sell(t));
            Assert.IsNull(towers.GetTowerAt(Site), "게임에서는 바로 빠진다");
            Assert.IsFalse(board.IsOccupied(Site), "칸도 바로 비운다");
            Assert.IsTrue(t.View.gameObject.activeSelf, "분해 연출 동안은 보인다");

            towers.TickViews(length * 0.5f);
            Assert.IsTrue(t.View.gameObject.activeSelf);
            towers.TickViews(length * 0.6f);
            Assert.IsFalse(t.View.gameObject.activeSelf, "분해가 끝나면 숨기고 풀로");
            Assert.IsTrue(t.Parts.IsMerged, "다음에 꺼낼 때를 위해 원래대로");
        }

        [Test]
        public void SellWhileBuilding_ReversesFromCurrentPoint()
        {
            float length = basic.buildClip.length;
            towers.Build(Site, basic);
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(Site);
            towers.TickViews(length * 0.25f);
            towers.Sell(t);

            towers.TickViews(length * 0.3f); // 25%까지만 조립됐으니 25%만큼 거꾸로 가면 끝
            Assert.IsFalse(t.View.gameObject.activeSelf);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MoveAllToRecovery_DemolishesEveryTower()
        {
            towers.Build(Site, basic);
            towers.Build(new Vector2Int(2, 0), basic);
            towers.TickViews(basic.buildClip.length + 0.1f);
            var views = new[] { towers.Towers[0].View, towers.Towers[1].View };

            towers.MoveAllTowersToRecovery(4);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.Towers.Count);
            Assert.IsTrue(views[0].gameObject.activeSelf && views[1].gameObject.activeSelf, "층 전환 연출 동안 분해");
            towers.TickViews(basic.buildClip.length + 0.1f);
            Assert.IsFalse(views[0].gameObject.activeSelf || views[1].gameObject.activeSelf);
        }
    }
}

    using System.Collections.Generic;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace TowerDefence.Tests
{
    // 타워 방향: 공격은 바라보는 쪽 앞 칸만 (바로 옆 줄 제외), 제자리 회전, 플라즈마 일직선 (헤드 고정).
    // 고정 7×7 맵 경로: 0(3,0) 1(3,1) 2(3,2) 3(4,2) 4(5,2) 5(5,3) 6(5,4) 7(5,5) 8(5,6)
    public class TowerFacingTests
    {
        GameConfig config;
        GameData data;
        Board board;
        MonsterManager monsters;
        TowerManager towers;
        PlayerState player;
        TowerDef basic;
        TowerDef line;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            config = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameConfig>("Assets/Data/GameConfig.asset");
            basic = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            basic.id = "basicTest";
            basic.buildCost = 10;
            basic.damage = 1f;
            basic.interval = 1f;
            basic.range = 2;
            basic.attackType = AttackType.Hitscan;
            line = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TowerDef>();
            line.id = "lineTest";
            line.buildCost = 10;
            line.damage = 1f;
            line.interval = 0.2f;
            line.range = 3;
            line.attackType = AttackType.Line;

            data = new GameData();
            data.Init(config, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MapGenRules>("Assets/Data/MapGenRules.asset"),
                new[] { TestAssets.NoIdleCopy("Assets/Data/Monsters/normal.asset") }, new[] { basic, line });
            board = new Board();
            monsters = new MonsterManager();
            towers = new TowerManager();
            player = new PlayerState();
            board.Init(data);
            player.Init(data);
            monsters.Init(data, board);
            towers.Init(data, board, monsters, player);
            towers.TowerChanged += board.HandleTowerChanged;
            var run = RunState.CreateNew(config);
            board.ResetForNewRun(run);
            player.ResetForNewRun(run);
            monsters.ResetForNewRun(run);
            towers.ResetForNewRun(run);
            board.Load(new FixedTestMapGenerator().Generate(default));
            player.Earn(1000, CashReason.Kill);
            monsters.DebugHpOverride = 1000;
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            Object.DestroyImmediate(basic);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(line);
        }

        HashSet<Vector2Int> CoveredCells(TowerInstance t)
        {
            var set = new HashSet<Vector2Int>();
            foreach (int id in t.Covered)
                set.Add(new Vector2Int(id / board.N, id % board.N));
            return set;
        }

        [Test]
        public void SquareRange_CoversOnlyCellsInFront()
        {
            var site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, basic, 1)); // +x (경로 쪽)
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(site);
            CollectionAssert.AreEquivalent(
                new[] { new Vector2Int(3, 0), new Vector2Int(3, 1), new Vector2Int(3, 2), new Vector2Int(4, 2) }, CoveredCells(t));

            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Sell(t));
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, basic, 3)); // −x (경로 반대쪽): 공격할 칸 없음
            Assert.AreEqual(0, towers.GetTowerAt(site).Covered.Length);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SideRow_IsExcluded_AndBestFacingCoversMostPath()
        {
            var site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, towers.BestFacing(basic, site), "+x가 경로 칸 4개로 가장 많다");
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, basic, 0)); // +y: 같은 줄 (3,0)은 바로 옆이라 제외
            var cells = CoveredCells(towers.GetTowerAt(site));
            Assert.IsFalse(cells.Contains(new Vector2Int(3, 0)), "바로 옆 줄은 180° 밖");
            Assert.IsTrue(cells.Contains(new Vector2Int(3, 1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void MoveInPlace_RotatesAndRecomputesRange()
        {
            var site = new Vector2Int(2, 0);
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, basic, 3));
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(site);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, t.Covered.Length);
            Assert.IsFalse(towers.Move(t, site, 3), "같은 칸·같은 방향이면 바뀌는 것 없음");
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Move(t, site, 1), "제자리에서 방향만 바꾼다");
            Assert.AreEqual(1, t.Facing);
            Assert.AreEqual(4, t.Covered.Length);
            Assert.IsTrue(board.IsOccupied(site), "점유는 그대로");
        }

        [Test]
        public void LineTower_CoversStraightCells_AndHitsEveryMonsterOnThem()
        {
            var site = new Vector2Int(2, 2);
            Assert.IsTrue(towers.Build(site, line, 1)); // +x: (3,2) (4,2) (5,2)
            var t = towers.GetTowerAt(site);
            CollectionAssert.AreEquivalent(
                new[] { new Vector2Int(3, 2), new Vector2Int(4, 2), new Vector2Int(5, 2) }, CoveredCells(t));

            // 몬스터를 여러 마리 흘려 보내 줄 위에 2마리 이상 올라올 때 1번 쏜다
            monsters.BeginWave(new[] { new WaveSpawn("normal", 12, 0.3f, 0f) }, 1);
            var onLine = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            var all = new List<MonsterInstance>();
            for (int step = 0; step < 400 && onLine.Count < 2; step++)
            {
                monsters.TickSpawn(0.05f);
                monsters.TickMove(0.05f);
                onLine.Clear();
                all.Clear();
                for (int pathIndex = 0; pathIndex < board.GetPathLength(0); pathIndex++)
                    foreach (var h in board.MonstersAt(board.CellId(board.GetPathCell(0, pathIndex))))
                    {
                        var m = monsters.Get(h);
                        all.Add(m);
                        if (t.CoversCell[m.CellId])
                            onLine.Add(m);
                    }
            }
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(onLine.Count, 2, "줄 위에 몬스터 2마리 이상");
            var hp = new Dictionary<MonsterInstance, float>();
            foreach (var m in all)
                hp[m] = m.Hp;

            towers.TickCombat(0f);

            foreach (var m in all)
            {
                if (onLine.Contains(m))
                    Assert.AreEqual(hp[m] - 1f, m.Hp, 1e-4f, "줄 위 몬스터는 모두 맞는다");
                else
                    Assert.AreEqual(hp[m], m.Hp, 1e-4f, "줄 밖은 안 맞는다");
            }
        }
    }
}
